new_nodes.detail: Door slides sideways in rails; conductive gasket closes the seam

ideas.rationale: Slide like a patio door; no swing, no button, full visibility.

raw_text:
{"ideas":[
{"title":"Single Start button with humidity auto-stop","anchors":["C13","F7","X13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Start button + exhaust humidity sensor","detail":"One button; magnetron runs until steam burst detected, then stops"},{"type":"Technology","label":"Humidity-based doneness sensing","detail":"Capacitive humidity sensor in exhaust duct detects food steam release"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Start button + exhaust humidity sensor","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Start button + exhaust humidity sensor","to":"X13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Start button + exhaust humidity sensor","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Start button + exhaust humidity sensor","to":"Humidity-based doneness sensing","type":"enabled_by"}],"rationale":"User presses one button and never thinks about minutes."},
{"title":"Food-icon dial replaces minutes scale","anchors":["C13","F7"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Icon dial (cup, bowl, plate, pizza)","detail":"Same cam timer but scale printed as food pictures with pre-tuned durations"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Icon dial (cup, bowl, plate, pizza)","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Icon dial (cup, bowl, plate, pizza)","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Icon dial (cup, bowl, plate, pizza)","to":"M6","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"Turn to the picture of what you are heating; no mental time arithmetic."},
{"title":"Weighing turntable sets time automatically","anchors":["C13","F7","X13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Load-cell turntable support","detail":"Mass of food maps to heating duration via fixed J/g rule"},{"type":"Technology","label":"Mass-proportional energy dosing","detail":"Energy delivered = k × mass, k selected by a reheat/defrost toggle"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Load-cell turntable support","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Load-cell turntable support","to":"Mass-proportional energy dosing","type":"enabled_by"},{"from":"Load-cell turntable support","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Place food, press start; machine deduces time from weight."},
{"title":"One knob: Cold–Warm–Hot","anchors":["C13","C14","F7","F8"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Single outcome knob (warm/hot/boiling)","detail":"Merged cam sets both duration and duty cycle from one temperature-feel scale"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Single outcome knob (warm/hot/boiling)","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Single outcome knob (warm/hot/boiling)","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Single outcome knob (warm/hot/boiling)","to":"M6","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"User chooses the result they want, not the engineering parameters."},
{"title":"Inverter replaces duty-cycle cam","anchors":["C14","T11","X6"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Technology","label":"Inverter continuous power control","detail":"Switch-mode supply varies magnetron anode current for true continuous power"},{"type":"Component","label":"Continuous power slider","detail":"Linear potentiometer labelled gentle→blast"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Inverter continuous power control","to":"T11","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Continuous power slider","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Inverter continuous power control","to":"X6","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Behaviour is predictable like a stove dial, no confusing pulsing."},
{"title":"Delete the power knob entirely","anchors":["C14","F8","X12"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Fixed 500 W gentle-only magnetron drive","detail":"Lower fixed output makes over-cooking forgiving; only time remains"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Fixed 500 W gentle-only magnetron drive","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Fixed 500 W gentle-only magnetron drive","to":"X12","type":"partially_mitigates"},{"from":"Fixed 500 W gentle-only magnetron drive","to":"M6","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"One control is simpler than two; forgiving power removes need for the second."},
{"title":"Voice-only control","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Offline keyword speech module","detail":"Recognises 'heat', 'defrost', 'stop', 'two minutes' without cloud"},{"type":"Technology","label":"Embedded keyword spotting","detail":"Low-power DSP speech recognition"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Offline keyword speech module","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Offline keyword speech module","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Offline keyword speech module","to":"Embedded keyword spotting","type":"enabled_by"}],"rationale":"Speaking is the zero-learning-curve interface, especially for A4."},
{"title":"Heat-to-temperature button with IR eye","anchors":["C13","C14","X13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"IR thermopile + 'Eat temp' button","detail":"Cooks until surface reaches 65 °C then stops"},{"type":"Technology","label":"Non-contact infrared food thermometry","detail":"Thermopile through choke-protected aperture reads food surface temperature"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"IR thermopile + 'Eat temp' button","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"IR thermopile + 'Eat temp' button","to":"X13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"IR thermopile + 'Eat temp' button","to":"Non-contact infrared food thermometry","type":"enabled_by"}],"rationale":"User asks for 'ready to eat', never for watts or minutes."},
{"title":"Magnetic pull door, no button","anchors":["C15","T18","F9"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Magnet-held door with grab handle","detail":"Ferrite catch holds door; reed switch is the interlock"},{"type":"Technology","label":"Magnetic catch + reed interlock","detail":"Replaces lever latch and hook mechanism"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Magnet-held door with grab handle","to":"C15","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Magnetic catch + reed interlock","to":"T18","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Magnet-held door with grab handle","to":"F9","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Pulling a fridge-like door needs no instruction."},
{"title":"Drawer cavity replaces hinged door","anchors":["C8","C26","C15","F9"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Pull-out drawer cavity","detail":"Food sits in a drawer; closing it is the only action"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Pull-out drawer cavity","to":"C8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Pull-out drawer cavity","to":"C26","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Pull-out drawer cavity","to":"C15","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Drawers are universally understood and need no latch button."},
{"title":"Roll-up metal shutter door","anchors":["C8","C26","T18"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Conductive tambour shutter","detail":"Interlocking steel slats roll up into the top; contact strips keep RF seal"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Conductive tambour shutter","to":"C8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Conductive tambour shutter","to":"C26","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Conductive tambour shutter","to":"X2","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Push up to open, pull down to cook; no swing clearance or button."},
{"title":"Top-loading pot-lid microwave","anchors":["C8","C15","F9"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Hinged top lid with choke flange","detail":"Cavity opens from above like a saucepan lid"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Hinged top lid with choke flange","to":"C8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Hinged top lid with choke flange","to":"C15","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Hinged top lid with choke flange","to":"F9","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Lifting a lid is a cooking gesture everyone already knows."},
{"title":"Hand-wound spring timer (no mains clock)","anchors":["C13","T8","X15"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Technology","label":"Escapement clockwork timer","detail":"Wind-up spring with balance escapement, independent of mains frequency"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Escapement clockwork timer","to":"T8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Escapement clockwork timer","to":"X15","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Escapement clockwork timer","to":"F7","type":"enables_function"}],"rationale":"Same egg-timer twist everywhere in the world, identical feel."},
{"title":"Hold-to-heat pad","anchors":["C13","F7"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Capacitive dead-man pad","detail":"Magnetron runs only while a hand rests on the pad"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Capacitive dead-man pad","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Capacitive dead-man pad","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Capacitive dead-man pad","to":"M6","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"No setting at all: you heat for as long as you touch, like a tap."},
{"title":"Foot pedal operation","anchors":["C13","C15"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Foot pedal (press=heat, double-tap=open)","detail":"Hands-free control for users carrying dishes"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Foot pedal (press=heat, double-tap=open)","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Foot pedal (press=heat, double-tap=open)","to":"C15","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"One pedal, two obvious actions; no front panel to read."},
{"title":"Barcode scanner reads cook instructions","anchors":["C13","C14","X13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Front barcode scanner","detail":"Reads packaging code and looks up time/power in onboard table"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Front barcode scanner","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Front barcode scanner","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Front barcode scanner","to":"X13","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Swipe the package; the oven sets itself."},
{"title":"NFC containers carry their own settings","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"NFC reader under turntable","detail":"Tagged bowls/mugs announce their recommended program"},{"type":"Technology","label":"Passive NFC tagging","detail":"Heat-resistant tags embedded in glass containers"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"NFC reader under turntable","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"NFC reader under turntable","to":"Passive NFC tagging","type":"enabled_by"},{"from":"NFC reader under turntable","to":"M6","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"Put the mug in, press start; the mug knows."},
{"title":"Camera food recognition sets program","anchors":["C13","C14","X13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Cavity camera + on-device classifier","detail":"Recognises soup/plate/frozen block and selects a program"},{"type":"Technology","label":"Edge image classification","detail":"Tiny CNN on microcontroller"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Cavity camera + on-device classifier","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Cavity camera + on-device classifier","to":"X13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Cavity camera + on-device classifier","to":"Edge image classification","type":"enabled_by"}],"rationale":"Zero inputs from the user beyond closing the door."},
{"title":"Toaster-style lever","anchors":["C13","C14","T8"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Push-down lever with pop-up release","detail":"Push down to start; depth = duration; pops up with click when done"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Push-down lever with pop-up release","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Push-down lever with pop-up release","to":"T8","type":"relevant_to"},{"from":"Push-down lever with pop-up release","to":"M6","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"Borrows the most intuitive kitchen gesture there is."},
{"title":"Braille/tactile detent dial","anchors":["C13","A4"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Raised-dot detent dial (1 click = 30 s)","detail":"Strong clicks and raised numerals for eyes-free setting"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Raised-dot detent dial (1 click = 30 s)","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Raised-dot detent dial (1 click = 30 s)","to":"A4","type":"relevant_to"},{"from":"Raised-dot detent dial (1 click = 30 s)","to":"X5","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Counting clicks is simpler than reading a fine scale."},
{"title":"0–5 minute big-scale timer","anchors":["C13","X5"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Short-range 0–5 min cam timer","detail":"Same clockwork but gearing spreads 5 minutes over full 300° travel"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Short-range 0–5 min cam timer","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Short-range 0–5 min cam timer","to":"X5","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Most tasks are under 5 min; a wide scale makes 30 s easy to hit."},
{"title":"Crystal-clocked electronic timer in a knob","anchors":["T8","X5","X15"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Technology","label":"Quartz-timed knob encoder","detail":"Rotary encoder + MCU emulates cam timer, mains-independent"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Quartz-timed knob encoder","to":"T8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Quartz-timed knob encoder","to":"X15","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Quartz-timed knob encoder","to":"X5","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Keeps the familiar twist but makes it accurate everywhere."},
{"title":"Talking done-signal replaces bell","anchors":["C13","T8","A4"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Voice chip + big green lamp","detail":"Says 'your food is ready' and lights a large indicator"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Voice chip + big green lamp","to":"T8","type":"relevant_to"},{"from":"Voice chip + big green lamp","to":"A4","type":"relevant_to"},{"from":"Voice chip + big green lamp","to":"M6","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"Unambiguous feedback removes guessing about what the ding meant."},
{"title":"Transparent conductive film window","anchors":["C8","T5","T15"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Technology","label":"Conductive oxide (ITO/metal-mesh) laminate glass","detail":"Sheet resistance low enough to shield 2.45 GHz while fully clear"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Conductive oxide (ITO/metal-mesh) laminate glass","to":"T5","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Conductive oxide (ITO/metal-mesh) laminate glass","to":"C8","type":"enabled_by"},{"from":"Conductive oxide (ITO/metal-mesh) laminate glass","to":"X2","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"A clear window shows progress plainly, so no interface needed to 'check'."},
{"title":"Doorless cut-off tunnel for mugs","anchors":["C8","C15","C26","T5"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Open-front mug chimney cavity","detail":"Opening below waveguide cut-off diameter; no door, no latch, no hinge"},{"type":"Technology","label":"Below-cutoff waveguide attenuation","detail":"Narrow deep opening attenuates 2.45 GHz exponentially"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Open-front mug chimney cavity","to":"C8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Open-front mug chimney cavity","to":"C15","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Below-cutoff waveguide attenuation","to":"X2","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Nothing to open or close: slide the mug in, press one button."},
{"title":"Three preset buttons only","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Buttons: Drink / Meal / Defrost","detail":"Three fixed programs, nothing else on the panel"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Buttons: Drink / Meal / Defrost","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Buttons: Drink / Meal / Defrost","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Buttons: Drink / Meal / Defrost","to":"M6","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"Three choices cover 95% of use with zero reading."},
{"title":"Pull-cord timer","anchors":["C13","T8"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Pull-string spring timer","detail":"Pull length sets minutes; cord retracts as it counts down, visible progress"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Pull-string spring timer","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Pull-string spring timer","to":"T8","type":"relevant_to"}],"rationale":"Progress is physically visible; longer pull = longer heat, intuitive."},
{"title":"Knee-press door opener","anchors":["C15","F9"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Lower-front knee bar release","detail":"Wide bar at knee height trips the latch"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Lower-front knee bar release","to":"C15","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Lower-front knee bar release","to":"F9","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Opens with hands full of plates; no small button to find."},
{"title":"Living-hinge polymer door frame","anchors":["C26","T23"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Technology","label":"Moulded living hinge with metallised door","detail":"One-piece polymer door/hinge, vacuum-metallised for shielding"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Moulded living hinge with metallised door","to":"C26","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Moulded living hinge with metallised door","to":"T23","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Moulded living hinge with metallised door","to":"X12","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Lighter door with no pinch points is easier for frail hands."},
{"title":"Metallised fabric curtain door","anchors":["C8","C26","C15"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Conductive textile curtain with magnetic hem","detail":"Silver-coated fabric drops over opening; hem magnets seal to frame"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Conductive textile curtain with magnetic hem","to":"C8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Conductive textile curtain with magnetic hem","to":"C26","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Conductive textile curtain with magnetic hem","to":"X2","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Brush it aside like a shower curtain; nothing to operate."},
{"title":"Door-is-the-switch","anchors":["C13","C15","F7"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Close-to-run door with auto-stop sensor","detail":"Closing door starts heating; steam sensor or opening stops it"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Close-to-run door with auto-stop sensor","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Close-to-run door with auto-stop sensor","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Close-to-run door with auto-stop sensor","to":"X13","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Removes the start step entirely."},
{"title":"Caregiver-preset, no front panel","anchors":["C13","C14","A4"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Single big button + BLE preset by caregiver","detail":"Family member sets the program once via phone; user only presses GO"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Single big button + BLE preset by caregiver","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Single big button + BLE preset by caregiver","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Single big button + BLE preset by caregiver","to":"A4","type":"relevant_to"}],"rationale":"Elderly user faces exactly one button."},
{"title":"Bimetal thermal timer","anchors":["T8","X12","X15"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Technology","label":"Heated bimetal strip delay switch","detail":"Resistor warms strip; bend time sets duration, no motor"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Heated bimetal strip delay switch","to":"T8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Heated bimetal strip delay switch","to":"X12","type":"partially_mitigates"},{"from":"Heated bimetal strip delay switch","to":"X15","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Cheaper, frequency-independent, same simple knob feel."},
{"title":"Shelf height sets power","anchors":["C14","F8","T11"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Multi-level rack cavity","detail":"Field intensity varies with height; upper shelf = gentle, lower = strong"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Multi-level rack cavity","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Multi-level rack cavity","to":"F8","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Multi-level rack cavity","to":"X6","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Power becomes a physical placement decision, like an oven rack."},
{"title":"Waveguide vane attenuator","anchors":["C14","T11","X6"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Technology","label":"Mechanical waveguide attenuator slider","detail":"Lossy vane inserted into waveguide absorbs power continuously"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Mechanical waveguide attenuator slider","to":"T11","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Mechanical waveguide attenuator slider","to":"X6","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Mechanical waveguide attenuator slider","to":"C14","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"A smooth slider behaves like a volume knob—no steps to learn."},
{"title":"Only a +30 s button","anchors":["C13","X5"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Single large +30 s button with countdown lamp bar","detail":"Each press adds 30 s and starts; bar of LEDs shows remaining"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Single large +30 s button with countdown lamp bar","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Single large +30 s button with countdown lamp bar","to":"X5","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Press once or several times—nothing else to understand."},
{"title":"Traffic-light doneness indicator","anchors":["C13","X13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Red/amber/green doneness lamp","detail":"IR sensor drives lamp; user stops when green, timer optional"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Red/amber/green doneness lamp","to":"X13","type":"partially_mitigates"},{"from":"Red/amber/green doneness lamp","to":"C13","type":"relevant_to"},{"from":"Red/amber/green doneness lamp","to":"M6","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"Universal colour code replaces numeric settings."},
{"title":"Vessel-detent dial","anchors":["C13","F7"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Timer with click stops labelled Mug / Bowl / Plate","detail":"Cam timer detents at pre-tuned durations"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Timer with click stops labelled Mug / Bowl / Plate","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Timer with click stops labelled Mug / Bowl / Plate","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Turn until it clicks for your dish; done."},
{"title":"Gravity drop-down door, no latch","anchors":["C15","T18","C26"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Bottom-hinged weighted door","detail":"Door falls shut under its own weight; reed switch interlock"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Bottom-hinged weighted door","to":"C15","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Bottom-hinged weighted door","to":"T18","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Bottom-hinged weighted door","to":"F9","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Lift to open, let go to close—no button, no slamming."},
{"title":"Push-push cabinet latch","anchors":["C15","T18"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Technology","label":"Push-to-open cabinet catch","detail":"Press door face to pop it open; press again to latch"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Push-to-open cabinet catch","to":"T18","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Push-to-open cabinet catch","to":"C15","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Whole door is the button; nothing to locate."},
{"title":"Turntable-rotation timer","anchors":["C13","T8","X12"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Rotation-counting turntable timer","detail":"Knob sets number of turns; turntable motor shaft drives cam, no separate timer motor"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Rotation-counting turntable timer","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Rotation-counting turntable timer","to":"T8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Rotation-counting turntable timer","to":"X12","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Fewer parts, and 'three turns' is a tangible unit for users."},
{"title":"Push-depth drawer sets time","anchors":["C13","C8","F7"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Drawer with graduated push-in travel","detail":"How far the drawer is pushed in winds the timer; it slides back out as it counts"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Drawer with graduated push-in travel","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Drawer with graduated push-in travel","to":"C8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Drawer with graduated push-in travel","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Loading and setting time become one motion."},
{"title":"Program cartridge slot","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Coded plastic card slot","detail":"Insert 'Soup' or 'Rice' card; notches set cam positions mechanically"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Coded plastic card slot","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Coded plastic card slot","to":"C14","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Picking a card is choosing a dish, not a setting."},
{"title":"Visible ball-run timer","anchors":["C13","T8","X5"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Marble-run gravity timer","detail":"Drop N marbles; each takes 30 s to roll through and trip a switch"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Marble-run gravity timer","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Marble-run gravity timer","to":"T8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Marble-run gravity timer","to":"X5","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Time is counted in physical objects you can see and understand."},
{"title":"Spiral combined time-power dial","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Spiral-scale single dial","detail":"First turn = defrost power, second turn = full power; angle = minutes"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Spiral-scale single dial","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Spiral-scale single dial","to":"C14","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"One knob instead of two halves the interface."},
{"title":"Thermostat dial with closed loop","anchors":["C14","C13","X13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Target-temperature dial + IR feedback","detail":"Set 40–90 °C; oven cycles magnetron to hold that temperature then stops"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Target-temperature dial + IR feedback","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Target-temperature dial + IR feedback","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Target-temperature dial + IR feedback","to":"X13","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Works like a room thermostat, a control everyone already understands."},
{"title":"Hold-door-closed to heat","anchors":["C15","C13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Spring-open door with hold-to-run interlock","detail":"Door springs open when released; heating only while user holds it shut"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Spring-open door with hold-to-run interlock","to":"C15","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Spring-open door with hold-to-run interlock","to":"C13","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Impossible to misuse: let go and it stops and opens."},
{"title":"Minute tokens","anchors":["C13","T8"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Token slot timer","detail":"Drop wooden 1-minute tokens into a slot; each token advances the cam"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Token slot timer","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Token slot timer","to":"T8","type":"relevant_to"}],"rationale":"Counting tokens is concrete and playful, no scale reading."},
{"title":"Gesture wave control","anchors":["C13","C15"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"ToF gesture sensor","detail":"Wave up = +30 s, wave down = stop, hold palm = open door"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"ToF gesture sensor","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"ToF gesture sensor","to":"C15","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Touch-free, wipeable, three gestures only."},
{"title":"Juke-box tilt lever for power","anchors":["C14","F8"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Big tilt lever Low/High","detail":"Two-position lever drives duty-cycle cam; no five-step confusion"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Big tilt lever Low/High","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Big tilt lever Low/High","to":"F8","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Binary choice is the simplest possible power control."},
{"title":"Open-plan sliding glass door","anchors":["C8","C26","C15","T15"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Side-sliding ITO glass panel","detail":"Door slides sideways in rails; conductive gasket closes the seam"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Side-sliding ITO glass panel","to":"C8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Side-sliding ITO glass panel","to":"C26","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Side-sliding ITO glass panel","to":"C15","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Slide like a patio door; no swing, no button, full visibility."}
]}

new_nodes.label: Single large GO button (fixed 30 s per press, auto-accumulating)
new_nodes.detail: Replaces both knobs; each press adds 30 s at full power, long-press clears.

new_edges.from: Single large GO button (fixed 30 s per press, auto-accumulating)
Single large GO button (fixed 30 s per press, auto-accumulating)
Single large GO button (fixed 30 s per press, auto-accumulating)

ideas.rationale: A single control with one obvious action removes every decision point, giving zero learning curve.

ideas.title: Toaster-Lever Timer

new_nodes.label: Spring-loaded depth lever with escapement
new_nodes.detail: Push depth sets minutes; lever rises as it counts down and pops up at the end.

new_nodes.label: Toaster-style start lever
new_nodes.detail: Push down to start, lever position shows remaining time, pop-up ends cycle.

new_edges.from: Fibre-optic light pipe from the fascia
Fibre-optic light pipe from the fascia

ideas.rationale: Nothing to burn out, so the 'look inside' check always works.

ideas.title: LED strip for the lamp

new_nodes.label: Mains-driven LED bar behind door frame
new_nodes.detail: Lifetime LEDs doubling as a bright 'cooking' ring around the window

new_edges.from: Mains-driven LED bar behind door frame
Mains-driven LED bar behind door frame

ideas.rationale: A glowing door ring makes 'it is running' unambiguous from any angle.

ideas.title: Add-30-seconds rocker

new_nodes.label: Single 'a bit more' rocker
new_nodes.detail: One oversized rocker: each tap adds 30 s of full power; auto-starts on door close

ideas.rationale: Mirrors how people actually use microwaves: start, check, add a bit.

ideas.title: Passive chimney cooling

new_nodes.label: Heat-pipe and chimney stack
new_nodes.detail: Magnetron heat conducted to a rear fin chimney; natural draught replaces the fan

ideas.rationale: A silent, fanless oven gives one clear sound (the done signal) and no noise to misinterpret as a fault.

ideas.title: Vibrating pager puck

new_nodes.label: Detachable vibrating coaster
new_nodes.detail: Restaurant-pager style puck buzzes when the timer trips; sits on the oven top when not carried

ideas.rationale: You feel 'done' in your pocket; no need to watch or listen to the appliance.

ideas.title: Weight-sensing defrost

new_nodes.label: Frozen-mass defrost cam
new_nodes.detail: Spring scale under the tray plus a 'frozen' flip switch picks a defrost duty and duration automatically

ideas.rationale: Defrosting, the most confusing task, becomes 'flip one switch'.

ideas.title: Removable silicone floor mat

new_nodes.label: Dishwasher-safe silicone cavity mat
new_nodes.detail: Non-slip mat replaces the glass tray on a flat floor; lifts out to wash

ideas.rationale: No breakable tray to re-seat on its ring; cleaning is lift, rinse, drop back.

ideas.title: Overlapping lip seal instead of choke

new_nodes.label: Conductive elastomer gasket
new_nodes.detail: Metal-filled silicone gasket seals RF by contact, tolerating a slightly misaligned door

ideas.rationale: A door that seals even when shut casually removes 'slam it harder' learning.

ideas.title: Rotating cavity, fixed food

new_nodes.label: Slowly rotating waveguide feed ring
new_nodes.detail: The feed port orbits around the cavity wall so the field sweeps the food

ideas.rationale: Food stays where you put it, so handles and cups never spin out of reach.

ideas.title: Shadow-clock timer window

new_nodes.label: Large mechanical countdown drum
new_nodes.detail: Timer cam drives a drum with huge numerals and a shrinking colour bar visible from across the room

ideas.rationale: Remaining time is read like a traffic light, not a tiny dial scale.

ideas.title: Single Big Button

new_nodes.label: One-touch start/stop button
new_nodes.detail: Replaces timer and power knobs with one button; each press adds 30 s at full power

new_nodes.label: Single-action cooking start
new_nodes.detail: User starts heating with one press, no settings

ideas.rationale: Removes all choices so anyone can operate it instantly.

ideas.title: Weight-Sensing Turntable

new_nodes.label: Load-cell turntable
new_nodes.detail: Weighs the food and sets time automatically

new_nodes.label: Automatic time setting by mass
new_nodes.detail: No timer input needed

ideas.rationale: The food itself tells the oven how long to run, eliminating the timer knob.

ideas.title: Steam-Stop Sensor

new_nodes.label: Humidity sensor auto-stop
new_nodes.detail: Stops heating when steam burst indicates food is hot

new_nodes.label: Capacitive humidity sensing
new_nodes.detail: Low-cost MEMS sensor

ideas.rationale: Replaces timer with doneness detection so users never set a time.

ideas.title: Door-Is-The-Switch

new_nodes.label: Door-closure start interlock
new_nodes.detail: Closing the door starts heating; opening stops it

new_nodes.label: Zero-control operation
new_nodes.detail: Only action is door open/close

ideas.rationale: No buttons or knobs at all; the door is the entire interface.

ideas.title: Egg-Timer Style Dial Only

new_nodes.label: Single 0-10 min dial
new_nodes.detail: Replaces both knobs; power fixed at full

ideas.rationale: One familiar kitchen-timer gesture is all that is needed.

ideas.title: Food-Picture Buttons

new_nodes.label: Icon preset keypad
new_nodes.detail: Buttons show cup, plate, popcorn, bowl; each runs a fixed program

new_nodes.label: Picture-based selection
new_nodes.detail: No numbers or reading required

ideas.rationale: Users match food to picture, no mental arithmetic on wattage or minutes.

ideas.title: Voice Command Module

new_nodes.label: Offline voice recogniser
new_nodes.detail: Replaces knobs with spoken commands like 'two minutes'

new_nodes.label: Keyword-spotting ASR chip
new_nodes.detail: No internet needed

ideas.rationale: Talking is the most natural interface with zero learning.

ideas.title: IR Thermometer Auto-Stop

new_nodes.label: Infrared surface-temperature sensor
new_nodes.detail: Stops when food reaches 70 °C

new_nodes.label: Target-temperature cooking
new_nodes.detail: Doneness replaces duration

ideas.rationale: User never guesses time; oven stops when food is hot.

ideas.title: Barcode Reader Door

new_nodes.label: Package barcode scanner
new_nodes.detail: Reads ready-meal code and sets program automatically

new_nodes.label: 1D barcode camera scanning
new_nodes.detail: Low-cost CMOS camera

ideas.rationale: Scanning the package removes all manual settings.

ideas.title: Foot Pedal Start

new_nodes.label: Foot-pedal run switch
new_nodes.detail: Oven heats only while pedal pressed, like a sewing machine

ideas.rationale: Intuitive hold-to-run control with no timing decisions.

ideas.title: Hold-To-Heat Button

new_nodes.label: Momentary dead-man heat button
new_nodes.detail: Magnetron runs only while finger holds button

new_nodes.label: Direct manual duration control
new_nodes.detail: User feels the duration, no counting

ideas.rationale: Simplest possible control metaphor: press to heat, release to stop.

ideas.title: Sand Hourglass Timer

new_nodes.label: Flip hourglass with optical end sensor
new_nodes.detail: User flips hourglass; sensor stops oven when sand runs out

new_edges.from: Flip hourglass with optical end sensor
Flip hourglass with optical end sensor

ideas.rationale: Universally understood timing object replaces numbered dial.

ideas.title: Colour-Change Window

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic door panel
new_nodes.detail: Glass turns from blue to red as cavity warms, no lamp needed

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic ink film
new_nodes.detail: Passive, no power

ideas.rationale: Status is read at a glance by colour with no display to learn.

ideas.title: LED Ring Progress

new_nodes.label: LED ring around door
new_nodes.detail: Fills as cooking proceeds, replaces bell and lamp

ideas.rationale: Progress is visible from across the room without reading anything.

ideas.title: Smartphone Camera Lens

new_nodes.label: Phone cradle with mesh window
new_nodes.detail: User's phone camera replaces lamp and viewing window

ideas.rationale: Uses device users already know to monitor food.

ideas.title: Glass-Only Cavity

new_nodes.label: Transparent mesh-laminated glass casing
new_nodes.detail: Whole oven is see-through, no lamp or window holes

ideas.rationale: What you see is what is happening; nothing hidden to understand.

ideas.title: Rotating Drum Instead of Turntable

new_nodes.label: Mode-stirrer fan
new_nodes.detail: Replaces glass turntable with metal stirrer for even heating

ideas.rationale: No turntable to remove, clean or misalign, so nothing to get wrong.

ideas.title: Flat-Bed Ceramic Floor

new_nodes.label: Fixed ceramic floor with bottom antenna
new_nodes.detail: Flat floor, no moving parts

new_edges.from: Fixed ceramic floor with bottom antenna
Fixed ceramic floor with bottom antenna

ideas.rationale: Any dish fits anywhere; no fitting a plate to a ring.

ideas.title: Pull-Handle Door

new_nodes.label: Magnetic-latch pull handle
new_nodes.detail: Replaces push-release button with a fridge-style pull

ideas.rationale: Everyone knows how to pull a handle; no hunting for a button.

ideas.title: Drawer Oven

new_nodes.label: Pull-out drawer cavity
new_nodes.detail: Food sits in a drawer; pushing it shut starts heating

ideas.rationale: Drawer metaphor is familiar and closing it is the only action.

ideas.title: Auto-Open Door

new_nodes.label: Spring auto-opening door at end
new_nodes.detail: Door pops open when done, replacing bell

ideas.rationale: End-of-cook is unmistakable and food is already accessible.

ideas.title: Toaster Lever

new_nodes.label: Push-down toaster lever
new_nodes.detail: Lever starts cooking and pops up when done

ideas.rationale: Borrows the universally understood toaster gesture.

ideas.title: Two-Position Slider

new_nodes.label: Warm/Cook slider
new_nodes.detail: Replaces 5-step power cam with two settings

ideas.rationale: Two obvious choices instead of five abstract power levels.

ideas.title: No Power Knob, Inverter Auto-Taper

new_nodes.label: Inverter supply with automatic power taper
new_nodes.detail: Starts full, reduces automatically as food warms

new_nodes.label: Inverter magnetron drive
new_nodes.detail: Continuous power control

new_edges.from: Inverter supply with automatic power taper
Inverter supply with automatic power taper
Inverter supply with automatic power taper

ideas.rationale: Oven manages power itself so user never picks a level.

ideas.title: Dish-Recognising Camera

new_nodes.label: Cavity camera with food classifier
new_nodes.detail: Identifies food type and sets program

new_nodes.label: Edge image classification
new_nodes.detail: Tiny neural net on microcontroller

ideas.rationale: Put food in, close door, done—no settings.

ideas.title: RFID Container Tags

new_nodes.label: RFID reader for tagged containers
new_nodes.detail: Supplied containers carry program tags

ideas.rationale: Container choice replaces settings; user learns nothing.

ideas.title: Reflected-Power Doneness

new_nodes.label: Directional coupler load monitor
new_nodes.detail: Detects change in absorbed microwave power to stop automatically

new_nodes.label: RF reflectometry
new_nodes.detail: Senses food state via impedance

ideas.rationale: Oven senses doneness electrically, removing timing from the user.

ideas.title: Cup-Shaped Cavity

new_nodes.label: Mug-only cylindrical cavity
new_nodes.detail: Fits one mug; fixed program for drinks

ideas.rationale: Single-purpose shape means there is only one way to use it.

ideas.title: Tactile Braille-Free Knob with Clicks

new_nodes.label: Detent knob with one-minute haptic clicks
new_nodes.detail: Each click equals one minute, no scale to read

new_edges.from: Detent knob with one-minute haptic clicks
Detent knob with one-minute haptic clicks

ideas.rationale: Counting clicks by feel replaces reading a dial.

ideas.title: Gesture Wave Start

new_nodes.label: IR proximity gesture sensor
new_nodes.detail: Wave hand to add 30 s

ideas.rationale: Touch-free, no buttons, works with messy hands.

ideas.title: Spoken Progress Instead of Bell

new_nodes.label: Speech synthesis speaker
new_nodes.detail: Says 'your food is ready' instead of bell

ideas.rationale: Plain language feedback needs no interpretation.

ideas.title: Transparent Turntable With Minute Marks

new_nodes.label: Turntable as clock face
new_nodes.detail: Turntable rotation itself shows elapsed time; no lamp or display

ideas.rationale: Existing motion doubles as timer display, removing a control.

ideas.title: Glow Door Instead of Lamp

new_nodes.label: Edge-lit LED door glass
new_nodes.detail: Door itself glows, replacing interior bulb

ideas.rationale: Obvious on/off state visible from anywhere, nothing to learn.

ideas.title: Plate Clip Sensor

new_nodes.label: Dish-presence switch
new_nodes.detail: Oven refuses to start empty and auto-starts a default when dish placed

ideas.rationale: Prevents the common mistake of running empty without any instructions.

ideas.title: Water Reservoir Steam Oven Hybrid

new_nodes.label: Auto-fill steam cup
new_nodes.detail: Replaces power-level knob; steam prevents drying so full power is always safe

ideas.rationale: Always-full-power becomes forgiving, so no power choice is needed.

ideas.title: Doorbell Chime Replacement

new_nodes.label: Pleasant wireless chime relay
new_nodes.detail: Rings existing home doorbell receiver when done

ideas.rationale: Reuses a sound users already associate with attention.

ideas.title: Coin-Slot Style Token Timer

new_nodes.label: Minute token slot
new_nodes.detail: Drop one token per minute into slot; mechanical count sets time

ideas.rationale: Physical counting is intuitive for children and elderly.

ideas.title: Wall-Plug Timer Removal

new_nodes.label: Smart plug controlling magnetron power
new_nodes.detail: Oven has no controls; external plug app or button starts it

ideas.rationale: Oven becomes a dumb appliance; control lives where user already is.

ideas.title: Weight-Gradient Floor

new_nodes.label: Pressure-mat floor
new_nodes.detail: Cheap resistive mat under ceramic floor senses load for auto-time

new_nodes.label: Force-sensitive resistor
new_nodes.detail: Printed sensor

ideas.rationale: Cheaper than load cell, still removes timer decision.

ideas.title: Acoustic Popcorn Sensor

new_nodes.label: Cavity microphone
new_nodes.detail: Stops when popping or boiling sounds change

ideas.rationale: Oven listens so user does not have to.

ideas.title: Colour-Coded Dial Zones

new_nodes.label: Three-colour dial
new_nodes.detail: Green drink, yellow plate, red frozen; no numbers

ideas.rationale: Colour zones map directly to tasks instead of minutes.

ideas.title: Magnetron Replaced by Induction Plate

new_nodes.label: Induction-heated ferrite dish
new_nodes.detail: Dish heats by induction; simpler safety and no interlock door

new_nodes.label: Induction heating
new_nodes.detail: Coil under floor

ideas.rationale: Open-top design removes door and interlock complexity entirely.

ideas.title: Fixed-Time Capsule Oven

new_nodes.label: Single fixed 90-second program
new_nodes.detail: Only one program; repeat if needed

ideas.rationale: Zero parameters; the only decision is whether to run again.

ideas.title: Analog Clock-Hand Timer

new_nodes.label: Large clock-face hand timer
new_nodes.detail: Hand set to minute like a wall clock, visible from afar

ideas.rationale: Leverages clock literacy everyone already has.

ideas.title: String-Pull Starter

new_nodes.label: Pull-cord timer
new_nodes.detail: Pull cord length sets time, like a bath-light cord

ideas.rationale: Single gross motor action, usable with wet or gloved hands.

ideas.title: Door Window Projection

new_nodes.label: Pico-projector on door
new_nodes.detail: Projects remaining time onto the food itself, replaces lamp

ideas.rationale: Information appears where the user is already looking.

ideas.title: Self-Resetting Mechanical Bell Door

new_nodes.label: Door-wound spring timer
new_nodes.detail: Opening door winds timer; closing releases it for fixed run

ideas.rationale: Energy and intent come from the one action users must do anyway.

ideas.title: Scale-Free Portion Cups

new_nodes.label: Marked portion container set
new_nodes.detail: Fill-line containers map to the fixed program; no settings

ideas.rationale: Standardised portions make a single program always correct.

ideas.title: Thermal-Fuse Overcook Guard

new_nodes.label: Resettable cavity thermostat cutoff
new_nodes.detail: Stops oven if cavity air overheats, forgiving timer mistakes

ideas.rationale: Errors become harmless so there is nothing to learn to avoid.

ideas.title: Lid Instead of Door

new_nodes.label: Top-opening hinged lid
new_nodes.detail: Chest-style lid replaces front door and release button

ideas.rationale: Lifting a lid is universal; gravity keeps it closed, no latch to operate.

ideas.title: Food-pictogram dial replaces power knob

new_nodes.label: Pictogram preset dial
new_nodes.detail: Single dial with icons (soup, pizza, mug) that sets power and time together via a fixed cam.

ideas.rationale: User picks a picture instead of understanding watts and minutes.

ideas.title: Fixed-power oven, delete the power knob

new_nodes.label: Single full-power operation
new_nodes.detail: Remove the duty-cycle cam entirely; only a timer remains.

ideas.rationale: One control is the shortest possible learning curve.

ideas.title: 30-second tap button replaces clockwork timer

new_nodes.label: Add-30s pushbutton
new_nodes.detail: Each press adds 30 s; press starts immediately.

ideas.rationale: No dial to read; tapping is self-explanatory and precise for short runs.

ideas.title: Hold-to-heat deadman button

new_nodes.label: Momentary hold-to-cook switch
new_nodes.detail: Magnetron runs only while the big front pad is held; release stops.

ideas.rationale: Nothing to set; the user simply holds until the food looks ready.

ideas.title: IR surface thermometer replaces timer

new_nodes.label: Thermopile IR food sensing
new_nodes.detail: Non-contact sensor in cavity ceiling stops heating at a target temperature.

new_nodes.label: Cook-until-hot button
new_nodes.detail: Single button; oven stops at 70 °C surface.

ideas.rationale: Removes guessing of time and power altogether.

ideas.title: Humidity-sensor auto-stop

new_nodes.label: Steam exhaust humidity sensor
new_nodes.detail: Detects vapour surge and ends the cycle.

ideas.rationale: Press start once; the oven decides when it is done.

ideas.title: Weighing turntable sets the time

new_nodes.label: Load-cell turntable hub
new_nodes.detail: Food mass read at door close; time derived automatically.

ideas.rationale: Weight does the arithmetic so the user never does.

ideas.title: Magnetic door replaces lever latch

new_nodes.label: Magnetic door retention
new_nodes.detail: Ferrite strip holds door; simple pull opens it, no button or hooks.

ideas.rationale: Opening like a fridge needs no instruction.

ideas.title: Drawer-style cavity

new_nodes.label: Pull-out cooking drawer
new_nodes.detail: Cavity slides out on rails; closing it is the only action.

ideas.rationale: Loading a drawer is universally understood and needs no latch button.

ideas.title: Top-loading lid oven

new_nodes.label: Hinged top lid cavity
new_nodes.detail: Bread-bin style lid; gravity seals it, no latch mechanism.

ideas.rationale: Drop food in, shut lid, done—no handles or buttons to learn.

ideas.title: Hall-effect door sensing replaces three microswitches

new_nodes.label: Solid-state magnetic interlock
new_nodes.detail: Hall sensors plus a single monitored relay perform redundant logic.

ideas.rationale: Fewer wearing parts means the door always behaves the same, so users never meet odd failure modes.

ideas.title: Door hook is the HV plug

new_nodes.label: Door-hook contact interlock
new_nodes.detail: The door hook itself closes a mains contact; no separate switches.

ideas.rationale: Door closed equals power present, an inherently obvious rule.

ideas.title: Conductive elastomer gasket replaces choke seal

new_nodes.label: Silver-loaded silicone RF gasket
new_nodes.detail: Compressible conductive seal tolerant of misalignment.

ideas.rationale: Door closes securely however casually it is pushed.

ideas.title: Mode stirrer replaces turntable

new_nodes.label: Rotating metal stirrer blade
new_nodes.detail: Fan in waveguide scatters field; flat fixed floor.

ideas.rationale: No plate to seat, nothing to knock off the track.

ideas.title: Door-wound spring drives turntable

new_nodes.label: Clockwork turntable wound by door
new_nodes.detail: Closing the door winds a spring that rotates the plate for 10 min.

ideas.rationale: Removes a motor and wiring with zero change in user behaviour.

ideas.title: Under-floor rotating antenna

new_nodes.label: Rotating feed antenna beneath ceramic floor
new_nodes.detail: Antenna spins instead of food; floor is flat and wipeable.

new_edges.from: Rotating feed antenna beneath ceramic floor

ideas.rationale: Any dish fits anywhere; no instructions about centring.

ideas.title: Microtextured floor plate prevents superheating

new_nodes.label: Laser-etched nucleation ceramic
new_nodes.detail: Surface pits seed gentle boiling in mugs.

ideas.rationale: Users need not learn the 'put a spoon in' rule.

ideas.title: Inverter supply replaces diode-capacitor doubler

new_nodes.label: Switch-mode HV inverter
new_nodes.detail: Continuous true power control without stored HV capacitor.

ideas.rationale: Enables a smooth 'gentle–fast' slider instead of a stepped cam the user must interpret.

ideas.title: Solid-state GaN RF source

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplifier
new_nodes.detail: Reflected-power sensing gives automatic doneness detection.

ideas.rationale: Oven self-adjusts, leaving a single start button.

ideas.title: Neon charge indicator replaces bleeder resistor

new_nodes.label: Neon HV-live lamp
new_nodes.detail: Glows while capacitor holds charge, discharging it meanwhile.

ideas.rationale: A visible 'still hot' cue needs no manual.

ideas.title: Electroluminescent cavity wall

new_nodes.label: EL-coated cavity liner
new_nodes.detail: Whole wall glows; no bulb socket or replacement.

ideas.rationale: Nothing ever needs replacing or switching on.

ideas.title: Transparent ITO-coated glass door, no mesh, no lamp

new_nodes.label: Transparent conductive oxide shielding glass
new_nodes.detail: ITO layer blocks microwaves while fully clear.

ideas.rationale: Seeing food clearly replaces any need for status indicators.

ideas.title: Ambient-light pipe replaces bulb

new_nodes.label: Acrylic light pipe from front bezel
new_nodes.detail: Pipes kitchen light into the cavity.

new_edges.from: Acrylic light pipe from front bezel

ideas.rationale: Removes a bulb and a switch; illumination just happens.

ideas.title: Door pops ajar at end instead of bell

new_nodes.label: Spring door-release at timer zero
new_nodes.detail: Timer cam releases latch; door cracks open as the 'done' signal.

ideas.rationale: Open door is the most intuitive 'ready' signal possible.

ideas.title: Toaster-style pop-up tray

new_nodes.label: Spring-lifted food tray
new_nodes.detail: Tray rises to the opening when cooking finishes.

ideas.rationale: Borrows a gesture everyone already knows from toasters.

ideas.title: Glass-ceramic waveguide cover

new_nodes.label: Glass-ceramic (LAS) waveguide window
new_nodes.detail: Dishwasher-safe rigid plate replaces mica.

ideas.rationale: Wipe-clean interior means no maintenance rules to learn.

ideas.title: Integrated molded ceramic cavity ceiling

new_nodes.label: One-piece ceramic cavity top with feed window
new_nodes.detail: Waveguide cover molded into the liner.

new_edges.from: One-piece ceramic cavity top with feed window

ideas.rationale: No removable cover for users to lose or misfit.

ideas.title: Voice duration input

new_nodes.label: Offline keyword speech recognition
new_nodes.detail: Say 'two minutes' to start.

ideas.rationale: Speaking a time requires no understanding of the interface.

ideas.title: Gentle/Fast rocker replaces 5-step knob

new_nodes.label: Two-position power rocker
new_nodes.detail: Gentle (defrost/reheat) or Fast.

ideas.rationale: Binary choice beats five numbered steps.

ideas.title: Quartz escapement behind the same knob

new_nodes.label: Quartz-timed knob with stepper return
new_nodes.detail: Mechanical feel retained, electronic accuracy.

ideas.rationale: Keeps the familiar twist gesture while fixing short-time error.

ideas.title: 'A little – a lot' slider

new_nodes.label: Linear fader labelled little/lot
new_nodes.detail: Single slider maps to combined time and power curve.

ideas.rationale: Qualitative scale removes numeracy from the task.

ideas.title: Door is the start switch

new_nodes.label: Close-to-start, open-to-stop
new_nodes.detail: Closing the door starts a fixed 1-min burst; reopen to stop.

ideas.rationale: Zero buttons; the only control is the door.

ideas.title: Packaging-code reader sets program

new_nodes.label: Cavity-mounted barcode reader
new_nodes.detail: Reads ready-meal code; sets time and power.

ideas.rationale: Ready-meal eaters never read instructions again.

ideas.title: Toe-kick door opener

new_nodes.label: Foot-operated latch release
new_nodes.detail: Pedal at base opens door for hands-full users.

ideas.rationale: Opening with a foot is discoverable and hands-free.

ideas.title: Metallised polymer cavity

new_nodes.label: Vacuum-metallised PPS cavity molding
new_nodes.detail: Lightweight one-shot cavity with conductive coating.

ideas.rationale: Lighter, cheaper oven for students; fewer seams to confuse cleaning.

ideas.title: Metal-detect refusal replaces the 'no metal' rule

new_nodes.label: Floor eddy-current metal sensor
new_nodes.detail: Oven simply won't start with metal inside.

ideas.rationale: Substitutes a user rule with a machine rule.

ideas.title: Thermal-feedback 'warm/hot' knob

new_nodes.label: Target-temperature knob
new_nodes.detail: Knob sets desired food temperature; power modulates to reach it.

ideas.rationale: People think in 'how hot', not in watts.

ideas.title: Lamp stays on as the done signal

new_nodes.label: Light-until-opened completion cue
new_nodes.detail: Cavity lamp remains lit after cycle until door opens; bell removed.

ideas.rationale: Silent, obvious, and needs no explanation.

ideas.title: Light-bar countdown replaces dial pointer

new_nodes.label: Shrinking LED time bar
new_nodes.detail: Bar length equals remaining time; no numbers.

ideas.rationale: Remaining time is read at a glance like a progress bar.

ideas.title: Hand-crank timer

new_nodes.label: Crank-wound escapement timer
new_nodes.detail: One crank turn equals one minute; unwinds visibly.

ideas.rationale: Physical effort maps directly to cooking time.

ideas.title: Tactile-notch blind dial

new_nodes.label: Detented knob with raised minute bumps
new_nodes.detail: Each click is 15 s; feelable without looking.

new_edges.from: Detented knob with raised minute bumps
Detented knob with raised minute bumps

ideas.rationale: Usable in dim dorm kitchens or by visually impaired users.

ideas.title: Gravity drop door

new_nodes.label: Lift-up counterweighted door
new_nodes.detail: Lift to open, let go to close; no latch, no button.

ideas.rationale: Letting go always leaves the oven in the safe closed state.

ideas.title: Defrost-only toggle

new_nodes.label: Snowflake toggle switch
new_nodes.detail: Only alternative to full power is a 30% defrost mode.

ideas.rationale: Covers the single real-world use of low power with one icon.

ideas.title: Cordless kettle-style docking base

new_nodes.label: Contact-ring docking base
new_nodes.detail: Oven lifts off a powered base; no plug handling.

ideas.rationale: Plugging-in disappears as a step for dorm movers.

ideas.title: Magnetic breakaway mains connector

new_nodes.label: Magnetic mains coupler
new_nodes.detail: Snaps onto the oven; detaches safely if pulled.

ideas.rationale: Connection is self-aligning and foolproof.

ideas.title: PTC self-limiting magnetron cooling

new_nodes.label: PTC thermistor current limiting
new_nodes.detail: Inherent resistance rise throttles power when hot; no snap disc.

ideas.rationale: Oven never abruptly trips, so users never puzzle over a dead unit.

ideas.title: Wax-motor overheat vent

new_nodes.label: Wax-actuator vent flap
new_nodes.detail: Thermal wax opens extra airflow before shutdown is needed.

ideas.rationale: Passive self-care removes a failure mode the user would have to understand.

ideas.title: Rocking-floor instead of turntable

new_nodes.label: Cam-rocked ceramic floor
new_nodes.detail: Floor tilts slowly to shift standing-wave pattern.

ideas.rationale: Square dishes fit; nothing to align.

ideas.title: Single dial for both time and power

new_nodes.label: Dual-cam combined dial
new_nodes.detail: Early rotation = defrost region, later rotation = full power minutes.

ideas.rationale: Two knobs collapse into one twist.

ideas.title: Cup-shaped cavity for the mug use-case

new_nodes.label: Mug-sized mini cavity with lid
new_nodes.detail: Tiny oven sized for one mug or bowl; fixed 90 s burst on lid close.

ideas.rationale: A product with one purpose needs no settings at all.

ideas.title: Self-locking door latch replaces monitor switch

new_nodes.label: Solenoid-locked door during RF
new_nodes.detail: Door physically cannot open while magnetron runs; interlock chain shrinks to one switch.

ideas.rationale: User can never do the wrong thing, so there is nothing to learn.

{
  "ideas": [
    {"title": "Single big dial replaces timer + power knobs","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Mechanical timer knob + power knob","detail": "Two legacy knobs the user must coordinate"},{"type": "Component","label": "One-dial heat-amount knob","detail": "Single knob scaled in 'cups of soup' / 'plates' that sets time and power jointly via a cam"},{"type": "Function","label": "Set heating with one gesture","detail": "User turns one thing and walks away"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "One-dial heat-amount knob","to": "Mechanical timer knob + power knob","type": "resolves"},{"from": "One-dial heat-amount knob","to": "Set heating with one gesture","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Set heating with one gesture","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "Removes the two-variable mental model so nothing has to be learned."},
    {"title": "Weighing turntable replaces timer knob","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Mechanical clockwork timer","detail": "User guesses minutes"},{"type": "Component","label": "Spring-scale turntable","detail": "Food weight compresses a spring that mechanically winds the timer proportionally"},{"type": "Function","label": "Auto-set time by weight","detail": "Heavier food gets longer heating without any input"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "Spring-scale turntable","to": "Mechanical clockwork timer","type": "resolves"},{"from": "Spring-scale turntable","to": "Auto-set time by weight","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Auto-set time by weight","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "User never chooses a duration; put food in, press start."},
    {"title": "Steam-sensor cutoff replaces timer","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Clockwork timer bell","detail": "Fixed-duration stop"},{"type": "Component","label": "Humidity sensor stop","detail": "Cheap hygristor in exhaust cuts power when food steams"},{"type": "Function","label": "Stop when food is hot","detail": "Done means done, not minutes elapsed"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "Humidity sensor stop","to": "Clockwork timer bell","type": "resolves"},{"from": "Humidity sensor stop","to": "Stop when food is hot","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Stop when food is hot","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "Zero settings: the oven itself knows when to stop."},
    {"title": "IR thermometer replaces power knob","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "5-step duty-cycle power cam","detail": "Abstract power levels"},{"type": "Component","label": "IR food-temperature thermostat","detail": "Thermopile aimed at food, magnetron cycles until surface reaches eating temperature"},{"type": "Function","label": "Heat to eating temperature","detail": "Target outcome, not wattage"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "IR food-temperature thermostat","to": "5-step duty-cycle power cam","type": "resolves"},{"from": "IR food-temperature thermostat","to": "Heat to eating temperature","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Heat to eating temperature","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "Power levels disappear; the only concept is 'warm'."},
    {"title": "Single START button only","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Timer + power knobs","detail": "Legacy controls"},{"type": "Component","label": "One hard button","detail": "Press once = 1 min full power; press again adds a minute; hold = stop"},{"type": "Function","label": "Count presses as minutes","detail": "Vending-machine simplicity"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "One hard button","to": "Timer + power knobs","type": "resolves"},{"from": "One hard button","to": "Count presses as minutes","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Count presses as minutes","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "A single affordance cannot be misused."},
    {"title": "Door-close starts the oven","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Start action via knob twist","detail": "Separate start step"},{"type": "Component","label": "Door-latch start switch","detail": "Closing the door begins heating; opening stops it"},{"type": "Function","label": "Start by closing door","detail": "No start control at all"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "Door-latch start switch","to": "Start action via knob twist","type": "resolves"},{"from": "Door-latch start switch","to": "Start by closing door","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Start by closing door","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "The only act the user already knows how to do starts the process."},
    {"title": "Foot pedal replaces knobs","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Front-panel knobs","detail": "Hands-busy users struggle"},{"type": "Component","label": "Foot pedal timer","detail": "Press pedal with foot while holding plate; heating runs as long as pedal held or per stomp"},{"type": "Function","label": "Hands-free control","detail": "Like a bin lid"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "Foot pedal timer","to": "Front-panel knobs","type": "resolves"},{"from": "Foot pedal timer","to": "Hands-free control","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Hands-free control","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "Universally understood pedal gesture, no panel to read."},
    {"title": "Hourglass timer","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Clockwork dial timer","detail": "Numbers to read"},{"type": "Component","label": "Flip sand-glass timer","detail": "Flip the glass to start; a float switch stops heating when sand runs out"},{"type": "Function","label": "Visible analog countdown","detail": "Everyone understands sand running"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "Flip sand-glass timer","to": "Clockwork dial timer","type": "resolves"},{"from": "Flip sand-glass timer","to": "Visible analog countdown","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Visible analog countdown","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "Pre-literate, pre-numeric time setting."},
    {"title": "Pull-cord timer","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Rotary timer knob","detail": "Requires grip and reading"},{"type": "Component","label": "Pull-string wind-up","detail": "Pull cord like a toy; the further pulled, the longer it runs, retracting as it counts"},{"type": "Function","label": "Length-as-time setting","detail": "Direct physical mapping"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "Pull-string wind-up","to": "Rotary timer knob","type": "resolves"},{"from": "Pull-string wind-up","to": "Length-as-time setting","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Length-as-time setting","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "Pulling harder = heating longer is intuitive to a toddler."},
    {"title": "Slider with food pictograms","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Numbered time knob","detail": "Minutes are abstract"},{"type": "Component","label": "Pictogram slider","detail": "Slider stops at icons: mug, plate, frozen box, popcorn; each is a fixed cam program"},{"type": "Function","label": "Select by picture","detail": "Language-free"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "Pictogram slider","to": "Numbered time knob","type": "resolves"},{"from": "Pictogram slider","to": "Select by picture","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Select by picture","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "Users match food to picture instead of computing time."},
    {"title": "Barcode-reading door","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Manual time/power entry","detail": "User reads package and transcribes"},{"type": "Component","label": "Barcode scanner in door frame","detail": "Pass the package past the door; oven looks up heating instructions"},{"type": "Function","label": "Auto-program from packaging","detail": "Package tells the oven"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "Barcode scanner in door frame","to": "Manual time/power entry","type": "resolves"},{"from": "Barcode scanner in door frame","to": "Auto-program from packaging","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Auto-program from packaging","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "Instructions are already on the box; the oven reads them so the user doesn't."},
    {"title": "RFID smart dishes","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Power/time controls","detail": "Set per use"},{"type": "Component","label": "RFID-tagged bowls and turntable reader","detail": "Each household dish carries a tag encoding its default program"},{"type": "Function","label": "Dish selects program","detail": "Soup bowl always does soup"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "RFID-tagged bowls and turntable reader","to": "Power/time controls","type": "resolves"},{"from": "RFID-tagged bowls and turntable reader","to": "Dish selects program","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Dish selects program","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "Choosing a bowl is the whole interface."},
    {"title": "Camera food recognition","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Human setting choice","detail": "Guesswork"},{"type": "Component","label": "Cavity camera + food classifier","detail": "Tiny camera identifies pizza/soup/frozen and picks program"},{"type": "Function","label": "Recognize food and heat","detail": "No input"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "Cavity camera + food classifier","to": "Human setting choice","type": "resolves"},{"from": "Cavity camera + food classifier","to": "Recognize food and heat","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Recognize food and heat","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "The oven does the thinking the user used to do."},
    {"title": "Voice command replaces panel","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Knobs and buttons","detail": "Must be found and interpreted"},{"type": "Component","label": "Offline voice module","detail": "Say 'warm my coffee'; cheap keyword chip, no cloud"},{"type": "Function","label": "Speak the goal","detail": "Natural language"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "Offline voice module","to": "Knobs and buttons","type": "resolves"},{"from": "Offline voice module","to": "Speak the goal","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Speak the goal","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "Talking needs no instruction manual."},
    {"title": "Thermochromic bell replacement","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Mechanical end bell","detail": "Audible only, missed when away"},{"type": "Component","label": "Thermochromic turntable","detail": "Glass changes colour when food above it is hot; readout is the food itself"},{"type": "Function","label": "Show doneness by colour","detail": "Glance tells state"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "Thermochromic turntable","to": "Mechanical end bell","type": "resolves"},{"from": "Thermochromic turntable","to": "Show doneness by colour","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Show doneness by colour","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "Red means hot, universally understood, no clock reading."},
    {"title": "Door pops open at end","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Bell + push-release button","detail": "Two things to notice and operate"},{"type": "Component","label": "Spring auto-open latch","detail": "Timer release lets the door swing ajar like a toaster pop"},{"type": "Function","label": "Signal and release in one","detail": "Open door = done"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "Spring auto-open latch","to": "Bell + push-release button","type": "resolves"},{"from": "Spring auto-open latch","to": "Signal and release in one","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Signal and release in one","type": "addresses_need","to": "M6"}],"rationale": "Toaster logic: nothing to press, the oven hands the food back."},
    {"title": "Drawer replaces hinged door","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Hinged door + release button","detail": "Button hunting"},{"type": "Component","label": "Pull-out drawer cavity","detail": "Food sits on a drawer; push shut to start, pull to stop"},{"type": "Function","label": "Load like a drawer","detail": "Familiar kitchen gesture"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "Pull-out drawer cavity","to": "Hinged door + release button","type": "resolves"},{"from": "Pull-out drawer cavity","to": "Load like a drawer","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Load like a drawer","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "Drawers need no instructions."},

    {"title": "Transparent casing, no lamp","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Interior incandescent lamp + mesh window","detail": "Dim, bulb fails"},{"type": "Component","label": "ITO-coated glass cavity","detail": "Fully transparent conductive glass shields RF while ambient light shows food"},{"type": "Function","label": "See food directly","detail": "No window, no bulb"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "ITO-coated glass cavity","to": "Interior incandescent lamp + mesh window","type": "resolves"},{"from": "ITO-coated glass cavity","to": "See food directly","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "See food directly","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "Checking progress needs no learned window-peering."},

    {"title": "Mode stirrer replaces turntable","anchors": ["M6"],"new_nodes": [{"type": "Component","label": "Glass turntable + roller ring","detail": "Must be seated correctly, breaks"},{"type": "Component","label": "Fan-blade mode stirrer","detail": "Rotating metal blades in roof spread the field; flat fixed floor"},{"type": "Function","label": "Even field with flat floor","detail": "Nothing to align"}],"new_edges": [{"from": "Fan-blade mode stirrer","to": "Glass turntable + roller ring","type": "resolves"},{"from": "Fan-blade mode stirrer","to": "Even field with flat floor","type": "performs_function"},{"from": "Even field with flat floor","to": "M6","type": "addresses_need"}],"rationale": "No turntable to misplace or jam."},
