ideas.title: Food-pictogram dial replaces power knob

new_nodes.label: Pictogram food dial
new_nodes.detail: Single knob with icons (mug, plate, frozen block, popcorn) that maps directly to a fixed power/time pair.

ideas.rationale: Users pick what they are heating rather than translating it into watts and minutes.

ideas.title: Weighing turntable replaces timer knob

new_nodes.label: Load-cell turntable hub
new_nodes.detail: Turntable spindle sits on a strain gauge; mass sets cooking time automatically.

new_nodes.label: Derives cook time from food mass
new_nodes.detail: Time = k × weight, no user input.

new_edges.to: Derives cook time from food mass

new_edges.from: Derives cook time from food mass

ideas.rationale: Nothing to set: put food in, close the door, it knows how long.

ideas.title: IR 'hot enough' sensor replaces the timer entirely

new_nodes.label: Non-contact IR food thermometer
new_nodes.detail: Thermopile in cavity ceiling stops the magnetron when the food surface reaches eating temperature.

new_nodes.label: Cooks to temperature not time
new_nodes.detail: Single 'Heat' button, auto-stop.

ideas.rationale: Replaces a guessing-game knob with one button that always yields hot food.

ideas.title: Magnetic soft-close door replaces push-button latch

new_nodes.label: Magnetic door retention
new_nodes.detail: Rare-earth magnets hold the door; pull anywhere on its edge to open, no button, no hooks.

ideas.rationale: Opens like a fridge, which every user already knows how to use.

ideas.title: Hall-effect door sensors replace interlock microswitches

new_nodes.label: Redundant Hall-effect door sensors
new_nodes.detail: Solid-state magnet sensors with cross-check logic; no mechanical wear, door closes with any gentle push.

ideas.rationale: No 'slam it harder' learning curve because closure detection no longer depends on switch travel.

ideas.title: Mode stirrer replaces turntable and its motor

new_nodes.label: Fan-driven waveguide mode stirrer
new_nodes.detail: Rotating metal paddle in the waveguide spreads energy; cavity has a flat ceramic floor.

ideas.rationale: Removes the misaligned-plate / off-the-roller failure that confuses first-time users.

ideas.title: Three-detent 'Defrost / Reheat / Cook' knob replaces 5-step cam

new_nodes.label: Three-position power selector
new_nodes.detail: Cam with only three heavy detents and plain words, no percentages.

ideas.rationale: Fewer, named choices eliminate decision paralysis.

ideas.title: Speech chip replaces the mechanical bell

new_nodes.label: Voice announcement module
new_nodes.detail: Says 'Your food is ready – careful, it is hot' instead of ringing.

ideas.rationale: Plain-language feedback needs no interpretation of beeps.

ideas.title: Door handle twist sets time

new_nodes.label: Rotary door handle timer
new_nodes.detail: The grab handle is the clockwork timer; twist it as you close the door.

ideas.rationale: Closing and setting become one gesture on one part.

ideas.title: Docking plate replaces power cord

new_nodes.label: Contact docking base
new_nodes.detail: Oven sits on a powered base plate with spring contacts; no cord to route or plug.

ideas.rationale: Set-up is 'put it down', with no cable management.

ideas.title: Glass-ceramic waveguide window replaces mica

new_nodes.label: Wipe-clean glass-ceramic RF window
new_nodes.detail: Non-porous ceramic that never delaminates or scorches, so no replacement instructions exist.

ideas.rationale: Removes a maintenance task the user would otherwise have to learn.

ideas.title: Silicone mat replaces glass turntable

new_nodes.label: Flexible silicone cavity mat
new_nodes.detail: Unbreakable, dishwasher-safe, drops in any orientation.

ideas.rationale: No fragile plate to break or re-seat on a roller ring.

ideas.title: Inverter supply replaces duty-cycle cam

new_nodes.label: Inverter magnetron drive
new_nodes.detail: Continuous true power control; 'low' means gentle, not on-off pulsing.

ideas.rationale: The knob behaves like a stove flame, matching users' existing mental model.

ideas.title: Tap-to-add button replaces timer dial

new_nodes.label: Single +30 s tap button
new_nodes.detail: Each tap adds 30 seconds and starts immediately.

ideas.rationale: Counting taps is simpler than reading a dial scale.

ideas.title: Single push-twist knob replaces both knobs

new_nodes.label: Combined push-depth / twist control
new_nodes.detail: Twist sets minutes, push depth sets power (shallow = defrost, deep = full).

ideas.rationale: One control, one hand, no sequence to remember.

ideas.title: Food probe replaces timer

new_nodes.label: Shielded cavity temperature probe
new_nodes.detail: Stick into food, dial a target temperature; magnetron stops at target.

ideas.rationale: 'How hot' is a more intuitive question than 'how many minutes at what percent'.

ideas.title: Humidity sensor auto-stop replaces timer

new_nodes.label: Exhaust steam sensor
new_nodes.detail: Detects steam burst from food and ends the cycle a set delay later.

ideas.rationale: Reheating becomes a single 'go' with no numeric input.

ideas.title: Solid-state GaN RF source replaces HV chain

new_nodes.label: Low-voltage solid-state RF generator
new_nodes.detail: Transistor amplifier at ~50 V replaces magnetron, transformer, diode and HV capacitor.

ideas.rationale: Accurate, instant power lets controls say exactly what they do, with no warm-up quirks to learn.

ideas.title: PTC thermistor replaces bimetal thermostat

new_nodes.label: Self-resetting PTC overheat limiter
new_nodes.detail: Resistive element throttles current when hot; no manual reset button.

ideas.rationale: Users never meet a 'why did it stop working' reset procedure.

ideas.title: Transparent conductive film replaces perforated door screen

new_nodes.label: ITO-coated glass RF shield
new_nodes.detail: Optically clear conductive coating blocks microwaves without a mesh.

ideas.rationale: Users see boil-over coming without peering through a dark grid.

ideas.title: Edge-lit LED ceiling replaces incandescent lamp

new_nodes.label: LED edge-lit cavity ceiling panel
new_nodes.detail: Even, cool light that also flashes to signal 'done'.

ideas.rationale: Bright view and visual status in one part, no bulb to change.

ideas.title: Absorbing ferrite gasket replaces quarter-wave choke

new_nodes.label: Ferrite-loaded elastomer door gasket
new_nodes.detail: Absorbs leakage so door alignment tolerances are relaxed.

ideas.rationale: Door seals with any casual push, removing the 'is it really closed?' doubt.

ideas.title: Foot pedal replaces door button

new_nodes.label: Toe-kick door release pedal
new_nodes.detail: Kick plate under the oven pops the door while hands hold the dish.

ideas.rationale: Hands-full operation is the real-world default; no juggling needed.

ideas.title: Voice command replaces knobs

new_nodes.label: Offline keyword voice controller
new_nodes.detail: 'Two minutes', 'defrost', 'stop' – local recognition, no app.

ideas.rationale: Speaking the intent is the lowest possible learning curve.

ideas.title: NFC packaging reader replaces controls

new_nodes.label: Door-frame NFC reader
new_nodes.detail: Reads cooking instructions encoded on ready-meal tags and runs them.

ideas.rationale: Tap the box, press go – the package knows better than the user.

ideas.title: Camera food recognition replaces knobs and window

new_nodes.label: Cavity camera with food classifier
new_nodes.detail: Identifies dish type and volume, sets program, streams view to front display.

ideas.rationale: Zero settings: the oven looks at the food and decides.

ideas.title: Toaster-style pop-open door replaces bell

new_nodes.label: Timer-released door spring
new_nodes.detail: At zero the clockwork trips the latch; door swings ajar as the 'done' signal.

ideas.rationale: Done-state is unmistakable and food is already accessible.

ideas.title: Door hinge as the only interlock switch

new_nodes.label: Conductive hinge-pin contact
new_nodes.detail: The hinge itself completes the control circuit only at full-closed angle.

ideas.rationale: Fewer hidden parts to misalign means the door 'just works'.

ideas.title: Three preset buttons replace 0-30 min dial

new_nodes.label: Three fixed-duration mechanical buttons
new_nodes.detail: 1 min / 3 min / 6 min spring buttons, each a separate clockwork.

ideas.rationale: No scale to read; pick short, medium or long.

ideas.title: Slot-in recipe cards replace knobs

new_nodes.label: Punched recipe card reader
new_nodes.detail: Physical card with notches sets time and power when inserted; cards ship with the oven.

ideas.rationale: Tangible, labelled cards replace abstract settings.

ideas.title: Embossed tactile shapes replace printed scales

new_nodes.label: Tactile-shape control fascia
new_nodes.detail: Raised cup, plate and snowflake shapes locatable by touch.

ideas.rationale: Usable without reading, glasses or good lighting.

ideas.title: Light-ring touch dial replaces clockwork timer

new_nodes.label: Capacitive LED ring timer
new_nodes.detail: Swipe around a ring of lights; lit arc shows remaining time, precise to the second.

ideas.rationale: Time is shown as a shrinking arc, which needs no numeracy.

ideas.title: Hand crank replaces timer knob

new_nodes.label: Wind-up crank timer
new_nodes.detail: One full crank turn equals one minute; stored spring energy also drives the turntable.

ideas.rationale: Counting cranks is physical and obvious; also removes a motor.

ideas.title: Pull-out drawer replaces turntable and swing door

new_nodes.label: Sliding cavity drawer
new_nodes.detail: Food tray slides out toward the user like a kitchen drawer; closing starts cooking.

ideas.rationale: Loading, closing and starting collapse into one familiar push.

ideas.title: Drop-down oven door replaces side-hinged door

new_nodes.label: Bottom-hinged shelf door
new_nodes.detail: Door folds down to form a landing shelf for hot dishes.

ideas.rationale: Mirrors a conventional oven so users transfer existing habits.

ideas.title: Colour-wedge timer scale replaces minute numbers

new_nodes.label: Colour-zoned timer bezel
new_nodes.detail: Dial face divided into blue (drink), green (plate), red (frozen) zones instead of minutes.

ideas.rationale: Turn to the colour that matches your food; no arithmetic.

ideas.title: Neon charge indicator replaces hidden bleed resistor

new_nodes.label: Visible HV discharge neon lamp
new_nodes.detail: Lamp across the capacitor glows until the charge is safely bled off.

ideas.rationale: Safety state is self-explanatory: light on means wait.

ideas.title: Colour-changing handle replaces bell

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic illuminated handle
new_nodes.detail: Glows amber while cooking, green when done, red if contents are very hot.

ideas.rationale: Status is read at a glance from across the room, silently.

ideas.title: Hand-wave sensor replaces door button

new_nodes.label: IR proximity door opener
new_nodes.detail: Wave a hand in front of the door and a solenoid releases the latch.

ideas.rationale: No button to find or force; gesture is self-evident.

ideas.title: Optical beam interlock replaces monitor switch

new_nodes.label: Through-beam optical door sensor
new_nodes.detail: Door tab breaks an IR beam; non-contact so closing force is irrelevant.

ideas.rationale: Door closes softly and reliably every time, no slamming technique required.

ideas.title: Metallised polymer cavity replaces steel box

new_nodes.label: Vacuum-metallised moulded cavity
new_nodes.detail: Lightweight plastic shell with aluminium coating forms the RF enclosure.

ideas.rationale: A few-kilogram oven can be carried and placed anywhere by a student with no installation.

ideas.title: Hand-rotated turntable sets the timer

new_nodes.label: Turntable-as-timer spindle
new_nodes.detail: Rotate the plate by hand to wind the clockwork; it unwinds while rotating the food.

ideas.rationale: The thing you already touch when loading food is the only control.

ideas.title: Phone buzz replaces bell

new_nodes.label: Bluetooth done-notifier
new_nodes.detail: Sends a single 'ready' notification; no app set-up beyond pairing.

ideas.rationale: Alert reaches the user wherever they are without any ongoing interaction.

ideas.title: Mug cradle replaces time/power settings for drinks

new_nodes.label: Dedicated mug cradle with switch
new_nodes.detail: Placing a mug in the cradle triggers a fixed gentle-heat beverage cycle with stir pause.

ideas.rationale: The most common task needs zero settings and avoids superheating.

ideas.title: Pull-cord timer replaces knob

new_nodes.label: Retracting pull-cord clockwork
new_nodes.detail: Pull the cord out to a length marked with food icons; release to start.

ideas.rationale: Length is a more intuitive quantity than dial angle.

ideas.title: One-button 'Reheat' oven

new_nodes.label: Single-program reheat button
new_nodes.detail: Only control: a big button running a sensor-terminated reheat cycle.

ideas.rationale: A product with one button cannot be operated wrongly.

ideas.title: Airflow-spun floor replaces turntable motor

new_nodes.label: Fan-exhaust driven turbine platter
new_nodes.detail: Magnetron cooling air turns a vaned platter; no separate motor.

ideas.rationale: Fewer parts to fail means fewer error states the user must understand.

ideas.title: Sliding door replaces hinged door and latch

new_nodes.label: Side-sliding RF door
new_nodes.detail: Door slides on rails into the housing; no swing clearance or button.

ideas.rationale: Works in tight dorm spaces with an obvious slide gesture.

ideas.title: Metal-detect coil replaces warning labels

new_nodes.label: Cavity metal-detection coil
new_nodes.detail: Inductive sensor refuses to start and lights an icon when metal is inside.

ideas.rationale: Users need not learn the no-metal rule; the oven enforces it.

ideas.title: Fully transparent cavity shell replaces lamp and window

new_nodes.label: Transparent conductive-mesh glass enclosure
new_nodes.detail: Whole cavity made of laminated glass with embedded fine mesh; ambient light suffices.

ideas.rationale: Everything is visible from any angle so mistakes are caught without instruction.

ideas.title: Steam-sensor auto-stop replaces timer

new_nodes.label: Exhaust humidity sensor
new_nodes.detail: Detects steam burst from food and ends heating automatically.

new_nodes.label: Heats until food is done without user timing
new_nodes.detail: No minutes to set.

new_edges.to: Heats until food is done without user timing

new_edges.from: Heats until food is done without user timing

ideas.rationale: User presses one button and the oven decides when to stop, removing the timer entirely.

ideas.title: Weighing turntable sets time and power

new_nodes.label: Load-cell turntable hub
new_nodes.detail: Weighs the dish and derives duration and power automatically.

ideas.rationale: Weight replaces two knobs with zero decisions.

ideas.title: Mode stirrer replaces turntable

new_nodes.label: Rotating metal stirrer fan in waveguide
new_nodes.detail: Spreads RF pattern so food heats evenly on a fixed flat floor.

new_edges.from: Rotating metal stirrer fan in waveguide

ideas.rationale: No plate to misplace, break or trip on; just put food anywhere.

ideas.title: Solid-state frequency-sweep RF replaces turntable motor

new_nodes.label: LDMOS solid-state microwave generator
new_nodes.detail: Low-voltage transistor RF source sweeps frequency for uniform heating.

ideas.rationale: No moving parts and no lethal HV, food just heats evenly wherever placed.

ideas.title: Magnetic door catch replaces push-button latch

new_nodes.label: Magnetic door catch
new_nodes.detail: Fridge-style magnet strip holds door; user just pulls handle.

ideas.rationale: Opening works like every fridge the user already knows.

ideas.title: Hall-effect door sensors replace microswitches

new_nodes.label: Redundant Hall-effect magnetic sensing
new_nodes.detail: Contactless sensors detect door magnet; no wear, no misalignment.

ideas.rationale: Door never 'fails to register', avoiding confusing non-starts.

ideas.title: Optical light-curtain interlock

new_nodes.label: Infrared beam-break door sensor
new_nodes.detail: IR beam across door frame interrupted only when door fully shut.

ideas.rationale: Removes the 'slam it harder' learning step of stiff microswitches.

ideas.title: Low-voltage inverter replaces HV doubler

new_nodes.label: Resonant switch-mode inverter supply
new_nodes.detail: Generates magnetron voltage without a large storage capacitor.

ideas.rationale: Continuous power means settings behave intuitively instead of pulsing.

ideas.title: PTC thermistor replaces bimetal thermostat

new_nodes.label: Self-resetting PTC thermal limiter
new_nodes.detail: Resistance spikes with heat, throttling the magnetron without snapping contacts.

ideas.rationale: Invisible protection that never leaves the user wondering why it stopped.

ideas.title: Single 'add 30 s' button replaces timer dial

new_nodes.label: One large +30 s start button
new_nodes.detail: Each press adds 30 s and starts immediately; nothing else.

ideas.rationale: One button, one rule; counting presses is the whole interface.

ideas.title: Food-icon dial replaces minutes

new_nodes.label: Pictogram selector dial
new_nodes.detail: Positions show mug, plate, soup, popcorn; each maps to preset time and power.

ideas.rationale: User chooses what they have, not how long to cook it.

ideas.title: NFC package reader replaces controls

new_nodes.label: NFC food-package tag reading
new_nodes.detail: Antenna under cavity floor reads cooking programme from packaging tag.

ideas.rationale: Zero settings: the meal tells the oven what to do.

ideas.title: Delete the power knob: fixed full power

new_nodes.label: Single fixed-power design (timer only)
new_nodes.detail: Power knob and duty-cycle cam removed; only duration remains.

ideas.rationale: One knob fewer means one concept fewer to learn.

ideas.title: Inductive power pad replaces mains cord

new_nodes.label: High-power inductive countertop coupling
new_nodes.detail: Oven sits on a flush counter coil; no cord, no plug.

ideas.rationale: Place it and it works; no cable routing or sockets.

ideas.title: Auto-opening door replaces end bell

new_nodes.label: Spring door pop-open at timer end
new_nodes.detail: Timer trips the latch so the door swings open as the done signal.

new_edges.from: Spring door pop-open at timer end
Spring door pop-open at timer end

ideas.rationale: The open door is an unmistakable, language-free 'ready'.

ideas.title: Glass-ceramic waveguide window replaces mica

new_nodes.label: Glass-ceramic (LAS) waveguide cover
new_nodes.detail: Wipe-clean non-absorbent cover that cannot char or arc.

ideas.rationale: No maintenance knowledge needed about replacing scorched mica.

ideas.title: Silicone mat replaces glass turntable

new_nodes.label: Flexible silicone cavity mat
new_nodes.detail: Unbreakable, non-slip, dishwasher-safe floor in place of glass plate and roller ring.

ideas.rationale: Nothing to seat correctly or shatter; cleaning is intuitive.

ideas.title: Conductive elastomer gasket replaces choke seal

new_nodes.label: Conductive silicone RF gasket
new_nodes.detail: Compressible metallised rubber seals RF regardless of door alignment.

ideas.rationale: Door seals even when closed casually, removing precision-closing habits.

ideas.title: Pull-out drawer replaces hinged door

new_nodes.label: Drawer-style cavity
new_nodes.detail: Whole floor slides out like a kitchen drawer; pushing it in closes the interlock.

ideas.rationale: Loading a drawer is a universally understood gesture.

ideas.title: IR food thermometer replaces timer

new_nodes.label: Infrared surface thermometer
new_nodes.detail: Stops heating when food reaches target temperature chosen on a 'warm/hot/boil' dial.

new_nodes.label: Heats to a target temperature
new_nodes.detail: Outcome-based control.

ideas.rationale: Users think in 'hot enough', not minutes.

ideas.title: Continuous inverter power replaces duty-cycle cam

new_nodes.label: Variable-amplitude inverter power control
new_nodes.detail: True 10-100% output instead of on/off pulsing.

ideas.rationale: Power knob behaves like a stove dial, matching existing mental models.

ideas.title: Tap-the-top to start one minute

new_nodes.label: Piezo tap sensor in casing
new_nodes.detail: Each tap on the lid adds one minute and starts heating.

ideas.rationale: No panel at all; the oven itself is the button.

ideas.title: Foot pedal start

new_nodes.label: Hold-to-heat foot pedal
new_nodes.detail: Heats only while pedal is pressed; release stops.

ideas.rationale: Direct hands-free control with no timing concept to learn.

ideas.title: Plain-word slider replaces power percentages

new_nodes.label: Linear slider labelled defrost / warm / reheat / boil
new_nodes.detail: Words replace wattage or percentage steps.

new_edges.from: Linear slider labelled defrost / warm / reheat / boil
Linear slider labelled defrost / warm / reheat / boil

ideas.rationale: Intent-named positions need no manual.

ideas.title: Camera doneness vision replaces timer

new_nodes.label: Embedded camera with on-device doneness model
new_nodes.detail: Watches bubbling, steam and colour to stop heating.

new_edges.from: Embedded camera with on-device doneness model
Embedded camera with on-device doneness model

ideas.rationale: Single 'go' button; the oven watches so the user needn't.

ideas.title: Vibrating floor replaces rotating turntable

new_nodes.label: Piezo-vibrated cavity floor
new_nodes.detail: Micro-vibrations shuffle food slightly for even heating without rotation.

ideas.rationale: Rectangular dishes fit anywhere; no 'will it spin' guesswork.

ideas.title: LED array replaces incandescent lamp

new_nodes.label: Cool-white LED interior strip
new_nodes.detail: Low-power lamp also colour-shifts to show heating / done state.

ideas.rationale: Status shown by light colour, no display to read.

ideas.title: Door itself is the power contactor

new_nodes.label: Door-hinge contact as mains interrupter
new_nodes.detail: Closing the door physically bridges the magnetron primary circuit.

ideas.rationale: Closed door equals on, open door equals off: the simplest possible rule.

ideas.title: Colour-glow finish indicator replaces bell

new_nodes.label: Edge-lit casing that glows green when done
new_nodes.detail: Silent visual completion signal visible across the room.

new_edges.from: Edge-lit casing that glows green when done
Edge-lit casing that glows green when done

ideas.rationale: Universal colour code, no beep patterns to decode.

ideas.title: Pull-cord winds the timer

new_nodes.label: Pull-cord clockwork winder
new_nodes.detail: Length of pull sets duration; let go to start.

ideas.rationale: Physical, playful, obvious: longer pull equals longer heat.

ideas.title: Shape-coded buttons: mug and plate

new_nodes.label: Two moulded buttons shaped as a mug and a plate
new_nodes.detail: Each triggers a fixed preset for drinks or meals.

new_edges.from: Two moulded buttons shaped as a mug and a plate
Two moulded buttons shaped as a mug and a plate

ideas.rationale: Match the button to the object in your hand.

ideas.title: Transparent conductive film replaces mesh window

new_nodes.label: ITO / silver-nanowire RF-shielding glass coating
new_nodes.detail: Clear door glass that blocks microwaves without perforated metal.

ideas.rationale: Clear view means users check food naturally instead of reading timers.

ideas.title: Auto-grounding relay replaces bleeder resistor

new_nodes.label: Normally-closed HV shorting relay
new_nodes.detail: Capacitor shorted to ground whenever mains is absent.

ideas.rationale: Safe by default so nothing about the device needs to be understood.

ideas.title: Metallised polymer shell replaces steel casing

new_nodes.label: Injection-moulded polymer with vacuum-metallised interior
new_nodes.detail: Lightweight one-piece body with integrated controls.

ideas.rationale: Light enough for a student to move and position without help.

ideas.title: Roller-shutter door replaces hinged door

new_nodes.label: Vertical metal roller shutter with RF gasket
new_nodes.detail: Shutter rolls up into the top; closes by pulling a tab down.

new_edges.from: Vertical metal roller shutter with RF gasket

ideas.rationale: No swing clearance, no latch button: pull down, done.

ideas.title: Rotating cavity replaces turntable

new_nodes.label: Whole-cavity slow rotation drum
new_nodes.detail: The sealed cavity rotates around the fixed waveguide.

ideas.rationale: Floor is flat and fixed from the user's view; nothing to align.

ideas.title: Thermal fuse replaces thermostat

new_nodes.label: One-shot thermal fuse
new_nodes.detail: Cheap fusible link cuts power permanently on overheat.

ideas.rationale: Cheaper protection with zero user interaction.

ideas.title: Frozen-or-not IR sensor replaces defrost setting

new_nodes.label: Start-temperature IR probe
new_nodes.detail: Detects frozen food and automatically selects defrost duty cycle.

ideas.rationale: Defrost happens without the user knowing the word.

ideas.title: Mug-only micro-microwave

new_nodes.label: Mug-sized cavity with single preset
new_nodes.detail: Cavity fits one mug; one button heats to drinking temperature.

ideas.rationale: Removing options removes learning; perfect for a dorm.

ideas.title: 0-5 minute large dial replaces 0-30 min timer

new_nodes.label: Short-range high-resolution timer dial
new_nodes.detail: Full rotation spans 5 minutes with 10 s marks.

ideas.rationale: Everyday reheats become precise with the same one-knob gesture.

ideas.title: Quartz synchronous timer replaces clockwork

new_nodes.label: Synchronous-motor timer with cam
new_nodes.detail: Mains-synchronised motor drives the dial back accurately.

ideas.rationale: Keeps the trusted knob but makes short times behave as expected.

ideas.title: Latchless soft-close door

new_nodes.label: Damped friction hinge door
new_nodes.detail: Door stays shut by hinge friction and gasket compression; no hooks or button.

ideas.rationale: Push to close, pull to open: no mechanism to discover.

ideas.title: USB-C PD low-power microwave

new_nodes.label: 240 W USB-C powered mini oven
new_nodes.detail: Runs from a laptop charger; longer but plug-anywhere heating.

ideas.rationale: Uses the one cable students already own.

ideas.title: Two-position power switch replaces 5-step knob

new_nodes.label: Defrost / Full toggle switch
new_nodes.detail: Only two states, clearly labelled.

ideas.rationale: Binary choice is instantly understood.

ideas.title: Capacitive door-closure sensing

new_nodes.label: Capacitive proximity door detection
new_nodes.detail: Electrode in frame senses door metal flush against it.

ideas.rationale: Door registers closed without force or clicks.

ideas.title: Heated ceramic crisp floor replaces glass plate

new_nodes.label: Ferrite-loaded ceramic crisping floor
new_nodes.detail: Absorbs microwaves to get hot and browns food bottoms.

ideas.rationale: Crisping happens automatically with no extra mode.

ideas.title: 48 V DC bus replaces HV transformer and diode

new_nodes.label: Low-voltage DC distribution to RF amplifiers
new_nodes.detail: Everything inside runs under 60 V; no HV section at all.

new_edges.from: Low-voltage DC distribution to RF amplifiers
Low-voltage DC distribution to RF amplifiers

ideas.rationale: Removes hidden hazards so the product can be as casual as a toaster.

ideas.title: Tactile detent knob replaces printed scale

new_nodes.label: Knob with raised bumps per minute and braille
new_nodes.detail: Settings felt, not read.

new_edges.from: Knob with raised bumps per minute and braille
Knob with raised bumps per minute and braille

ideas.rationale: Operable without looking or reading, in any language.

ideas.title: Air-turbine turntable driven by cooling fan

new_nodes.label: Fan-airflow-driven turntable hub
new_nodes.detail: Magnetron cooling air spins a small turbine coupled to the plate; no separate motor.

ideas.rationale: Cheaper and quieter with no change to how the user loads food.

ideas.title: Top-loading lid replaces front door

new_nodes.label: Hinged top lid with gravity RF seal
new_nodes.detail: Lid drops shut under its own weight and compresses the choke gasket.

new_edges.from: Hinged top lid with gravity RF seal
Hinged top lid with gravity RF seal

ideas.rationale: Lift lid, drop food in, close: the pot-and-lid gesture everyone knows.

new_nodes.label: Barcode/NFC scanner on door frame
new_nodes.detail: Reads ready-meal packaging and applies the printed instructions.

ideas.rationale: Students never read the instructions on the box; the oven reads them instead.

ideas.title: Voice-controlled heating

new_nodes.label: Offline voice command module
new_nodes.detail: 'Heat my soup' sets time and power.

ideas.rationale: Natural language is the zero-learning-curve interface.

ideas.title: Steam-sensor auto stop

new_nodes.label: Humidity sensor in exhaust vent
new_nodes.detail: Detects steam burst and ends heating.

ideas.rationale: Removes time setting entirely for most reheating tasks.

ideas.title: Food-type dial replaces power knob

new_nodes.label: Dial with soup/plate/frozen/butter icons
new_nodes.detail: Each position maps to an appropriate duty cycle.

ideas.rationale: Users think in foods, not watts.

ideas.title: Solid-state RF generator

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state microwave source
new_nodes.detail: Low-voltage transistors replace magnetron, transformer, diode and HV capacitor.

ideas.rationale: Even heating without turntable or power choices means the user just presses go.

ideas.title: Self-discharging capacitor module

new_nodes.label: Capacitor with integrated bleeder and discharge indicator LED
new_nodes.detail: Visibly shows when safe; no separate resistor.

new_edges.from: Capacitor with integrated bleeder and discharge indicator LED
Capacitor with integrated bleeder and discharge indicator LED

ideas.rationale: Safety is built in so no warnings need to be learned.

ideas.title: Glazed ceramic cavity, no mica cover

new_nodes.label: Enamelled ceramic waveguide window
new_nodes.detail: Permanent glazed port replaces replaceable mica sheet.

ideas.rationale: No fragile part to burn or replace, so nothing to understand about maintenance.

ideas.title: Dishwasher-safe silicone mat floor

new_nodes.label: Removable silicone cavity mat
new_nodes.detail: Replaces glass turntable with unbreakable wipeable mat on flat floor.

ideas.rationale: No plate to seat on a spindle; cleaning is obvious.

ideas.title: Transparent conductive door film

new_nodes.label: ITO/metal-mesh transparent RF shield
new_nodes.detail: Clear film replaces perforated metal screen.

ideas.rationale: A fully clear window lets users see progress without learning a display.

ideas.title: Roll-top shutter door

new_nodes.label: Bread-bin style roll-top with conductive slats
new_nodes.detail: Slides up and away; no swing clearance needed.

new_edges.from: Bread-bin style roll-top with conductive slats

ideas.rationale: Familiar bread-bin gesture, no button, no door in the way.

ideas.title: Foot-pedal door opener

new_nodes.label: Pedal-actuated door release
new_nodes.detail: Like a kitchen bin; frees the hands.

ideas.rationale: Borrowed from the pedal bin everyone already uses.

ideas.title: Proximity auto-open door

new_nodes.label: Capacitive hand-approach sensor
new_nodes.detail: Door opens when a hand with a dish approaches.

ideas.rationale: Zero-touch operation has no instructions to read.

ideas.title: Two-position gentle/normal rocker

new_nodes.label: Rocker switch: Gentle / Normal
new_nodes.detail: Replaces 5-step cam with two meaningful choices.

ideas.rationale: Two words instead of five percentages.

ideas.title: Food icons on timer dial

new_nodes.label: Timer bezel printed with foods at typical times
new_nodes.detail: Mug at 1:30, plate at 3:00, etc.

new_edges.from: Timer bezel printed with foods at typical times

ideas.rationale: Guidance is on the knob itself; nothing to memorise.

ideas.title: Sand-glass visual timer

new_nodes.label: Flip hourglass that trips the start switch
new_nodes.detail: Sand level shows remaining time; empty = off.

new_edges.from: Flip hourglass that trips the start switch
Flip hourglass that trips the start switch

ideas.rationale: The most universally understood timer there is.

ideas.title: Colour-strip countdown

new_nodes.label: Shrinking coloured bar replacing numbered dial
new_nodes.detail: Bar length is the time; no digits.

new_edges.from: Shrinking coloured bar replacing numbered dial

ideas.rationale: Remaining time read instantly from across the room.

new_nodes.label: One-shot thermal fuse plus PTC current limiter
new_nodes.detail: Fewer moving parts, fails safe.

One-shot thermal fuse plus PTC current limiter

ideas.title: Airflow-driven turntable

new_nodes.label: Turbine turntable spun by cooling-fan exhaust
new_nodes.detail: Removes the separate turntable motor.

new_edges.from: Turbine turntable spun by cooling-fan exhaust

ideas.rationale: Fewer parts, same even heating, nothing new to operate.

ideas.title: Battery-powered dorm microwave

new_nodes.label: Removable Li-ion pack (300 Wh)
new_nodes.detail: Replaces mains cord for a few heating sessions.

ideas.rationale: Works anywhere with no socket hunting or cable management.

ideas.title: Conductive gasket door seal

new_nodes.label: Compressible metal-mesh gasket
new_nodes.detail: Replaces precision quarter-wave choke rim.

ideas.rationale: Door seals even if slammed carelessly, forgiving of untrained use.

ideas.title: RF-absorbing curtain doorless oven

new_nodes.label: Hanging RF-absorbent ferrite-loaded curtain
new_nodes.detail: Walk-through access with no door or latch.

ideas.rationale: Nothing to open or close at all.

ideas.title: Microwave pot with lid

new_nodes.label: Pot-shaped cavity with lift-off lid containing the interlock
new_nodes.detail: Looks and works like a saucepan.

new_edges.from: Pot-shaped cavity with lift-off lid containing the interlock

ideas.rationale: Cooking metaphor everyone understands: lid on, heat; lid off, stop.

ideas.title: Hold-to-heat dead-man button

new_nodes.label: Momentary heat button
new_nodes.detail: Heats only while pressed, like a tap.

ideas.rationale: Direct cause-and-effect control with nothing to set.

ideas.title: Falling-weight clockwork timer

new_nodes.label: Visible weight-driven timer with chain
new_nodes.detail: Pull the chain to set; weight drops to zero.

ideas.rationale: Time left is visible as height, intuitive for anyone.

ideas.title: Scent-release done signal

new_nodes.label: Aroma puff cartridge triggered at end
new_nodes.detail: Pleasant smell replaces the bell.

new_edges.from: Aroma puff cartridge triggered at end

ideas.rationale: A non-intrusive cue understood without instruction.

ideas.title: Thermochromic door glass

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic laminate on door window
new_nodes.detail: Window tints red as food gets hot.

ideas.rationale: Colour tells users 'hot' with no display or lamp.

ideas.title: Thermal-image projection on door

new_nodes.label: Low-res thermal camera projecting heat map on door
new_nodes.detail: Shows cold spots so users stir only if needed.

new_edges.from: Low-res thermal camera projecting heat map on door

ideas.rationale: Visual truth replaces guesswork about doneness.

ideas.title: Tactile embossed controls

new_nodes.label: Embossed tactile icons and detents
new_nodes.detail: Controls readable by touch and sight.

ideas.rationale: Universal design widens who can operate it without help.

ideas.title: Mirror cavity using room light

new_nodes.label: Polished reflective cavity walls
new_nodes.detail: Room light through the window lights the food; no lamp.

ideas.rationale: Passive viewing with one fewer part to fail.

ideas.title: Door-as-switch start

new_nodes.label: Closing the door starts heating
new_nodes.detail: Interlock closure doubles as start command.

ideas.rationale: Eliminates the start step entirely.

ideas.title: Ultrasonic vibrating floor

new_nodes.label: Piezo-vibrated cavity floor
new_nodes.detail: Micro-shuffles food through the field without rotation.

ideas.rationale: No turntable to misplace, dish can be any size.

ideas.title: Integrated power module

new_nodes.label: Sealed potted HV power block
new_nodes.detail: Diode, capacitor and bleeder in one replaceable brick.

ideas.rationale: Simplifies service so the appliance stays trouble-free for novices.

ideas.title: Gentle chime plus door pop

new_nodes.label: Three-note chime with latch release
new_nodes.detail: Replaces harsh bell.

ideas.rationale: Two redundant, obvious done-cues.

ideas.title: Temperature probe instead of timer

new_nodes.label: Plug-in food probe with target-temp dial
new_nodes.detail: Set 'hot' not 'minutes'.

new_edges.from: Plug-in food probe with target-temp dial
Plug-in food probe with target-temp dial

ideas.rationale: Users specify the outcome they care about.

new_nodes.label: Mug-sized cavity with one preset button
new_nodes.detail: Fixed 90 s full power; nothing else.

new_edges.from: Mug-sized cavity with one preset button
Mug-sized cavity with one preset button

ideas.rationale: A one-function appliance has literally nothing to learn.

ideas.title: Nucleation-textured floor

new_nodes.label: Micro-textured ceramic floor plate
new_nodes.detail: Promotes safe boiling, replacing smooth glass turntable.

ideas.rationale: Removes a hidden hazard that otherwise requires user knowledge.

ideas.title: Toaster-style push-down start lever

new_nodes.label: Spring-loaded push-down lever timer
new_nodes.detail: Push lever down to start fixed reheating cycle; it pops up and stops RF when done, like a toaster.

new_nodes.label: Thermally-released latch with spring return
new_nodes.detail: Simple escapement/bimetal release holds the lever for a preset duration.

ideas.rationale: Everyone already knows how a toaster works, so a single push lever removes any dial reading or setting.

ideas.title: Single doneness slider replaces both knobs

new_nodes.label: One-axis 'cold→piping hot' slider
new_nodes.detail: A single slider sets a combined time/power profile; no separate power knob.

ideas.rationale: Two interacting controls collapse into one intuitive 'how hot' choice.

ideas.title: Food pictogram dial instead of minutes

new_nodes.label: Pictogram program dial (mug, soup, plate, snowflake)
new_nodes.detail: Each icon position maps to a fixed cam time and duty cycle.

new_edges.from: Pictogram program dial (mug, soup, plate, snowflake)
Pictogram program dial (mug, soup, plate, snowflake)
Pictogram program dial (mug, soup, plate, snowflake)

ideas.rationale: Users pick what they are heating rather than translating it into minutes and watts.

ideas.title: Purely mechanical weighing-pan timer

new_nodes.label: Spring-scale-to-cam linkage
new_nodes.detail: Food weight compresses a spring under the tray; the deflection mechanically presets the timer cam.

new_nodes.label: Weight-set turntable support
new_nodes.detail: Roller ring on a calibrated spring pan that winds the timer proportional to load.

ideas.rationale: Placing the food sets the time, so the user never touches a timer.

ideas.title: Load-cell auto-time turntable

new_nodes.label: Strain-gauge turntable coupler
new_nodes.detail: Cheap load cell in the coupler weighs food and sets cook time automatically.

ideas.rationale: Weight substitutes for the user's time estimate, leaving just a start button.

ideas.title: Steam-sensor auto-stop replaces timer

new_nodes.label: Humidity sensor in exhaust vent
new_nodes.detail: Detects steam burst from food and ends the cycle shortly after.

new_nodes.label: Capacitive humidity sensing
new_nodes.detail: Low-cost polymer humidity sensor reads cavity exhaust moisture.

ideas.rationale: The food itself tells the oven when it is hot, so there is nothing to set.

ideas.title: Temperature dial instead of time dial

new_nodes.label: IR thermopile with 'warm/hot/boiling' knob
new_nodes.detail: User selects a target food temperature; a ceiling IR sensor stops RF when reached.

ideas.rationale: People think in 'how hot', not minutes, so the setting becomes self-explanatory.

ideas.title: Door closing starts cooking

new_nodes.label: Door-triggered fixed cycle
new_nodes.detail: Closing the door starts a 1-minute cycle; opening cancels; repeat for more.

ideas.rationale: The only action needed is the one users already perform: shutting the door.

ideas.title: Auto-popping door replaces bell

new_nodes.label: Timer-released spring door
new_nodes.detail: Timer cam trips the latch so the door swings ajar at end; lets steam out and signals done.

ideas.rationale: An open door is unmistakable feedback and removes the step of pressing a release button.

ideas.title: Magnetic fridge-style door, no button

new_nodes.label: Magnetic gasket pull-door
new_nodes.detail: Flexible magnetic strip holds door shut; user simply pulls the handle.

ideas.rationale: Pulling a handle is universal; no hunting for a release button.

ideas.title: Pull-out drawer cavity

new_nodes.label: Drawer-type cooking cavity
new_nodes.detail: Cavity slides out like a drawer on rails; closing it completes the choke seal and interlock.

ideas.rationale: Drawers need no instructions and avoid door/button confusion for children and the elderly.

ideas.title: Mode stirrer replaces turntable set

new_nodes.label: Rotating metal mode stirrer behind ceiling
new_nodes.detail: Fan-driven paddle scrambles the field; flat fixed cavity floor.

new_edges.from: Rotating metal mode stirrer behind ceiling
Rotating metal mode stirrer behind ceiling
Rotating metal mode stirrer behind ceiling
Rotating metal mode stirrer behind ceiling

ideas.rationale: No tray to seat, align or knock off its ring—just put the plate anywhere.

ideas.title: Rotating antenna under ceramic floor

new_nodes.label: Rotating feed antenna under flat ceramic base
new_nodes.detail: Waveguide feeds a slowly spinning antenna below a flat, fixed floor.

new_edges.from: Rotating feed antenna under flat ceramic base
Rotating feed antenna under flat ceramic base
Rotating feed antenna under flat ceramic base

ideas.rationale: A flat floor removes the 'did I put the tray back correctly?' failure mode.

ideas.title: Solid-state RC timer with 0-5 min scale

new_nodes.label: Analog RC timer with triac
new_nodes.detail: Potentiometer-set RC delay drives a triac; full dial sweep covers 0-5 min.

ideas.rationale: A wide, precise short-time scale matches real use so users hit the right time first try.

ideas.title: Wind-up spring egg-timer mechanism

new_nodes.label: Mainspring clockwork escapement
new_nodes.detail: Turning the knob winds a spring; no synchronous motor, frequency-independent.

ideas.rationale: Identical kitchen-egg-timer feel with tactile winding that users already understand.

ideas.title: Two-position cook/defrost switch

new_nodes.label: Rocker switch: Cook / Defrost
new_nodes.detail: Replaces 5-step cam with a two-state duty-cycle selector.

ideas.rationale: Five abstract power levels become one obvious binary choice.

ideas.title: Push-and-turn single knob

new_nodes.label: Combined rotary encoder knob
new_nodes.detail: Turn to set time; press-and-turn to toggle defrost; one control on fascia.

ideas.rationale: One physical object to learn instead of two.

ideas.title: Colour-zoned dial replaces numbers

new_nodes.label: Colour-band fascia (blue/green/orange/red)
new_nodes.detail: Dial scale printed as colour zones meaning drink/plate/meal/defrost instead of minutes.

ideas.rationale: Colour cues are read faster and more reliably than small numerals.

ideas.title: Tactile detents and braille scale

new_nodes.label: Detented knob with raised braille/pips
new_nodes.detail: Each 30 s is a felt click and a raised dot; numbers embossed.

ideas.rationale: Setting time by feel removes the need to read anything at all.

ideas.title: Audible click-per-30s knob

new_nodes.label: Ratchet knob with audible clicks
new_nodes.detail: Each click heard while turning equals 30 s; no label reading required.

ideas.rationale: Counting clicks is simpler than reading a dial for anyone, sighted or not.

ideas.title: Token-slot timer (one token = one minute)

new_nodes.label: Coin/token drop timer
new_nodes.detail: Reusable tokens dropped in a slot each add one minute; mechanically advances the cam.

ideas.rationale: Counting physical tokens is a concrete, zero-learning way to set time.

ideas.title: NFC packaging sets the program

new_nodes.label: NFC reader in fascia
new_nodes.detail: Tap ready-meal pack; its tag preloads time and power, start is automatic.

new_nodes.label: Passive NFC tag reading
new_nodes.detail: 13.56 MHz reader IC reads cook parameters from food packaging.

ideas.rationale: The packaging does the thinking so the user only taps and waits.

ideas.title: Camera food-recognition auto-cook

new_nodes.label: Ceiling camera with on-device classifier
new_nodes.detail: Recognises mug, plate, frozen block and picks time/power; doubles as viewing camera.

ideas.rationale: Zero settings: the oven sees what you put in and heats accordingly.

ideas.title: Offline voice chip replaces control panel

new_nodes.label: Keyword speech module
new_nodes.detail: Low-cost offline recogniser accepts 'two minutes', 'defrost', 'stop'.

ideas.rationale: Speaking a request needs no manual and no dexterity.

ideas.title: Foot pedal door opener

new_nodes.label: Pedal-cable door release
new_nodes.detail: Bin-style foot pedal pulls the latch lever via Bowden cable.

ideas.rationale: Opening with hands full of plates becomes effortless and obvious.

ideas.title: Roll-top tambour door

new_nodes.label: Metal-slat tambour shutter
new_nodes.detail: Shutter rolls up into the roof; overlapping conductive slats form the shield.

ideas.rationale: Push up / pull down is a single obvious gesture with no swing clearance.

ideas.title: Low-voltage LED replaces incandescent lamp

new_nodes.label: LED lamp fed from transformer filament tap
new_nodes.detail: 3 V LED strip on the cavity ceiling; lifetime exceeds the oven.

new_edges.from: LED lamp fed from transformer filament tap
LED lamp fed from transformer filament tap
LED lamp fed from transformer filament tap

ideas.rationale: A light that never fails keeps the 'look inside to check' habit reliable.

ideas.title: Light pipe brings in kitchen light

new_nodes.label: Acrylic light pipe from top panel
new_nodes.detail: Ambient room light guided into the cavity through RF-safe aperture; no lamp.

new_edges.from: Acrylic light pipe from top panel
Acrylic light pipe from top panel
Acrylic light pipe from top panel

ideas.rationale: Nothing to switch on or replace; the cavity is simply always visible.

ideas.title: Electroluminescent cavity ceiling

new_nodes.label: EL phosphor panel
new_nodes.detail: Thin EL sheet behind mica ceiling glows uniformly; no bulb socket.

ideas.rationale: Shadow-free view of the food makes 'is it done?' checks easier.

ideas.title: Light colour counts down remaining time

new_nodes.label: RGB cavity light tied to timer
new_nodes.detail: Light shifts blue→amber→green as the cycle progresses; green = done.

new_edges.from: RGB cavity light tied to timer
RGB cavity light tied to timer
RGB cavity light tied to timer
RGB cavity light tied to timer

ideas.rationale: Progress is visible at a glance across the room without reading a dial.

ideas.title: Fan-driven exhaust whistle replaces bell

new_nodes.label: Timer-flap exhaust whistle
new_nodes.detail: At end of cycle the cam opens a flap routing fan air through a kettle whistle.

ideas.rationale: The familiar kettle whistle is an instantly understood 'ready' cue.

ideas.title: Repeating piezo reminder replaces bell

new_nodes.label: Piezo buzzer with repeat-until-opened
new_nodes.detail: Chirps every 30 s until the door is opened; cheaper than striker and bell.

ideas.rationale: Users never need to remember or watch the clock; the oven nags for them.

ideas.title: Pop-up flag indicator

new_nodes.label: Spring pop-up 'READY' flag
new_nodes.detail: Cam releases a bright flag on top of the cabinet at cycle end; silent and visible.

ideas.rationale: A visible status flag needs no interpretation and works in noisy shared kitchens.

ideas.title: Thermochromic door window

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic film on door glass
new_nodes.detail: Inner glass tint changes colour as cavity air passes ~60 °C, showing food is hot.

ideas.rationale: The window itself says 'hot' so the user needs no timing skill.

ideas.title: Zoned cavity: position sets power

new_nodes.label: Two-zone cavity floor (mug ring / plate area)
new_nodes.detail: Field is shaped so the small mug ring gets gentle heating, plate area full power; no power knob.

new_edges.from: Two-zone cavity floor (mug ring / plate area)
Two-zone cavity floor (mug ring / plate area)
Two-zone cavity floor (mug ring / plate area)

ideas.rationale: Where you put the food replaces a power setting.

ideas.title: Dedicated mug microwave, one button

new_nodes.label: Mug-sized cavity with single Go button
new_nodes.detail: ~1.5 L cavity, fixed 90 s / 500 W cycle tuned for a drink; no turntable.

new_edges.from: Mug-sized cavity with single Go button
Mug-sized cavity with single Go button
Mug-sized cavity with single Go button
Mug-sized cavity with single Go button

ideas.rationale: One product, one job, one button—nothing to learn.

ideas.title: Big single Go button, press again for more

new_nodes.label: Single large start button (+30 s per press)
new_nodes.detail: Each press adds 30 s to a solid-state counter; no knobs at all.

new_edges.from: Single large start button (+30 s per press)
Single large start button (+30 s per press)
Single large start button (+30 s per press)

ideas.rationale: A lone button cannot be misused and matches how most people already use microwaves.

ideas.title: Quantity dial marked in cups and plates

new_nodes.label: Portion-count dial (1 cup…3 plates)
new_nodes.detail: Scale shows portions instead of minutes; cam gearing maps portion to time.

ideas.rationale: Users know how much food they have, not how many minutes it needs.

ideas.title: Inverter supply replaces transformer, cap and diode

new_nodes.label: Switch-mode inverter HV supply
new_nodes.detail: Lightweight resonant inverter gives continuously variable true power.

ideas.rationale: Gentle, continuous power means defrost 'just works' without choosing cycle levels.

ideas.title: Solid-state GaN RF source

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state RF amplifier with reflected-power sensing
new_nodes.detail: Replaces magnetron and HV chain; reflected power indicates food state for auto-stop.

new_edges.from: GaN solid-state RF amplifier with reflected-power sensing
GaN solid-state RF amplifier with reflected-power sensing
GaN solid-state RF amplifier with reflected-power sensing
GaN solid-state RF amplifier with reflected-power sensing

ideas.rationale: Built-in sensing lets the oven stop itself, removing the need for any settings.

ideas.title: Hall-sensor door detection

new_nodes.label: Redundant Hall/reed door sensors
new_nodes.detail: Contactless magnets replace mechanical microswitches; no latch alignment fuss.

ideas.rationale: Door never needs to be 'slammed just right' to start, removing a hidden learning step.

ideas.title: Door handle doubles as timer lever

new_nodes.label: Handle-slide timer
new_nodes.detail: After closing, slide the door handle sideways; distance sets time and starts the cycle.

ideas.rationale: The hand is already on the handle, so closing and setting become one continuous motion.

ideas.title: Hourglass visual timer

new_nodes.label: Rotatable sand hourglass with optical end-sensor
new_nodes.detail: Flip the glass to start; sand level shows time left; photo-gate stops RF when empty.

new_edges.from: Rotatable sand hourglass with optical end-sensor
Rotatable sand hourglass with optical end-sensor
Rotatable sand hourglass with optical end-sensor

ideas.rationale: Remaining time is visible as a physical quantity anyone understands.

ideas.title: Three-button fascia: Drink / Meal / Defrost

new_nodes.label: Three preset membrane buttons
new_nodes.detail: Each button fires a fixed time/power program; nothing else on the panel.

ideas.rationale: Choosing one of three labelled buttons is the lowest possible cognitive load.

ideas.title: Weight-plus-IR closed-loop with no controls

new_nodes.label: Controller fusing load cell and IR sensor
new_nodes.detail: Weighs food, heats until surface reaches 70 °C, stops; fascia has only Start.

new_edges.from: Controller fusing load cell and IR sensor
Controller fusing load cell and IR sensor
Controller fusing load cell and IR sensor
Controller fusing load cell and IR sensor

ideas.rationale: Sensors replace all user judgment, leaving a single start action.

ideas.title: Cheap microwave stop/start by lid pressure

new_nodes.label: Press-to-run top lid
new_nodes.detail: Toaster-oven-style lid; RF runs only while a weighted lid is down, lid springs up at timer end.

ideas.rationale: Open means off, down means cooking—a state anyone can read at a glance.

ideas.title: Printed cook-chart lid replaces manual

new_nodes.label: Embossed quick-chart on top panel
new_nodes.detail: Durable pictorial chart (food → dial position) moulded into the cabinet top.

ideas.rationale: Guidance lives on the product itself so no manual is ever needed.

ideas.title: Self-centering silicone mat replaces glass tray

new_nodes.label: Keyed silicone turntable mat
new_nodes.detail: Flexible mat drops onto the coupler in any orientation; dishwasher-safe, unbreakable.

ideas.rationale: Removes the fiddly tray-and-ring reassembly that confuses users after cleaning.

ideas.title: Bimetal food-contact probe dial

new_nodes.label: Snap-disc probe on flexible lead
new_nodes.detail: User clips a bimetal probe into the food; the disc opens the RF circuit at eating temperature.

ideas.rationale: A purely mechanical probe ends cooking at the right moment with no settings.

ideas.title: Bluetooth-free beeper in a magnet fob

new_nodes.label: Detachable wireless beeper fob
new_nodes.detail: Low-power 433 MHz fob on the fridge-magnet style; chirps when the cycle ends.

ideas.rationale: No app or pairing: carry the fob and the oven simply finds you.

ideas.title: Transparent mesh-free door with embedded ITO shield

new_nodes.label: Transparent conductive (ITO) coated glass shielding
new_nodes.detail: Conductive transparent coating blocks 2.45 GHz without a perforated mesh.

ideas.rationale: A clear, unobstructed view lets users judge doneness by eye without guesswork.

ideas.title: Hourglass visual timer

new_nodes.detail: Timer cam drives a painted disc; red area shrinks to zero behind a window, no numbers.

new_nodes.detail: Heating runs until a steam burst signals the food is hot, then stops.

ideas.rationale: Replaces timing with a single 'heat until done' button, eliminating guesswork.

ideas.title: Roll-up door

new_nodes.label: Vertical tambour shutter of conductive slats
new_nodes.detail: Door rolls up into the top like a bread-bin lid.

new_edges.from: Vertical tambour shutter of conductive slats
Vertical tambour shutter of conductive slats

ideas.rationale: No swing clearance and a familiar bread-bin gesture.

ideas.title: Magnetic no-latch door

new_nodes.label: Magnet strip seal with reed interlock
new_nodes.detail: Fridge-style magnetic closure replaces hooks, lever and button.

new_edges.from: Magnet strip seal with reed interlock
Magnet strip seal with reed interlock

ideas.rationale: Opens like a fridge, the most familiar kitchen door.

ideas.title: Nudge-open soft door

new_nodes.label: Push-push latch with damped spring
new_nodes.detail: Press the door panel anywhere; it clicks open gently.

ideas.rationale: Whole door is the button; nothing to locate.

ideas.title: Carousel cavity

new_nodes.label: Rotating half-cylinder cavity
new_nodes.detail: Spin the drum to expose the shelf; metal drum wall doubles as door.

ideas.rationale: One rotation both opens and closes; no handles, hinges or buttons.

ideas.title: Top-loading chest

new_nodes.label: Lift-up lid cavity
new_nodes.detail: Like a slow-cooker; gravity keeps lid shut, lifting it stops cooking.

ideas.rationale: Pot-with-lid is the oldest kitchen idiom.

ideas.title: Clear conductive window

new_nodes.label: ITO/metal-mesh film laminated glass
new_nodes.detail: Optically clear shielding film replaces perforated steel.

new_nodes.label: Transparent conductive coatings
new_nodes.detail: Sputtered ITO or fine wire mesh.

ideas.rationale: Full visibility lets users judge doneness without any readout.

ideas.title: Hand-wave door

new_nodes.label: Proximity sensor + motorised door
new_nodes.detail: Wave in front of the oven; door opens, like an automatic shop door.

ideas.rationale: No button, handle or grip strength required.

ideas.title: Big-detent minute dial

new_nodes.label: Ratchet dial with 30-second clicks
new_nodes.detail: Coarse, audible detents replace continuous imprecise scale.

ideas.rationale: Counting clicks is easier than reading a fine scale.

ideas.title: Glowing time ring

new_nodes.label: LED arc around the dial
new_nodes.detail: Lit arc shrinks as timer runs; same cam, added ring.

ideas.rationale: Progress visible from across the room without a display.

ideas.title: Detachable egg timer

new_nodes.label: Removable spring egg-timer that docks as the knob
new_nodes.detail: Docked it runs the oven; undocked it is an ordinary kitchen timer.

new_edges.from: Removable spring egg-timer that docks as the knob

ideas.rationale: Uses an object people already know how to use.

ideas.title: Punch-card programs

new_nodes.label: Slot for mechanical program cards
new_nodes.detail: Notched card physically sets time and power cams, like a jukebox.

ideas.rationale: Insert the 'soup' card: tangible, no settings to remember.

ideas.title: Gravity clock timer

new_nodes.label: Weight-driven escapement timer
new_nodes.detail: Lift the knob to wind; descending weight runs the clock independent of mains frequency.

ideas.rationale: Lifting to wind is intuitive and works identically in every region.

ideas.title: Portions dial

new_nodes.label: Knob marked 1-4 plates
new_nodes.detail: Portion count sets both time and power via one cam.

ideas.rationale: People know how many portions they have; they don't know wattage.

ideas.title: One big start button

new_nodes.label: Single illuminated start/stop pad
new_nodes.detail: All timing by sensors; one button only.

ideas.rationale: The smallest possible interface: one button.

ideas.title: Close-to-start door

new_nodes.label: Door-latch-triggered start
new_nodes.detail: Closing the door starts a fixed cook; opening stops it.

ideas.rationale: Loading the oven is the only action required.

ideas.title: Hold-to-heat button

new_nodes.label: Dead-man heating button
new_nodes.detail: Magnetron runs only while the pad is pressed; release stops.

ideas.rationale: Like a kettle switch held down: direct, immediate, impossible to over-set.

ideas.title: Tactile raised dial

new_nodes.label: Knob with raised bumps and Braille minutes
new_nodes.detail: Same cam, tactile overlay for low-vision users.

new_edges.from: Knob with raised bumps and Braille minutes

new_edges.to: Knob with raised bumps and Braille minutes

ideas.rationale: Operable by feel without reading.

ideas.title: Thermochromic plate

new_nodes.label: Turntable with colour-change glaze
new_nodes.detail: Plate turns red at 60°C; user stops when colour appears.

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic ceramic pigments
new_nodes.detail: Reversible colour-shift glaze.

ideas.rationale: Doneness is shown as a colour, no timing judgement needed.

ideas.title: Mode stirrer replaces turntable

new_nodes.label: Rotating metal fan stirrer in waveguide
new_nodes.detail: Flat fixed floor; no glass plate to position or break.

new_edges.from: Rotating metal fan stirrer in waveguide
Rotating metal fan stirrer in waveguide

ideas.rationale: Removes the 'is the plate seated right?' failure mode.

ideas.title: Solid-state PWM power

new_nodes.label: Triac phase-controlled transformer
new_nodes.detail: Smooth power via triac replaces mechanical duty cam.

ideas.rationale: Enables one smooth, intuitive slider instead of five discrete steps.

ideas.title: Evaporation-stop

new_nodes.label: Weight-loss cutoff
new_nodes.detail: Load cell stops heating once a few grams of water have steamed off.

ideas.rationale: Physics decides when it's hot; the user decides nothing.

ideas.title: Pull-string timer

new_nodes.label: Pull-cord retracting timer
new_nodes.detail: Pull the cord out; it retracts over minutes, like a talking-doll string.

ideas.rationale: Pull length maps to time in the most physical way possible.

ideas.title: Twist-handle timer

new_nodes.label: Door handle that twists to set minutes
new_nodes.detail: Handle doubles as timer knob; one hand, one gesture.

new_edges.from: Door handle that twists to set minutes
Door handle that twists to set minutes

ideas.rationale: Open, load, twist, close: controls live where the hand already is.

ideas.title: Camera door

new_nodes.label: Solid steel door with internal camera and front screen
new_nodes.detail: Live view replaces mesh window; screen also shows a big countdown.

new_edges.from: Solid steel door with internal camera and front screen
Solid steel door with internal camera and front screen

ideas.rationale: Brighter, larger view of the food than a dim mesh window.

ideas.title: Conductive curtain door

new_nodes.label: Metallised-fabric roller blind with choke rail
new_nodes.detail: Soft blind drops to seal; lift it to reach in.

new_nodes.label: Metallised textile RF shielding
new_nodes.detail: Silver-coated nylon fabric.

new_edges.from: Metallised-fabric roller blind with choke rail
Metallised-fabric roller blind with choke rail

ideas.rationale: A curtain you push aside needs zero explanation.

ideas.title: Doorless choke tunnel

new_nodes.label: Open cut-off waveguide access tunnel
new_nodes.detail: Long narrow metal entry tunnel attenuates 2.45 GHz below leakage limit; no door at all.

new_nodes.label: Below-cutoff waveguide attenuation
new_nodes.detail: Aperture smaller than half wavelength over sufficient length.

ideas.rationale: Nothing to open or close: just slide the dish in.

ideas.title: Joystick control

new_nodes.label: Single 2-axis lever
new_nodes.detail: Push forward for longer, sideways for stronger; both cams driven by one stick.

ideas.rationale: One gestural control instead of two scales to read.

ideas.title: Lift-to-stop plate

new_nodes.label: Turntable presence switch
new_nodes.detail: Heating only while a dish rests on the plate; lifting the dish ends the cook.

ideas.rationale: Taking the food out is the stop command.

ideas.title: Reflected-power auto level

new_nodes.label: Directional coupler sensing reflected RF
new_nodes.detail: Oven lowers power as food's absorption changes; no user power setting.

ideas.rationale: Power self-adjusts to the load so the user never sets it.

ideas.title: Living-hinge door

new_nodes.label: Polymer living hinge with metal choke insert
new_nodes.detail: One moulded flexure replaces stamped hinges and pins.

new_edges.from: Polymer living hinge with metal choke insert
Polymer living hinge with metal choke insert

ideas.rationale: Lighter, self-centring door that swings effortlessly for elderly users.

ideas.title: Audible tick countdown

new_nodes.label: Escapement tick that speeds up near zero
new_nodes.detail: Timer ticks louder and faster in the last 30 s; bell at end.

new_edges.from: Escapement tick that speeds up near zero

new_edges.to: Escapement tick that speeds up near zero

ideas.rationale: Remaining time is communicated by sound, no need to look or read.

{
  "ideas": [
    {"title":"Hourglass visual timer","anchors":["C13","F7"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Rotating coloured-disc countdown window","detail":"Timer cam drives a painted disc; red area shrinks to zero behind a window, no numbers."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Rotating coloured-disc countdown window","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Rotating coloured-disc countdown window","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"F7","to":"M6","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"Time remaining is read at a glance as a shrinking colour patch, so no numerals or clock-reading skill are needed."},
    {"title":"Weigh-and-go","anchors":["C13","X13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Load cell under turntable","detail":"Weight of dish sets cooking duration automatically; user only presses start."},{"type":"Technology","label":"Strain-gauge weighing","detail":"Low-cost load cell as used in kitchen scales."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Load cell under turntable","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Load cell under turntable","to":"X13","type":"partially_mitigates"},{"from":"Load cell under turntable","to":"Strain-gauge weighing","type":"enabled_by"}],"rationale":"The user never chooses a time; mass alone decides it."},
    {"title":"Steam-stop cooking","anchors":["C13","F7"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Humidity sensor in exhaust vent","detail":"Heating runs until a steam burst signals the food is hot, then stops."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Humidity sensor in exhaust vent","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Humidity sensor in exhaust vent","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Humidity sensor in exhaust vent","to":"X13","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Replaces timing with a single 'heat until done' button, eliminating guesswork."},
    {"title":"Infrared done-detector","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"IR thermopile aimed at food surface","detail":"Cooks until surface reaches ~70°C; no time or power knob."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"IR thermopile aimed at food surface","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"IR thermopile aimed at food surface","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"IR thermopile aimed at food surface","to":"X13","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Target temperature replaces both time and power decisions."},
    {"title":"Pictogram preset buttons","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Four large picture buttons (mug, plate, bowl, snowflake)","detail":"Each button hard-wires a fixed time/power cam combination."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Four large picture buttons (mug, plate, bowl, snowflake)","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Four large picture buttons (mug, plate, bowl, snowflake)","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"A4","to":"Four large picture buttons (mug, plate, bowl, snowflake)","type":"relevant_to"}],"rationale":"Choosing a picture of what you are heating needs no reading or numeracy."},
    {"title":"Picture slider","anchors":["C13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Linear slide lever with food icons","detail":"Slide the pointer to the icon; lever position sets cam timer."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Linear slide lever with food icons","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Linear slide lever with food icons","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"A single linear motion to an icon is more intuitive than rotating to minutes."},
    {"title":"Voice-only control","anchors":["C13","C14","C15"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Offline keyword microphone module","detail":"Says 'heat', 'defrost', 'stop', 'open'; no knobs or buttons at all."},{"type":"Technology","label":"Edge speech recognition","detail":"On-chip keyword spotting, no cloud."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Offline keyword microphone module","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Offline keyword microphone module","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Offline keyword microphone module","to":"Edge speech recognition","type":"enabled_by"}],"rationale":"Speaking is the most universal interface with zero learning curve."},
    {"title":"Package-scanning cook","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Barcode/OCR camera at door","detail":"Reads the heating instructions printed on the package and sets time/power itself."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Barcode/OCR camera at door","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Barcode/OCR camera at door","to":"C14","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Show the box to the oven and press start; no instructions to interpret."},
    {"title":"NFC meal tags","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"NFC reader in cavity floor","detail":"Tagged ready-meals program the oven on contact."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"NFC reader in cavity floor","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"NFC reader in cavity floor","to":"C14","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Placing food in the oven is the whole user interaction."},
    {"title":"Single doneness dial","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"One 'cold-to-hot' knob","detail":"Combined cam sets time and duty cycle together along one curve."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"One 'cold-to-hot' knob","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"One 'cold-to-hot' knob","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"One 'cold-to-hot' knob","to":"X12","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Two knobs become one, halving the decisions and the parts."},
    {"title":"No power knob at all","anchors":["C14","F8"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Fixed-power magnetron feed","detail":"Power knob deleted; defrost handled by lengthening time via timer scale."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Fixed-power magnetron feed","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Fixed-power magnetron feed","to":"X12","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Removing a control removes a decision and a mistake source."},
    {"title":"Inverter auto-power","anchors":["C14","X6"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Inverter power supply with automatic ramp","detail":"Continuous power follows a built-in gentle profile; no user setting."},{"type":"Technology","label":"Switch-mode inverter magnetron drive","detail":"Replaces duty-cycle cam."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Inverter power supply with automatic ramp","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Inverter power supply with automatic ramp","to":"X6","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Inverter power supply with automatic ramp","to":"Switch-mode inverter magnetron drive","type":"enabled_by"}],"rationale":"Power becomes invisible to the user yet gentler on food."},
    {"title":"Gentle/Normal rocker","anchors":["C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Two-position rocker switch","detail":"Replaces 5-step cam with 30%/100% selection."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Two-position rocker switch","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Two-position rocker switch","to":"X12","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"A binary choice is instantly understood by anyone."},
    {"title":"Weight-set power","anchors":["C14","F8"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Weight-indexed duty-cycle cam","detail":"Load cell shifts the cam; heavier dishes get fuller power."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Weight-indexed duty-cycle cam","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Weight-indexed duty-cycle cam","to":"F8","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Power is chosen by the food, not by the user."},
    {"title":"Snowflake/flame switch","anchors":["C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Defrost/Cook icon toggle","detail":"Large tactile toggle with only two universally understood icons."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Defrost/Cook icon toggle","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"A4","to":"Defrost/Cook icon toggle","type":"relevant_to"}],"rationale":"Icons replace numeric power percentages."},

ideas.title: Hold-to-Cook dead-man button

new_nodes.label: Momentary hold-to-cook button
new_nodes.detail: Magnetron runs only while the big button is pressed; release = stop.

ideas.rationale: No duration to set or read: you hold it until the food looks done, zero learning curve.

ideas.title: Toaster-style push-down lever

new_nodes.label: Spring lever with pop-up release
new_nodes.detail: Push lever down to start a fixed run; it pops up with a clack when done, like a toaster.

ideas.rationale: Borrows a universally understood toaster gesture instead of a numeric timer.

ideas.title: Pull-string timer

new_nodes.label: Pull-cord clockwork timer
new_nodes.detail: Pull the cord out; its slow spring retraction keeps the circuit closed, length = time.

ideas.rationale: A single intuitive physical gesture (pull more = cook more) with no dial markings to interpret.

ideas.title: Hourglass sand timer switch

new_nodes.label: Sand-flow optical interruption
new_nodes.detail: Flipping a visible hourglass closes an optical switch until sand runs out.

new_nodes.label: Flip-hourglass cooking timer
new_nodes.detail: Hourglass module on the front panel; flip to start, empty = stop.

ideas.rationale: The remaining time is literally visible as sand, understood by children and elderly alike.

ideas.title: Three big pictogram buttons

new_nodes.label: Cup / Plate / Snowflake preset buttons
new_nodes.detail: Three oversized buttons each hard-wired to a fixed time-and-power profile.

ideas.rationale: Replaces two knobs with one-press choices described by pictures, not numbers.

ideas.title: Weighing turntable sets the time

new_nodes.label: Load-cell turntable auto-timer
new_nodes.detail: Food mass measured on the turntable sets cook duration automatically.

ideas.rationale: User just places food and presses start; time is derived, never chosen.

ideas.title: Steam-sensor auto-stop

new_nodes.label: Humidity-burst sensing
new_nodes.detail: Cheap humidity sensor in the vent detects the steam surge when food is hot.

new_nodes.label: Steam-stop start button
new_nodes.detail: One start button; oven stops itself when steam is detected.

ideas.rationale: Removes the need to estimate time at all: press start, it stops when hot.

ideas.title: Infrared food-surface thermostat

new_nodes.label: IR thermopile stop switch
new_nodes.detail: Non-contact sensor in the cavity roof cuts power when food surface hits ~70 °C.

ideas.rationale: Cooking becomes 'until hot', a concept everyone already has.

ideas.title: Close-the-door-to-start

new_nodes.label: Door-closure start switch with fixed 60 s run
new_nodes.detail: Shutting the door starts a one-minute burst; reopen to stop, reshut for another minute.

new_edges.from: Door-closure start switch with fixed 60 s run
Door-closure start switch with fixed 60 s run

new_edges.to: Door-closure start switch with fixed 60 s run

ideas.rationale: Eliminates every control: the only interaction is opening and closing the door.

ideas.title: Knock-to-add-time casing

new_nodes.label: Piezo knock detection
new_nodes.detail: A piezo disc on the wrapper counts taps.

new_nodes.label: Tap-counter timer
new_nodes.detail: Each knock on the case adds 30 s; a knock while running stops.

ideas.rationale: No knob, no button labels: tapping is the most primitive interaction there is.

ideas.title: Rotate the whole oven to set time

new_nodes.label: Turntable base with clockwork return
new_nodes.detail: The oven sits on a wind-up base; twist the oven body, it slowly turns back and stops cooking at zero.

ideas.rationale: The product itself becomes the dial, a giant unmistakable indicator of remaining time.

ideas.title: Token-slot minute counter

new_nodes.label: Drop-token timer
new_nodes.detail: Each steel token dropped in a slot buys one minute; tokens return to a tray when spent.

ideas.rationale: Counting physical tokens is simpler than reading a scale and gives tangible feedback.

ideas.title: Single slider with cup-to-plate icons

new_nodes.label: One linear slider (sip ↔ feast)
new_nodes.detail: A single slider spans small-cup to full-plate icons, mapping to combined time and power.

ideas.rationale: Collapses two abstract settings into one picture-based choice of 'how much food'.

ideas.title: Light-is-the-timer

new_nodes.label: Fading-glow bar timer
new_nodes.detail: A row of warm LEDs lights up as you press start repeatedly; they extinguish one by one as time passes.

ideas.rationale: Remaining time is shown as light rather than digits, readable from across the room.

ideas.title: Bimetal cavity-heat timer

new_nodes.label: Bimetallic strip snap switch
new_nodes.detail: A strip warmed by exhaust air bends and opens the circuit when the cavity is hot.

new_nodes.label: Thermal snap-off switch
new_nodes.detail: Replaces clockwork; cook ends when the exhaust reaches a set temperature.

ideas.rationale: Cheaper than a motor timer and needs no setting: it just stops when things are hot.

ideas.title: Voice stop word

new_nodes.label: Offline single-keyword recognition
new_nodes.detail: Tiny MCU listens only for 'stop' and 'go'.

new_nodes.label: Spoken start/stop module
new_nodes.detail: Say go to run, say stop to end; no timer hardware.

ideas.rationale: Two words everyone knows replace every control and are usable with full hands.

ideas.title: Foot pedal cook control

ideas.rationale: Hands-free, no settings, familiar from sewing machines and car accelerators.

ideas.rationale: Keeps the cheap cam timer but removes the need to know how many minutes food takes.

Hinged top lid with gravity seal

new_nodes.detail: Visual flag springs up at end of cycle, replacing the bell

ideas.title: Electroluminescent cavity walls

new_nodes.detail: Glowing wall replaces bulb and lamp cavity, lighting food evenly

ideas.rationale: Shadow-free view makes checking food effortless.

ideas.title: Transparent conductive door glass

new_nodes.detail: Invisible conductive film shields RF without perforated metal sheet

ideas.rationale: Clear view of food means fewer stop-and-check cycles.

ideas.title: Fan-coupled turntable drive

new_nodes.detail: Geared take-off from existing fan spins the turntable; separate motor eliminated

new_edges.from: Magnetic coupling from cooling fan shaft

ideas.rationale: Fewer motors to fail means fewer confusing 'why isn't it turning' moments.

ideas.title: LED ring countdown around knob
