new_nodes.detail: Ring of LEDs around a single quartz-timed knob shows remaining time, replacing bell-only feedback

ideas.rationale: Glanceable progress needs no reading of numbers.

ideas.title: Liquid detection anti-superheat pulse

new_nodes.label: Liquid-load detector (weight + IR)
new_nodes.detail: Identifies cups of liquid and auto-pulses power, replacing manual power selection

ideas.rationale: Safety behavior is automatic, so the user needs no warnings to learn.

ideas.title: Arc sensor auto-cutoff

new_nodes.label: Acoustic/optical arc detector
new_nodes.detail: Detects arcing flash or crackle and cuts RF, replacing the 'no metal' rule

ideas.rationale: Forgives the most common user mistake instead of requiring knowledge.

ideas.title: Turntable is the timer dial

new_nodes.label: Hand-rotated minute-marked turntable
new_nodes.detail: User turns the tray to a minute mark; motor unwinds it back to zero as it heats

ideas.rationale: The food's own plate is the control; nothing on the front panel.

ideas.title: Current-sensing replaces monitor switch

new_nodes.label: Magnetron current monitor
new_nodes.detail: Electronics detect RF-on with door open and trip; replaces third mechanical monitor switch

ideas.rationale: Fewer mechanical adjustments reduce field faults the user would otherwise have to troubleshoot.

ideas.title: NTC in inverter replaces thermostat

new_nodes.label: NTC thermistor magnetron monitor
new_nodes.detail: Inverter reads temperature and derates power smoothly instead of snapping off

ideas.rationale: No abrupt mid-cook shutoff that puzzles the user.

ideas.title: Music-box timer

new_nodes.label: Wind-up music-box timer
new_nodes.detail: Winding sets time; a tune plays while cooking and silence signals done, replacing dial and bell

ideas.rationale: Audible progress means the user never wonders how long is left.

ideas.title: Roller ring takes the user's own plate

new_nodes.label: Universal plate roller ring
new_nodes.detail: Three-arm spring roller grips any plate, eliminating the glass tray

ideas.rationale: One less part to wash, align or break.

ideas.title: Push-the-door-to-open

new_nodes.label: Push-push door latch
new_nodes.detail: Cabinet-style push latch: press the door itself to pop it open, no separate button

ideas.rationale: Whole door is the button, nothing to find.

ideas.title: Thermochromic door window

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic door film
new_nodes.detail: Window tints from blue to red with cavity heat, replacing the lamp as feedback

ideas.rationale: Color shows hot-or-not at a glance without opening or reading.

ideas.title: Hold-to-heat dead-man button

new_nodes.label: Momentary hold-to-heat button
new_nodes.detail: Heats only while pressed; release stops. Replaces timer for short bursts

ideas.rationale: Perfect 10-second warm-ups with no dial reading.

ideas.title: Two-detent power cam

new_nodes.label: Two-step duty-cycle cam (Defrost/Cook)
new_nodes.detail: Simplified cam replaces five-step cam

ideas.rationale: Cheaper mechanism and a choice anyone can make.

ideas.title: Quartz timer in a single knob

new_nodes.label: Quartz-timed rotary knob
new_nodes.detail: Electronic timing behind a classic knob; accurate to the second with no keypad

ideas.rationale: Keeps the familiar twist while fixing short-duration imprecision.

ideas.title: Strobe beacon end signal

new_nodes.label: Flashing top beacon
new_nodes.detail: Bright flashing light replaces bell for noisy or hearing-impaired contexts

ideas.rationale: Universally noticed signal, no sound to interpret.

ideas.title: Tactile braille detent knob

new_nodes.label: Tactile-detent knob with raised icons
new_nodes.detail: Molded tactile markings replace printed scale on knobs

ideas.rationale: Settings can be felt, not read, so operation is learnable in one touch.

new_nodes.detail: Food cards carry mechanical codes; slot sets both settings.

ideas.rationale: Insert the 'soup card' — no knowledge needed.

ideas.title: Doneness dial (rare → well)

new_nodes.label: Single toaster-style doneness knob
new_nodes.detail: One cam couples time and duty into a 'light to strong' scale.

ideas.rationale: One knob, one concept, like the browning dial.

ideas.title: Defrost bar only

new_nodes.label: Single 'Defrost' latching bar, else full power
new_nodes.detail: Replaces 5-step cam with one 30 % duty option.

new_edges.from: Single 'Defrost' latching bar, else full power
Single 'Defrost' latching bar, else full power

ideas.rationale: Only the one non-full mode people actually use.

ideas.title: Fading light ring as countdown

new_nodes.label: LED ring on door bezel that drains as time elapses
new_nodes.detail: Replaces dial scale with a glanceable progress ring.

new_edges.from: LED ring on door bezel that drains as time elapses
LED ring on door bezel that drains as time elapses

ideas.rationale: Understand remaining time from across the room without reading digits.

ideas.title: Spoken 'Done' instead of bell

new_nodes.label: Voice/chime module saying 'your food is ready'
new_nodes.detail: Replaces mechanical bell with a clearer spoken cue.

new_edges.from: Voice/chime module saying 'your food is ready'
Voice/chime module saying 'your food is ready'

ideas.rationale: Unambiguous feedback helps hearing- or memory-impaired users.

ideas.title: Hinge-free magnet-hung door

new_nodes.label: Door held by magnetic rails, lifts away completely
new_nodes.detail: No hinges or latch; door snaps onto rails and seals by magnets.

new_edges.from: Door held by magnetic rails, lifts away completely
Door held by magnetic rails, lifts away completely

ideas.rationale: Grab and lift — no swing arc, no button.

ideas.title: Wave-to-add-a-minute

new_nodes.label: IR proximity gesture sensor
new_nodes.detail: Each hand wave adds 60 s; cover sensor to stop.

ideas.rationale: Touchless, hygienic, one gesture.

ideas.title: Top-loading lid oven

new_nodes.label: Top-hinged gravity-closing lid
new_nodes.detail: Lid falls shut by weight; seal by its own mass; no latch.

ideas.rationale: Can't be left half-open; drop it and go.

ideas.title: Squeeze-bulb timer

new_nodes.label: Pneumatic squeeze bulb with bleed valve
new_nodes.detail: Number of squeezes inflates bellows; bleed-down time equals cooking time.

new_edges.from: Pneumatic squeeze bulb with bleed valve
Pneumatic squeeze bulb with bleed valve

ideas.rationale: Tactile, mains-independent, and a child could use it.

ideas.title: 'Same as last time' button

new_nodes.label: Mechanical detent memory of last knob positions
new_nodes.detail: One big repeat button rewinds cams to last used settings.

new_edges.from: Mechanical detent memory of last knob positions
Mechanical detent memory of last knob positions

ideas.rationale: Repetitive daily use becomes a single press.

ideas.title: Barcode reads the packet

new_nodes.label: Door-mounted barcode/QR scanner
new_nodes.detail: Package code sets time and power automatically.

ideas.rationale: Show the packet, close the door, done.

ideas.title: NFC sticker on the bowl

new_nodes.label: NFC reader in turntable hub reading container tags
new_nodes.detail: Reusable bowls carry tags with preferred cycles.

new_edges.from: NFC reader in turntable hub reading container tags
NFC reader in turntable hub reading container tags

ideas.rationale: The container remembers the setting so the user needn't.

ideas.title: Linear ruler slider

new_nodes.label: Horizontal slide with giant 0-10 min ruler
new_nodes.detail: Slider returns left as time elapses; replaces rotary cam.

new_edges.from: Horizontal slide with giant 0-10 min ruler
Horizontal slide with giant 0-10 min ruler

ideas.rationale: Linear scales are easier to read than small rotary dials.

ideas.title: Weighted dice timer

new_nodes.label: Cube placed on top with time faces (1,2,3,5,10,Off)
new_nodes.detail: Hall sensors read which face is up; set by turning the cube.

new_edges.from: Cube placed on top with time faces (1,2,3,5,10,Off)
Cube placed on top with time faces (1,2,3,5,10,Off)

ideas.rationale: Playful, visible setting with big readable numbers.

ideas.title: Camera reads a scribbled note

new_nodes.label: Door camera with digit OCR
new_nodes.detail: Write '3' on a sticky note on the plate; oven runs 3 minutes.

ideas.rationale: Writing a number is the lowest-tech instruction possible.

ideas.title: Rotate the whole oven to set time

new_nodes.label: Turntable base: oven body rotates on a cam ring
new_nodes.detail: Twist the oven like a jar lid; it unwinds back as it cooks.

new_edges.from: Turntable base: oven body rotates on a cam ring
Turntable base: oven body rotates on a cam ring

ideas.rationale: Giant, impossible-to-miss control for low-dexterity users.

ideas.title: Bimetal thermal timer

new_nodes.label: Bimetal heater-strip delay switch
new_nodes.detail: A heated bimetal strip bends and cuts the circuit after a set travel; no motor.

ideas.rationale: Cheaper mechanism behind the same simple knob.

ideas.title: Interlock replaces the door button

new_nodes.label: Door with friction seal and no latch; interlock cuts power on crack
new_nodes.detail: Door swings freely; opening 2 mm kills the magnetron instantly.

new_edges.from: Door with friction seal and no latch; interlock cuts power on crack
Door with friction seal and no latch; interlock cuts power on crack

ideas.rationale: Door behaves like a cupboard; nothing to unlock.

ideas.title: Power by number of pulses

new_nodes.label: Pedal-tap duty: each tap on start = one 10 s burst
new_nodes.detail: User taps as needed; no stored power level.

new_edges.from: Pedal-tap duty: each tap on start = one 10 s burst
Pedal-tap duty: each tap on start = one 10 s burst

ideas.rationale: Gentle heating becomes 'tap, stir, tap' with no settings.

ideas.title: Smart-plug outsources the timer

new_nodes.label: Oven always-on; mains smart plug/phone app times it
new_nodes.detail: Timer removed from oven entirely; the plug cuts power.

new_edges.from: Oven always-on; mains smart plug/phone app times it
Oven always-on; mains smart plug/phone app times it

ideas.rationale: Oven becomes a one-switch appliance; timing lives where the user already is.

ideas.title: Thermochromic 'done' window

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic strip on turntable visible through door
new_nodes.detail: Strip turns red when plate reaches serving temperature.

new_edges.from: Thermochromic strip on turntable visible through door
Thermochromic strip on turntable visible through door

ideas.rationale: Users can just watch for the colour instead of estimating time.

ideas.title: Fixed one-minute oven

new_nodes.label: Single start lever: always 60 s, full power
new_nodes.detail: No timer, no power knob; press again for another minute.

new_edges.from: Single start lever: always 60 s, full power
Single start lever: always 60 s, full power
Single start lever: always 60 s, full power

ideas.rationale: The absolute minimum interface: one lever, one outcome.

{"ideas":[
{"title":"Hourglass timer","anchors":["C13","T8","F7"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Flip-over sand hourglass with optical empty-sensor","detail":"User flips a visible sand glass; a photodiode stops the magnetron when sand runs out."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Flip-over sand hourglass with optical empty-sensor","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Flip-over sand hourglass with optical empty-sensor","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"F7","to":"M6","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"Everyone understands sand running out; no numbers to read."},
{"title":"One big Go button (+30 s per press)","anchors":["C13","F7"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Single oversized start button adding 30 s per press","detail":"Replaces the 0-30 min dial with one tactile button and a click counter."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Single oversized start button adding 30 s per press","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Single oversized start button adding 30 s per press","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"One control, one gesture, zero learning curve for elderly users (A4)."},
{"title":"Weigh-and-go turntable","anchors":["C13","F7","X13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Load-cell turntable auto-setting duration by food mass","detail":"Strain gauge under turntable computes time; user only closes door."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Load-cell turntable auto-setting duration by food mass","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Load-cell turntable auto-setting duration by food mass","to":"X13","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"No input at all; the oven decides the time."},
{"title":"Pull-cord music-box timer","anchors":["C13","T8"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Technology","label":"Spring-rewind pull-cord escapement","detail":"Pull cord length sets duration; cord retracts and clicks off like a toy."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Spring-rewind pull-cord escapement","to":"T8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"C13","to":"Spring-rewind pull-cord escapement","type":"enabled_by"}],"rationale":"Pulling a cord is intuitive and cheaper than a motor cam."},
{"title":"Drawer instead of door","anchors":["C8","C26","C15","F9"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Pull-out shielded drawer cavity","detail":"Food sits on a sliding tray; drawer edge forms the choke seal."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Pull-out shielded drawer cavity","to":"C8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Pull-out shielded drawer cavity","to":"C26","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Pull-out shielded drawer cavity","to":"F9","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Pull, place, push: no hinge, no button, no latch logic to learn."},
{"title":"Roller-shutter front","anchors":["C8","C26","T18"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Mesh roller shutter sliding up into the top","detail":"Conductive slat shutter replaces hinged door and latch."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Mesh roller shutter sliding up into the top","to":"C8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Mesh roller shutter sliding up into the top","to":"T18","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Lift to open, drop to close — a garage-door gesture everyone knows."},
{"title":"Magnetic self-latching door","anchors":["C15","T18"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Technology","label":"Magnetic edge latch with reed-switch interlock","detail":"Permanent magnets hold door; pulling handle opens; reed switches do interlock."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Magnetic edge latch with reed-switch interlock","to":"T18","type":"resolves"},{"from":"C15","to":"Magnetic edge latch with reed-switch interlock","type":"enabled_by"}],"rationale":"Removes the push button: the door works like a fridge."},

{"title":"Say-a-number voice timer","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Technology","label":"Offline keyword speech recogniser chip","detail":"Recognises 'two minutes', 'defrost', 'stop' with no cloud."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Offline keyword speech recogniser chip","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Offline keyword speech recogniser chip","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"F7","to":"Offline keyword speech recogniser chip","type":"enabled_by"}],"rationale":"Speaking is the most natural interface; nothing to learn."},
{"title":"Picture dial of foods","anchors":["C13","C14","F7","F8"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Single icon dial (cup, plate, popcorn, frozen block)","detail":"Each icon maps to a fixed time/power pair on one cam."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Single icon dial (cup, plate, popcorn, frozen block)","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Single icon dial (cup, plate, popcorn, frozen block)","to":"C14","type":"resolves"}],"rationale":"Users pick what they are heating, not numbers."},
{"title":"Two-position gentle/full rocker","anchors":["C14","F8","X6"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Rocker switch: Full / Gentle","detail":"Replaces 5-step cam with a two-state switch and fixed 50 % duty."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Rocker switch: Full / Gentle","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Rocker switch: Full / Gentle","to":"F8","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Binary choice removes ambiguity of 5 levels."},
{"title":"No power knob at all","anchors":["C14","F8","X12"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Fixed full-power magnetron feed, no power control","detail":"Deletes cam switch; time is the only variable."}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Fixed full-power magnetron feed, no power control","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Fixed full-power magnetron feed, no power control","to":"X12","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Fewest controls possible; cheaper and nothing to misunderstand."},

ideas.title: Single 'food dial' replaces timer + power knobs

ideas.title: Zero-knob 'close door = start' microwave

ideas.title: Tap-to-add-30-seconds ratchet button

new_nodes.label: Single ratchet push button (each press adds 30 s)
new_nodes.detail: A mechanical escapement advances the timer cam one notch per press; no dial to read.

new_nodes.label: Pawl-and-ratchet increment mechanism
new_nodes.detail: Each press winds the spring one tooth; clockwork returns it.

ideas.title: Pull-cord timer: pull length = cook time

new_nodes.detail: Pulling a cord winds a clockwork; a short tug is 30 s, arm's length is 5 min; cord retracts as it cooks.

ideas.rationale: Remaining time is a physical length anyone can see and feel, with no numbers or motors involved.

ideas.title: Hand-wound mainspring timer (no synchronous motor)

new_nodes.label: Mainspring escapement clockwork
new_nodes.detail: Wind-up toy mechanism replaces the mains-frequency motor timer; works on 50 or 60 Hz.

ideas.rationale: A toy-like wind-up is instantly understood, cheaper, and identical across mains regions.

ideas.title: Quartz clock movement drives the timer cam

new_nodes.label: Quartz kitchen-clock movement
new_nodes.detail: A $1 battery quartz movement turns the cam shaft with second-level accuracy.

ideas.rationale: Keeps the familiar knob but makes the short settings reliable so users never need to re-run cycles.

ideas.title: Bimetal thermal-delay timer

new_nodes.label: Heater-coil bimetal delay switch
new_nodes.detail: Knob sets a contact gap; a heated bimetal strip bends until it opens the circuit, like a turn-signal flasher.

ideas.rationale: Three moving parts replace a clockwork, same one-knob operation at lower cost.

ideas.title: Weighing turntable sets the time automatically

new_nodes.label: Spring-scale turntable support
new_nodes.detail: Food weight compresses a spring that mechanically presets the timer cam (mass to minutes).

new_nodes.detail: No user input of duration.

new_edges.from: Derives cooking time from food mass

ideas.title: Steam-triggered bimetal auto-stop replaces the timer

new_nodes.detail: When food steams, hot vapour in the vent snaps a bimetal disc that cuts the magnetron.

new_nodes.detail: Purely mechanical closed-loop end-point.

new_edges.from: Pedal-bar latch release along the plinth
Pedal-bar latch release along the plinth
Pedal-bar latch release along the plinth

ideas.rationale: Hands full of hot plate or child, you open it the way you open a bin: no thought needed.

ideas.title: Drawer microwave: the cavity slides out, no door

new_nodes.label: Pull-out cavity drawer with choke lip
new_nodes.detail: The whole cooking box slides forward on rails; pushing it home closes the RF seal and interlocks.

new_edges.from: Pull-out cavity drawer with choke lip
Pull-out cavity drawer with choke lip
Pull-out cavity drawer with choke lip
Pull-out cavity drawer with choke lip

ideas.rationale: Loading from above into an open drawer is more intuitive and spill-proof than reaching into a lit box.

ideas.title: Drop-down oven-style door that is also a plate shelf

new_nodes.label: Bottom-hinged drop door with resting ledge
new_nodes.detail: Door folds down flat so the hot plate can be slid out onto it.

new_edges.from: Bottom-hinged drop door with resting ledge
Bottom-hinged drop door with resting ledge
Bottom-hinged drop door with resting ledge

ideas.rationale: Mirrors the conventional oven people already know and gives a safe place to park the hot dish.

ideas.title: Sliding pocket door

new_nodes.label: Side-sliding shielded panel door
new_nodes.detail: Door slides into the cabinet wall; no swing radius, no latch button.

ideas.rationale: One obvious sliding motion, and it fits in corners where a swing door bangs into things.

ideas.title: Top-loading lid microwave for mugs and bowls

new_nodes.label: Rice-cooker style hinged top lid over a round cavity
new_nodes.detail: Drop the mug in from above, close the lid; gravity and a choke ring seal it.

new_edges.from: Rice-cooker style hinged top lid over a round cavity
Rice-cooker style hinged top lid over a round cavity
Rice-cooker style hinged top lid over a round cavity
Rice-cooker style hinged top lid over a round cavity

ideas.rationale: A lidded pot is the most familiar kitchen object there is; nothing to explain.

ideas.title: Bell-jar microwave: lift the dome over the plate

new_nodes.label: Metallised glass dome on a heated base
new_nodes.detail: The dome is the cavity and the door; lifting it off opens the interlock in the rim.

new_edges.from: Metallised glass dome on a heated base
Metallised glass dome on a heated base
Metallised glass dome on a heated base
Metallised glass dome on a heated base

ideas.rationale: Plate down, dome on, lift off: the cooking gesture is as simple as covering a dish.

ideas.title: The dish is the cavity: docking microwave pot

new_nodes.label: Shielded lidded cooking pot that docks onto an RF base
new_nodes.detail: You eat from, store, and heat in the same sealed pot; docking it closes the waveguide path.

new_edges.from: Shielded lidded cooking pot that docks onto an RF base
Shielded lidded cooking pot that docks onto an RF base
Shielded lidded cooking pot that docks onto an RF base
Shielded lidded cooking pot that docks onto an RF base

ideas.rationale: No transferring food between containers and no appliance interior to understand or clean.

ideas.title: Door as a waveguide segment replaces interlock switches

new_nodes.label: Door-carried waveguide section
new_nodes.detail: RF path passes through a duct in the door; opening physically breaks the duct so energy cannot reach the cavity.

ideas.rationale: Safety by geometry rather than by three switches means fewer failure modes the user ever meets.

ideas.title: Hinge pin is the mains switch

new_nodes.label: Rotary-contact hinge interlock
new_nodes.detail: Hinge pin carries the mains contact; door open = circuit mechanically open at the hinge.

ideas.rationale: Removes misaligned-switch 'it won't start' faults that baffle users.

ideas.title: Resettable PTC replaces fuse and monitor switch

new_nodes.label: Polymer PTC resettable overcurrent element
new_nodes.detail: Trips on fault, resets when unplugged and cooled; no fuse to find or replace.

ideas.rationale: 'Unplug it and plug it back in' is the only recovery step anyone needs to know.

ideas.title: Passive chimney cooling replaces fan and motor

new_nodes.label: Natural-convection heat-pipe chimney
new_nodes.detail: Heat pipes from the magnetron to a rear stack create silent draught; no fan.

ideas.rationale: A silent appliance removes the 'is it still running?' ambiguity and one more thing to fail.

ideas.title: Flush glass-ceramic ceiling replaces mica cover

new_nodes.label: Sealed glass-ceramic waveguide window
new_nodes.detail: A flush, non-porous panel that wipes clean and never gets replaced.

ideas.rationale: Users never discover the scary 'burnt cardboard' part or need to know it exists.

ideas.title: Moulded tactile pictograms replace printed fascia legends

new_nodes.label: Embossed icon fascia with detent clicks
new_nodes.detail: Raised mug/plate/snowflake symbols and audible knob detents; no text, no ink to wear off.

new_edges.from: Embossed icon fascia with detent clicks
Embossed icon fascia with detent clicks
Embossed icon fascia with detent clicks

ideas.rationale: Language-free and readable by touch, so first use needs no manual and no eyesight.

ideas.title: Traffic-light colour zones replace numbered scales

new_nodes.label: Colour-band knob scales
new_nodes.detail: Green = drink, amber = plate, red = long cook; defrost shown as blue band.

ideas.rationale: People match colours faster than they estimate minutes.

ideas.title: Thermochromic frosting window as burn warning

new_nodes.label: Thermochromic laminate door glass
new_nodes.detail: Window tints red while contents are hot, clearing as they cool to safe handling temperature.

ideas.rationale: Hot/not-hot is shown without a reading, aimed at children and elderly users.

ideas.title: Hourglass-style visible countdown replaces the dial scale

new_nodes.label: Rotating coloured-sector time window
new_nodes.detail: A coloured wedge visibly shrinks as time runs out, like a kitchen egg timer, no digits.

ideas.rationale: Remaining time is understood pre-literately as 'how much red is left'.

ideas.title: Swing-out plate shelf door replaces turntable and door

new_nodes.label: Door-mounted carousel shelf
new_nodes.detail: The food shelf is attached to the door; opening swings the plate out to you, closing swings it in.

ideas.rationale: No reaching into a hot box: the appliance hands the plate to the user.

ideas.title: Vibrating floor stirs the field instead of rotating food

new_nodes.label: Low-frequency vibrating cavity floor
new_nodes.detail: An eccentric weight on the fan shaft shimmies a thin floor plate, shifting standing waves and nudging liquids.

ideas.rationale: Nothing to align or remove, and the gentle agitation also prevents superheated-drink surprises.

ideas.title: Hold-to-heat dead-man button

new_nodes.label: Single hold-to-heat push bar
new_nodes.detail: Magnetron runs only while the bar is held; release = stop, no timer, no power setting

ideas.rationale: Zero settings to learn: you press until the food looks right.

ideas.title: Load-cell auto-timer

new_nodes.label: Turntable load cell
new_nodes.detail: Weighs the dish and derives heating time from mass; one Start button

new_nodes.label: Strain-gauge weighing
new_nodes.detail: Cheap kitchen-scale sensor under turntable motor

ideas.rationale: User never estimates minutes; the oven weighs and decides.

ideas.title: Temperature dial instead of time dial

new_nodes.label: IR thermopile with target-temperature knob
new_nodes.detail: Knob labelled Warm/Hot/Boiling; heating stops when surface reaches target

ideas.rationale: 'How hot' is intuitive; 'how many minutes at what power' is not.

ideas.title: Steam-stop sensor

new_nodes.label: Humidity sensor in exhaust duct
new_nodes.detail: Stops heating when steam burst indicates food is hot throughout

ideas.rationale: Replaces timer guesswork with a single Start press.

ideas.title: Picture-preset buttons only

new_nodes.label: Four pictogram buttons (cup, plate, soup, defrost)
new_nodes.detail: Each button hard-wires a fixed time/power pair; no numbers anywhere

new_edges.from: Four pictogram buttons (cup, plate, soup, defrost)
Four pictogram buttons (cup, plate, soup, defrost)

ideas.rationale: Choosing a picture of your food needs no instruction.

ideas.title: One-button +30 s

new_nodes.label: Single '+30 s' button with LED countdown bar
new_nodes.detail: Each press adds 30 s and starts immediately; nothing else on the panel

new_edges.from: Single '+30 s' button with LED countdown bar
Single '+30 s' button with LED countdown bar

ideas.rationale: One control, one gesture, learnable in a second.

ideas.title: Door is the switch

new_nodes.label: Door-closed-equals-on interlock with 5 min safety cutoff
new_nodes.detail: Closing the door starts heating; opening stops it; no timer knob

new_edges.from: Door-closed-equals-on interlock with 5 min safety cutoff
Door-closed-equals-on interlock with 5 min safety cutoff

ideas.rationale: The only action is open/close, which everyone already knows.

ideas.title: Delete the power knob

new_nodes.label: Fixed 500 W single-power magnetron drive
new_nodes.detail: Lower fixed power that is safe for reheat and defrost alike; knob removed

ideas.rationale: Fewer controls equals less to learn.

ideas.title: Gentle/Strong rocker with inverter

new_nodes.label: Inverter continuous-power supply
new_nodes.detail: Switch-mode HV supply gives true continuous power

new_nodes.label: Two-position Gentle/Strong rocker
new_nodes.detail: Replaces 5-step cam with a binary choice

ideas.rationale: A binary choice is the simplest possible power setting.

ideas.title: Offline voice chip

new_nodes.label: Keyword-spotting voice module
new_nodes.detail: $2 chip understands 'two minutes', 'defrost', 'stop' without cloud

ideas.rationale: Speaking a duration needs no interface literacy.

ideas.title: Pull-cord timer

new_nodes.label: Retracting pull-cord timer
new_nodes.detail: Pull a cord out marked in minutes; a vacuum-style cord retractor pulls it back and trips the switch at zero

ideas.rationale: Visible cord length is a tangible, obvious representation of remaining time.

ideas.title: Egg-timer drum with braille detents

new_nodes.label: Oversized tactile drum timer
new_nodes.detail: Hand-sized drum with 1-minute clicks and raised numerals

ideas.rationale: Large tactile clicks make setting time unmistakable for elderly users.

ideas.title: Tap-the-packet NFC

new_nodes.label: NFC reader on front panel
new_nodes.detail: Tap food packaging; tag carries time and power

ideas.rationale: Packaging knows the recipe so the user needn't.

ideas.title: Magnetic no-button door

new_nodes.label: Magnetic-catch door with pull handle
new_nodes.detail: Magnets hold door shut; pull to open, push to close; interlocks sensed by reed switches

ideas.rationale: Removes the 'which button opens it' question.

ideas.title: Drawer microwave

new_nodes.label: Pull-out drawer cavity
new_nodes.detail: Food sits in a sliding drawer; push shut to seal with choke flange

ideas.rationale: Push/pull is a universal gesture with no latch to find.

ideas.title: Top-loading lid

new_nodes.label: Chest-style top lid cavity
new_nodes.detail: Drop food in from above; lid weight closes interlocks

ideas.rationale: Dropping food into a box is the simplest loading motion.

ideas.title: Revolving-carousel cavity

new_nodes.label: Rotating half-drum cavity
new_nodes.detail: Turn the drum to present the shelf outward; turning back seals it

ideas.rationale: No door at all to open or latch.

ideas.title: Oven-style drop-down shelf door

new_nodes.label: Bottom-hinged drop door
new_nodes.detail: Door swings down and doubles as a plate shelf

ideas.rationale: Mirrors a familiar oven and gives a place to rest the hot plate.

ideas.title: Foot pedal door

new_nodes.label: Foot-pedal latch release
new_nodes.detail: Bin-style pedal opens the door when hands are full

ideas.rationale: Hands-full opening removes a fumbling step.

ideas.title: Auto-open at end

new_nodes.label: Spring auto-pop door at timer end
new_nodes.detail: Timer trip releases latch so door pops ajar; replaces bell

new_edges.from: Spring auto-pop door at timer end

new_edges.to: Spring auto-pop door at timer end

ideas.rationale: Done state is physically obvious, no button needed.

ideas.title: Transparent conductive window

new_nodes.label: Fine metal-mesh laminated glass
new_nodes.detail: 20 µm mesh in glass gives clear view with Faraday shielding

new_nodes.label: Clear shielded door glass
new_nodes.detail: Replaces perforated steel mesh

ideas.rationale: Seeing food clearly lets users stop by eye instead of learning settings.

ideas.title: Doorless choke tunnel

new_nodes.label: Quarter-wave choke tunnel
new_nodes.detail: Conveyor-oven style open mouth attenuates leakage without a door

new_nodes.label: Open-mouth cavity with choke tunnel
new_nodes.detail: Slide plate in; no door, hinges or latch

ideas.rationale: Nothing to open or close means nothing to learn.

ideas.title: Thermochromic progress strip

new_nodes.label: Heated thermochromic bar on door
new_nodes.detail: A resistive strip warms along its length as time elapses, colour shows progress

ideas.rationale: Progress is read at a glance without numbers.

ideas.title: Wind-up spring timer

new_nodes.label: Clockwork wind-up timer
new_nodes.detail: Spring escapement like an egg timer; no synchronous motor, mains-frequency independent

ideas.rationale: Same twist gesture, cheaper, and ticks audibly so users know it's running.

ideas.title: Heat/Defrost toggle

new_nodes.label: Two-position Heat/Defrost toggle
new_nodes.detail: Defrost = 30% duty via one cam lobe; all other cases full power

ideas.rationale: Removes four meaningless intermediate power levels.

ideas.title: Single more/less lever

new_nodes.label: Spring-centred More/Less lever
new_nodes.detail: Push up to add heat, down to reduce; oven maps lever to time and power internally

ideas.rationale: One control expressing only 'more' or 'less'.

ideas.title: Wave-to-add gesture

new_nodes.label: IR proximity gesture sensor
new_nodes.detail: Each hand wave in front of the door adds 30 s

ideas.rationale: Touch-free, no knob to decode.

ideas.title: Pod-style coded containers

new_nodes.label: Keyed container base reader
new_nodes.detail: Container foot shape presses microswitches that select a fixed programme

ideas.rationale: The dish picks the programme; the user just inserts it.

ideas.title: Coloured dish mats

new_nodes.label: Colour-sensing turntable spot
new_nodes.detail: Red/yellow/green silicone mats under the plate encode short/medium/long cook

ideas.rationale: Picking a mat colour is simpler than reading a dial.

ideas.title: Mechanical power attenuator shelf

new_nodes.label: Height-adjustable shelf toward antenna
new_nodes.detail: Lifting the shelf nearer the feed increases coupling; lever marked Low/High

ideas.rationale: Power becomes a physical position users can see.

ideas.title: Thermochromic plate + run-until-open

new_nodes.label: Bundled thermochromic plate
new_nodes.detail: Plate glaze turns red when food is hot; oven runs until door opened

ideas.rationale: Doneness is shown on the plate, so no timing is needed.

ideas.title: Zone-labelled single dial

new_nodes.label: Combined time/power dial with result zones
new_nodes.detail: Dial sectors read Warm cup / Hot plate / Defrost / Cook; each sector sets both cams

new_edges.from: Combined time/power dial with result zones
Combined time/power dial with result zones

ideas.rationale: One knob describing outcomes instead of parameters.

ideas.title: Visible hourglass timer

new_nodes.label: Flip hourglass with sand-weight switch
new_nodes.detail: Flipping the glass starts the oven; empty top bulb trips a lever to stop

ideas.rationale: Everyone understands an hourglass at a glance.

ideas.title: Squeeze-handle door

new_nodes.label: Squeeze-to-release grab handle
new_nodes.detail: Gripping the handle lifts the hooks; the natural grab motion opens the door

ideas.rationale: Opening is the same motion as reaching for the handle.

ideas.title: Evaporation-loss auto-stop

new_nodes.label: Load cell detecting mass loss
new_nodes.detail: Stops when evaporated-water mass loss indicates boiling point reached

ideas.rationale: Closed-loop stop removes the timing decision entirely.

ideas.title: Listen-for-done microphone

new_nodes.label: Cavity microphone
new_nodes.detail: Stops on sizzle/pop pattern decline (popcorn, soups)

ideas.rationale: Mimics how people already judge doneness by ear.

ideas.title: Pass-through tunnel door

new_nodes.label: Front and rear doors
new_nodes.detail: Load from kitchen side, serve from table side

ideas.rationale: Removes carrying and turning steps around the appliance.

ideas.title: Push-push door latch

new_nodes.label: Cabinet push-push latch
new_nodes.detail: Press the door itself to pop it open; no button

ideas.rationale: Any push anywhere on the door opens it.

ideas.title: Roll-up shutter door

new_nodes.label: Flexible metal-mesh roller shutter
new_nodes.detail: Shutter rolls up into the top; no swing clearance

ideas.rationale: Lifting a shutter is obvious and needs no swing space.

ideas.title: Result-preview dial

new_nodes.label: Dial with illustrated outcome window
new_nodes.detail: Rotating shows pictures of steaming cup, hot plate etc. in a window

ideas.rationale: Users choose what they want to see, not a number.

ideas.title: Exhaust-air thermostat stop

new_nodes.label: Bimetal thermostat in vent
new_nodes.detail: Cuts magnetron when exhaust air reaches a set temperature; 10-cent part

ideas.rationale: Cheapest possible auto-stop with a single Start press.

ideas.title: Reflected-power defrost sensing

new_nodes.label: Directional-coupler load sensing
new_nodes.detail: Ice-to-water dielectric change shifts reflected power; detect end of defrost

new_nodes.label: Auto-defrost sensing loop
new_nodes.detail: One Defrost button, stops itself

ideas.rationale: Defrost, the hardest setting, becomes a single button.

ideas.title: Timer that pops the door

new_nodes.label: Timer cam linked to latch lever
new_nodes.detail: At zero the cam both stops heating and lifts the latch

new_edges.from: Timer cam linked to latch lever

new_edges.to: Timer cam linked to latch lever

ideas.rationale: Done equals open; no bell to interpret.

ideas.title: Speaking knob

new_nodes.label: Knob with voice readout
new_nodes.detail: Rotating announces 'one minute, two minutes' from a sound chip

ideas.rationale: No reading of small scales for low-vision users.

ideas.title: Toy pull-string timer

new_nodes.label: Pull-string spring governor timer
new_nodes.detail: Pull ring sets time; string retracts under governor; stops at home

ideas.rationale: One pull, hear the whirr, done when quiet.

ideas.title: Chain-mail curtain door

new_nodes.label: Conductive bead-chain curtain with choke
new_nodes.detail: Push plate through a grounded metal curtain; combined with choke tunnel for leakage

ideas.rationale: Walking food through a curtain needs no instructions.

ideas.title: Lift-off door

new_nodes.label: Drop-in pin hinges, removable door
new_nodes.detail: Door lifts off for cleaning; no tools

ideas.rationale: Cleaning the window is as simple as lifting it off.

ideas.title: Capacitive touch door pad

new_nodes.label: Large capacitive 'touch to open' pad
new_nodes.detail: Whole door front acts as release; solenoid lifts hooks

ideas.rationale: No target to aim for; touching anywhere works.

ideas.title: Timer-driven turntable

new_nodes.label: Timer motor that also turns the turntable
new_nodes.detail: One synchronous motor drives both cam and turntable via gear train

new_edges.from: Timer motor that also turns the turntable
Timer motor that also turns the turntable

ideas.rationale: Visible plate rotation doubles as the 'it's running' indicator.

ideas.title: Weight-plus-IR single Start

new_nodes.label: Scale and IR fused controller
new_nodes.detail: Mass sets power, IR sets stop; panel has only Start

ideas.rationale: Entire interface collapses to one Start button.

ideas.title: Door-weight interlock lid

new_nodes.label: Gravity-sealed lid, no latch
new_nodes.detail: Heavy top lid seals by its own weight; lift to stop, lower to start

ideas.rationale: No latch mechanism to understand or wear out.

ideas.title: One-button 'Hot' microwave

new_nodes.label: Single illuminated HOT button
new_nodes.detail: Press once: full power until humidity sensor says food is hot; press again to stop.

new_nodes.label: Humidity-sensor cooking termination
new_nodes.detail: Steam burst in cavity exhaust indicates food reached serving temperature.

ideas.rationale: Replaces two knobs with a single button so there is literally nothing to learn.

ideas.title: Weight-sensing turntable sets time

new_nodes.label: Load-cell turntable spindle
new_nodes.detail: Strain gauge under the turntable motor measures dish mass and derives heating time.

ideas.rationale: The user just puts food in; the oven computes duration from weight, eliminating timer guesswork.

ideas.title: Food-icon dial replaces power knob

new_nodes.label: Pictogram rotary dial (cup, plate, pizza, frozen block)
new_nodes.detail: Each icon maps to a preset power-and-time combo; no numbers anywhere.

new_edges.from: Pictogram rotary dial (cup, plate, pizza, frozen block)

ideas.rationale: Replaces abstract watts and minutes with pictures anyone understands instantly.

ideas.title: Magnetic pull-door, no button

new_nodes.label: Rare-earth magnetic door closure
new_nodes.detail: Magnets hold the door shut against the choke; a simple pull opens it, like a fridge.

ideas.rationale: A fridge-style pull is a universally known gesture, removing the hidden release button.

ideas.title: Hall-sensor door detection

new_nodes.label: Redundant Hall-effect magnetic position sensing
new_nodes.detail: Two solid-state sensors plus a relay replace three mechanical microswitches with no wear.

ideas.rationale: Door closes with a gentle push and always 'just works', with no clunky latch feel to learn.

ideas.title: Mode-stirrer fan instead of turntable

new_nodes.label: Ceiling mode-stirrer paddle
new_nodes.detail: Metal fan in waveguide outlet scrambles field pattern, giving even heating on a flat floor.

ideas.rationale: Flat floor means any plate shape fits anywhere, so no positioning rules to learn.

ideas.title: Rotating under-floor antenna

new_nodes.label: Rotating feed antenna beneath ceramic floor
new_nodes.detail: Motor spins the RF feed rather than the food; floor is a fixed wipe-clean slab.

new_edges.from: Rotating feed antenna beneath ceramic floor
Rotating feed antenna beneath ceramic floor

ideas.rationale: No removable glass plate to wash, re-seat or misalign.

ideas.title: Steam-sniff auto-stop timer

new_nodes.label: Exhaust humidity sensor
new_nodes.detail: Detects the steam rise that marks food reaching temperature and cuts power.

ideas.rationale: The oven decides when it is done, so users never set a time.

ideas.title: IR thermopile 'done at 70 °C' stop

new_nodes.label: Ceiling IR thermopile
new_nodes.detail: Reads food surface temperature through a mica window and stops at a safe serving temperature.

ideas.rationale: Temperature-based stopping replaces time arithmetic and avoids overheated liquids.

ideas.title: Bowl-size dial

new_nodes.label: Three-position 'mug / bowl / plate' dial
new_nodes.detail: Portion size is the only input; power and time are derived internally.

ideas.rationale: Users already know what container they are holding; nothing else needs to be understood.

ideas.title: Spoken 'your food is ready'

new_nodes.label: Voice chip speaker
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the mechanical bell with a short spoken phrase in the user's language.

ideas.rationale: An explicit sentence needs no interpretation, unlike a generic ding.

ideas.title: Colour-glow door replaces bell

new_nodes.label: Edge-lit RGB door frame
new_nodes.detail: Red while heating, green when done; silent and visible across the room.

ideas.rationale: Traffic-light colours are universally understood, zero learning.

ideas.title: Edge-lit glass door instead of cavity lamp

new_nodes.label: LED edge-lighting of tempered door glass
new_nodes.detail: LEDs in the door frame inject light through the glass, lighting the cavity from outside the RF field.

new_edges.from: LED edge-lighting of tempered door glass
LED edge-lighting of tempered door glass

ideas.rationale: No bulb to replace and food is always visible, so users check progress at a glance.

ideas.title: Fibre-optic daylight pipe

new_nodes.label: Ambient-light fibre bundle to cavity
new_nodes.detail: Optical fibres collect room light at the top of the casing and emit it inside; no lamp, no wiring.

ideas.rationale: Removes a failure-prone lamp so the oven never needs user maintenance.

ideas.title: Inductive power pad instead of cord

new_nodes.label: High-power wireless induction coupling (Ki standard)
new_nodes.detail: Microwave sits on a countertop coil; no cord, plug or outlet hunting.

ideas.rationale: Place it and it works; nothing to plug in.

ideas.title: Battery-pack picnic microwave

new_nodes.label: Swappable LiFePO4 battery module
new_nodes.detail: Tool-battery style pack powers a low-power inverter magnetron for a few heating cycles.

ideas.rationale: Works anywhere with one click-in pack, no outlet or cable management.

ideas.title: Thermal fuse cast into magnetron

new_nodes.label: Integral one-shot thermal fuse in magnetron heatsink
new_nodes.detail: Cheaper than a snap-disc; cuts anode supply at a fixed temperature.

new_edges.from: Integral one-shot thermal fuse in magnetron heatsink
Integral one-shot thermal fuse in magnetron heatsink

ideas.rationale: Invisible safety that never asks the user to intervene or reset.

ideas.title: Switch-mode inverter replaces doubler

new_nodes.label: High-frequency inverter HV supply
new_nodes.detail: Replaces transformer, diode and large capacitor; no lethal stored charge, continuous power control.

ideas.rationale: True continuous power means 'low' really is gentle, so results match expectations without trial and error.

ideas.title: Solid-state GaN RF source

new_nodes.label: GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz amplifier with reflected-power sensing
new_nodes.detail: Replaces magnetron and HV chain; auto-tunes to the load and self-detects empty cavity.

new_edges.from: GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz amplifier with reflected-power sensing
GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz amplifier with reflected-power sensing
GaN solid-state 2.45 GHz amplifier with reflected-power sensing

ideas.rationale: Oven senses the food and adjusts itself, removing most user decisions.

ideas.title: Auto-shorting discharge relay

new_nodes.label: Normally-closed discharge relay across HV capacitor
new_nodes.detail: Shorts the capacitor the instant power is removed, replacing a bleeder resistor.

new_edges.from: Normally-closed discharge relay across HV capacitor
Normally-closed discharge relay across HV capacitor

ideas.rationale: Makes the appliance safe to handle immediately after unplugging without any user knowledge.

ideas.title: Conductive elastomer door gasket

new_nodes.label: Silver-loaded silicone RF gasket
new_nodes.detail: Soft conductive seal replaces the precision quarter-wave choke; tolerates sloppy door closure.

ideas.rationale: Door seals even if closed casually, so there is no 'correct way' to shut it.

ideas.title: Silicone mat instead of glass turntable

new_nodes.label: Dishwasher-safe silicone turntable mat
new_nodes.detail: Unbreakable, rolls up, keyed to the motor hub.

ideas.rationale: Nothing to break or re-align; the mat drops in any orientation.

ideas.title: Glazed ceramic waveguide window

new_nodes.label: Sintered alumina waveguide cover
new_nodes.detail: Wipe-clean glazed ceramic replaces the fragile mica sheet that users damage when cleaning.

ideas.rationale: Removes the one interior part that requires special care, so cleaning is foolproof.

ideas.title: Drawer-style cavity

new_nodes.label: Pull-out drawer cavity on ball slides
new_nodes.detail: The whole floor slides out like a kitchen drawer; the fixed front wall seals when closed.

new_edges.from: Pull-out drawer cavity on ball slides
Pull-out drawer cavity on ball slides
Pull-out drawer cavity on ball slides

ideas.rationale: Everyone knows how to open a drawer; no hinges, no button, food loads from above.

ideas.title: Top-loading lid microwave

new_nodes.label: Hinged top lid with gravity seal
new_nodes.detail: Cavity opens like a rice cooker; lid weight closes the RF seal and interlock.

new_edges.from: Hinged top lid with gravity seal
Hinged top lid with gravity seal

ideas.rationale: Lift lid, drop bowl in, close lid — the pot metaphor requires no instructions.

ideas.title: Iris-aperture door

new_nodes.label: Metal iris diaphragm front
new_nodes.detail: Overlapping leaves twist open like a camera shutter; closed position forms the RF seal.

ideas.rationale: A single twist gesture opens and closes, with no latch, hinge or button to understand.

ideas.title: NFC food packaging sets the program

new_nodes.label: NFC reader in turntable hub
new_nodes.detail: Reads a tag printed on the meal package and applies the manufacturer's heating program.

ideas.rationale: Ready meals heat themselves correctly without reading the box.

ideas.title: Camera food recognition replaces knobs

new_nodes.label: Cavity camera with on-device food classifier
new_nodes.detail: Identifies coffee, soup, leftovers or frozen block and picks the program.

new_nodes.label: Computer vision
new_nodes.detail: Image classification on embedded hardware.

new_edges.from: Cavity camera with on-device food classifier
Cavity camera with on-device food classifier

ideas.rationale: The appliance looks at the food so the user never has to describe it.

ideas.title: Time-only dial, power auto-managed

new_nodes.label: Single large time dial with adaptive power firmware
new_nodes.detail: Power ramps automatically from high to low as the humidity sensor detects doneness.

new_edges.from: Single large time dial with adaptive power firmware

ideas.rationale: Removes the confusing power knob entirely; users only ever turn one thing.

ideas.title: Hold-to-heat dead-man button

new_nodes.label: Large momentary 'heat while pressed' pad
new_nodes.detail: RF is on only while the pad is held; release stops instantly.

ideas.rationale: Perfect for 10-second tasks; the user is the timer and nothing can be set wrong.

ideas.title: Pull-string timer

new_nodes.label: Retracting pull-cord timer
new_nodes.detail: Length of cord pulled equals heating time; cord retracts as it cooks, like a pull-string toy.

ideas.rationale: A visible, physical length of cord is an intuitive representation of remaining time.

ideas.title: Pressure-sensitive power pad

new_nodes.label: Force-sensing start pad
new_nodes.detail: Light tap = gentle reheat, firm press = full power; cooks until humidity sensor stops it.

ideas.rationale: Maps intensity of intent to intensity of heating without numbers or modes.

ideas.title: Vibrating floor prevents superheating

new_nodes.label: Piezo-vibrated cavity floor
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the turntable motor; gentle vibration nucleates boiling and evens heating.

ideas.rationale: Users no longer need to know the 'put a spoon in the mug' rule.

ideas.title: Built-in boiling chips in turntable

new_nodes.label: Micro-textured ceramic turntable
new_nodes.detail: Rough surface provides nucleation sites so liquids boil visibly instead of superheating.

ideas.rationale: Safety is built into the plate, so no special cup-handling knowledge is needed.

ideas.title: Ferrite crisper floor

new_nodes.label: Ferrite-loaded ceramic turntable
new_nodes.detail: Absorbs microwaves and heats to ~200 °C, browning the underside of pizza and bread.

ideas.rationale: Crisping happens automatically without a separate grill mode to learn.

ideas.title: Transparent conductive film door

new_nodes.label: ITO / silver-nanowire RF-shielding film on glass
new_nodes.detail: Replaces perforated metal mesh with a clear conductive coating.

new_edges.from: ITO / silver-nanowire RF-shielding film on glass
ITO / silver-nanowire RF-shielding film on glass

ideas.rationale: Crystal-clear view lets users judge doneness by eye, the most natural feedback.

ideas.title: Retractable cord reel

new_nodes.label: Spring-loaded cord reel in base
new_nodes.detail: Vacuum-cleaner style reel; pull to length, tap to retract.

ideas.rationale: Setup is pull-and-plug, with no cable tangle for first-time users.

ideas.title: Scent-release doneness cue

new_nodes.label: Fan-driven aroma vent at cycle end
new_nodes.detail: At the end of cooking the fan vents cavity aroma into the room instead of ringing a bell.

new_edges.from: Fan-driven aroma vent at cycle end
Fan-driven aroma vent at cycle end

ideas.rationale: Smelling your food is a primal, zero-learning notification.

Door-compressed air bellows to pressure switch

ideas.rationale: Fail-safe with no electrical contacts in the door, so the door never 'needs a harder slam'.

ideas.title: Transformer tap selector for power

new_nodes.label: Two-tap HV transformer with toggle
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the duty-cycle cam with a real high/low voltage tap, giving genuine continuous low power.

ideas.rationale: A simple high/low toggle behaves exactly as users expect, with no pulsing surprises.

ideas.title: Removable silicone cavity liner

new_nodes.label: Pull-out moulded silicone cavity liner
new_nodes.detail: Catches splatter; lift out and rinse instead of scrubbing stamped steel.

ideas.rationale: Cleaning becomes a single obvious action, lowering the ownership learning curve.

ideas.title: Fan-driven magnetic turntable

new_nodes.label: Magnetic coupling from cooling fan shaft
new_nodes.detail: Geared take-off from the existing fan spins the plate through the floor; no separate motor.

new_edges.from: Magnetic coupling from cooling fan shaft
Magnetic coupling from cooling fan shaft

ideas.rationale: Fewer parts to fail and a smooth floor with no coupler to align.

ideas.title: Add-30-seconds only button

new_nodes.label: Single '+30 s' start button
new_nodes.detail: Each press adds 30 s at full power and starts immediately; the entire control surface.

ideas.rationale: The most-used microwave action becomes the only action.

ideas.title: Two-position reheat/defrost switch

new_nodes.label: Rocker switch: REHEAT / DEFROST
new_nodes.detail: Replaces the 5-step knob with the only two settings people actually use.

ideas.rationale: Two words, two positions, nothing to misinterpret.

ideas.title: Slot-machine lever control

new_nodes.label: Spring-return pull lever
new_nodes.detail: Lever travel sets time, it ratchets back as cooking proceeds; one gesture replaces both knobs.

ideas.rationale: A big lever invites use and shows remaining time by its position.

ideas.title: Foot-pedal door opener

new_nodes.label: Floor pedal cable release
new_nodes.detail: Pedal under the counter pops the door, like a pedal bin, for hands-full users.

ideas.rationale: Pedal-bin gesture is already learned by everyone.

ideas.title: Door auto-opens when done

new_nodes.label: Solenoid latch tied to timer end
new_nodes.detail: The bell moment also fires a solenoid that swings the door ajar, venting steam and signalling done.

new_edges.from: Solenoid latch tied to timer end
Solenoid latch tied to timer end

ideas.rationale: Opening the door is the notification and the next step, with no button to find.

ideas.title: Magnetron current sensing replaces thermostat

new_nodes.label: Anode current monitor with cut-off
new_nodes.detail: Microcontroller watches magnetron current to infer empty cavity or overheating and stops.

ideas.rationale: Protects against running empty or with metal, so beginner mistakes are harmless.

ideas.title: Thermal camera door display

new_nodes.label: Low-res thermal imager with door e-ink overlay
new_nodes.detail: Shows hot and cold zones on the door instead of lighting the cavity.

new_edges.from: Low-res thermal imager with door e-ink overlay
Low-res thermal imager with door e-ink overlay

ideas.rationale: Users see whether food is hot through, without probing or guessing.

ideas.title: Shape-memory alloy door release

new_nodes.label: Nitinol wire actuator latch
new_nodes.detail: A touch on a capacitive pad heats SMA wire which retracts the hook; no lever mechanism.

ideas.rationale: Any touch anywhere on the door opens it, so there is no specific button to locate.

ideas.title: Hourglass-style countdown window

new_nodes.label: Visible mechanical sand-glass timer
new_nodes.detail: Flipping the hourglass module starts the oven; sand runout trips the stop switch and shows time left.

ideas.rationale: An hourglass is self-explanatory across all ages and languages.

ideas.title: Weight-sets-time turntable

new_nodes.label: Load-cell turntable base
new_nodes.detail: Strain gauge under roller ring weighs the dish and sets duration automatically

new_nodes.label: Mass-proportional heating rule
new_nodes.detail: Seconds = k × grams; one lookup, no user input

ideas.rationale: User just puts food in and closes the door—time is derived from weight, nothing to set.

ideas.title: Single +30 s tap button

new_nodes.label: One big add-30s button
new_nodes.detail: Each press adds 30 s and starts immediately; no other control exists

ideas.rationale: One button, one rule: tap more for longer—zero learning curve.

ideas.title: Pull-cord timer

new_nodes.label: Retractable pull-cord timer
new_nodes.detail: Pull the cord out; it retracts over minutes like a tape measure, length = time

new_nodes.label: Escapement-governed spring retraction
new_nodes.detail: Clockwork escapement meters cord return speed

ideas.rationale: Remaining time is a visible physical length—intuitive even for children and elderly.

ideas.title: Absorber mats replace power knob

new_nodes.label: Colour-coded RF absorber mats
new_nodes.detail: Silicone mats loaded with carbon/ferrite soak up a fixed share of RF; blue mat = defrost

new_nodes.label: Passive dielectric dummy-load power sharing
new_nodes.detail: Lossy mat absorbs part of the field so food sees lower effective power

ideas.rationale: Power level becomes a physical object you place under the food—no knob to decode.

ideas.title: Picture dial

new_nodes.label: Food-icon single dial
new_nodes.detail: One knob with detents showing a mug, plate, frozen block, butter stick; each detent encodes time+power cams

ideas.rationale: Point the knob at the picture of what you are heating—no numbers, no two-knob coordination.

ideas.title: Steam-stop sensor

new_nodes.detail: Cheap capacitive RH sensor in exhaust path stops cooking when steam burst detected

ideas.rationale: Food tells the oven when it is hot—user sets nothing.

new_nodes.label: Ceiling IR thermopile

ideas.rationale: Every dish stops at eating temperature automatically—one outcome, no settings.

ideas.rationale: Open it like a fridge—the most universally understood door gesture.
