{"ideas":[
{"title":"Weight-sets-time turntable","anchors":["C13","C14","C10"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Load-cell turntable base","detail":"Strain gauge under roller ring weighs the dish and sets duration automatically"},{"type":"Technology","label":"Mass-proportional heating rule","detail":"Seconds = k × grams; one lookup, no user input"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Load-cell turntable base","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Load-cell turntable base","to":"Mass-proportional heating rule","type":"enabled_by"},{"from":"Load-cell turntable base","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"F7","to":"M6","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"User just puts food in and closes the door—time is derived from weight, nothing to set."},
{"title":"Single +30 s tap button","anchors":["C13","C24"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"One big add-30s button","detail":"Each press adds 30 s and starts immediately; no other control exists"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"One big add-30s button","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"One big add-30s button","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"One big add-30s button","to":"X5","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"One button, one rule: tap more for longer—zero learning curve."},
{"title":"Pull-cord timer","anchors":["C13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Retractable pull-cord timer","detail":"Pull the cord out; it retracts over minutes like a tape measure, length = time"},{"type":"Technology","label":"Escapement-governed spring retraction","detail":"Clockwork escapement meters cord return speed"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Retractable pull-cord timer","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Retractable pull-cord timer","to":"Escapement-governed spring retraction","type":"enabled_by"},{"from":"Retractable pull-cord timer","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Remaining time is a visible physical length—intuitive even for children and elderly."},
{"title":"Absorber mats replace power knob","anchors":["C14","C10"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Colour-coded RF absorber mats","detail":"Silicone mats loaded with carbon/ferrite soak up a fixed share of RF; blue mat = defrost"},{"type":"Technology","label":"Passive dielectric dummy-load power sharing","detail":"Lossy mat absorbs part of the field so food sees lower effective power"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Colour-coded RF absorber mats","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Colour-coded RF absorber mats","to":"Passive dielectric dummy-load power sharing","type":"enabled_by"},{"from":"Colour-coded RF absorber mats","to":"F8","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Colour-coded RF absorber mats","to":"X6","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Power level becomes a physical object you place under the food—no knob to decode."},
{"title":"Picture dial","anchors":["C13","C14","C24"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Food-icon single dial","detail":"One knob with detents showing a mug, plate, frozen block, butter stick; each detent encodes time+power cams"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Food-icon single dial","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Food-icon single dial","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Food-icon single dial","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Food-icon single dial","to":"F8","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Point the knob at the picture of what you are heating—no numbers, no two-knob coordination."},
{"title":"Steam-stop sensor","anchors":["C13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Vent humidity sensor","detail":"Cheap capacitive RH sensor in exhaust path stops cooking when steam burst detected"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Vent humidity sensor","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Vent humidity sensor","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Vent humidity sensor","to":"X13","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Food tells the oven when it is hot—user sets nothing."},
{"title":"IR done-temperature cutoff","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Ceiling IR thermopile","detail":"Non-contact sensor stops heating at a fixed 70 °C surface target"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Ceiling IR thermopile","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Ceiling IR thermopile","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Ceiling IR thermopile","to":"X13","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Every dish stops at eating temperature automatically—one outcome, no settings."},
{"title":"Pull-handle magnetic door","anchors":["C15","C16"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Magnetic-catch pull handle door","detail":"No button or latch lever; magnets hold door, hall sensors feed interlocks"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Magnetic-catch pull handle door","to":"C15","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Magnetic-catch pull handle door","to":"F9","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Magnetic-catch pull handle door","to":"F10","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Open it like a fridge—the most universally understood door gesture."},
{"title":"Drawer microwave","anchors":["C8","C26","C15"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Pull-out cavity drawer","detail":"Food sits in a sliding drawer; rails carry choke seal and interlocks"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Pull-out cavity drawer","to":"C8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Pull-out cavity drawer","to":"C26","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Pull-out cavity drawer","to":"F9","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Pull-out cavity drawer","to":"F6","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Pull, place, push—no swinging door or hidden release button to find."},
{"title":"Roll-top shutter door","anchors":["C8","C26"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Conductive tambour shutter","detail":"Interlinked metal slats roll up into the top like a bread bin"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Conductive tambour shutter","to":"C8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Conductive tambour shutter","to":"F9","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Conductive tambour shutter","to":"F6","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Bread-bin gesture everyone knows; nothing swings into the kitchen."},
{"title":"Voice 'ready' chip","anchors":["C22"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Speech-chip announcer","detail":"Greeting-card class voice chip says 'Your food is ready'"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Speech-chip announcer","to":"C22","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Speech-chip announcer","to":"F12","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"F12","to":"M14","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"A spoken sentence needs no interpretation, unlike codes of beeps."},
{"title":"Toaster-style auto-eject door","anchors":["C22","C15"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Spring auto-pop door","detail":"Timer cam releases the latch at zero so the door springs ajar"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Spring auto-pop door","to":"C22","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Spring auto-pop door","to":"F12","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Spring auto-pop door","to":"F9","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Done = door open; the signal and the next action are the same thing."},
{"title":"Filament-winding LED lamp","anchors":["C17","C2"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"LED strip on 3 V filament winding","detail":"Sealed LED bar powered from the transformer's filament tap, lifetime of the oven"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"LED strip on 3 V filament winding","to":"C17","type":"resolves"},{"from":"LED strip on 3 V filament winding","to":"F11","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"LED strip on 3 V filament winding","to":"X14","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Light that never burns out means the user never faces a dark, confusing cavity."},
{"title":"Transparent-conductor glass door","anchors":["C8","C17"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"ITO-coated clear glass door","detail":"Transparent conductive oxide film shields RF without mesh; kitchen light enters"},{"type":"Technology","label":"Transparent conductive thin-film shielding","detail":"Indium-tin-oxide layer below skin depth for 2.45 GHz"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"ITO-coated clear glass door","to":"C8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"ITO-coated clear glass door","to":"C17","type":"resolves"},{"from":"ITO-coated clear glass door","to":"Transparent conductive thin-film shielding","type":"enabled_by"},{"from":"ITO-coated clear glass door","to":"F11","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"You simply see the food like through a window—no mesh squinting, no lamp to fail."},
{"title":"EL-panel cavity wall","anchors":["C17"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Electroluminescent back-wall panel","detail":"Thin EL sheet behind microwave-transparent ceramic glows uniformly"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Electroluminescent back-wall panel","to":"C17","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Electroluminescent back-wall panel","to":"F11","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Shadow-free glow makes food state obvious at a glance."},
{"title":"Mode stirrer, flat floor","anchors":["C10","C11","C12"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Fan-driven waveguide mode stirrer","detail":"Metal paddle in the waveguide exit scrambles the field; cavity floor is a flat ceramic plate"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Fan-driven waveguide mode stirrer","to":"C10","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Fan-driven waveguide mode stirrer","to":"C12","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Fan-driven waveguide mode stirrer","to":"F5","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Fan-driven waveguide mode stirrer","to":"X3","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"No tray to seat correctly or knock off—just put the plate anywhere."},
{"title":"Rotating under-floor antenna","anchors":["C10","C12","C5"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Sub-floor rotating feed antenna","detail":"Slow-turning antenna under a ceramic floor sweeps the field pattern"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Sub-floor rotating feed antenna","to":"C10","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Sub-floor rotating feed antenna","to":"F5","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Sub-floor rotating feed antenna","to":"F3","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Oversize dishes don't jam—the user never thinks about fit."},
{"title":"Two-way cook/gentle rocker","anchors":["C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Cook / Gentle rocker switch","detail":"Binary switch: full duty or 30 % duty for defrost and melting"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Cook / Gentle rocker switch","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Cook / Gentle rocker switch","to":"F8","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"F8","to":"F16","type":"enables_function"}],"rationale":"Two words replace five abstract power levels."},
{"title":"Press-the-dial gentle mode","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Push-to-toggle timer dial","detail":"Single clockwork dial; pushing it in engages a cam for low-power cycling"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Push-to-toggle timer dial","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Push-to-toggle timer dial","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Push-to-toggle timer dial","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Push-to-toggle timer dial","to":"F8","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"One control object on the whole front panel."},
{"title":"Hold-to-heat touch pad","anchors":["C13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Dead-man heating pad","detail":"Magnetron runs only while a palm rests on a large pad; lift hand to stop"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Dead-man heating pad","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Dead-man heating pad","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Dead-man heating pad","to":"F10","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Direct cause-and-effect like a tap—no concept of a timer at all."},
{"title":"NFC-tagged dishware","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Dish tag reader","detail":"NFC coil in the floor reads a tag in the bowl or mug that encodes time and power"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Dish tag reader","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Dish tag reader","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Dish tag reader","to":"F8","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"The soup bowl knows how to heat soup—the user only closes the door."},
{"title":"Package barcode reader","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Door-frame barcode scanner","detail":"Reads the ready-meal barcode on insertion and applies the printed instructions"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Door-frame barcode scanner","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Door-frame barcode scanner","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Door-frame barcode scanner","to":"X13","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Packaged food self-programs the oven; no reading tiny instructions."},
{"title":"Mug-only mini microwave","anchors":["C7","C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Single-mug cavity with one button","detail":"Cylindrical cavity for one cup; one button heats to drinking temperature"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Single-mug cavity with one button","to":"C7","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Single-mug cavity with one button","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Single-mug cavity with one button","to":"F4","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"F4","to":"M3","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"A device that does one thing has nothing to learn."},
{"title":"Spoken-minutes control","anchors":["C13","C24"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Offline keyword voice module","detail":"Recognises 'one minute' to 'ten minutes' and 'defrost' locally"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Offline keyword voice module","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Offline keyword voice module","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"F7","to":"M14","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"Say what you want in plain words—hands free, no panel to study."},
{"title":"Reed-switch interlocks","anchors":["C16","C15"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Magnet-and-reed door sensing","detail":"Reed switches replace mechanical microswitches; door closes with light touch"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Magnet-and-reed door sensing","to":"C16","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Magnet-and-reed door sensing","to":"F10","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Magnet-and-reed door sensing","to":"X10","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"No slamming or re-seating the door to satisfy stiff latches—it 'just works'."},
{"title":"Elbow push panel","anchors":["C15"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Full-height elbow push plate","detail":"Whole side of fascia is the release paddle, operable with elbow or hip"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Full-height elbow push plate","to":"C15","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Full-height elbow push plate","to":"F9","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Nothing small to locate—push anywhere with anything."},
{"title":"Embossed tactile fascia","anchors":["C24"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Raised-icon tactile fascia","detail":"Moulded raised symbols and detent clicks convey settings by touch"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Raised-icon tactile fascia","to":"C24","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Raised-icon tactile fascia","to":"F7","type":"relevant_to"},{"from":"F7","to":"M14","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"Settings are readable by fingertips alone—no glasses, no manual."},
{"title":"Gravity weight timer","anchors":["C13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Descending-weight timer","detail":"Lift a visible weight on a track; it sinks over minutes and trips the switch at the bottom"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Descending-weight timer","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Descending-weight timer","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Descending-weight timer","to":"F12","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Time left is literally how high the weight is—visible from across the room."},
{"title":"Thermochromic window","anchors":["C8","C13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Thermochromic door glass","detail":"Inner pane tints red as cavity air passes 60 °C"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Thermochromic door glass","to":"C8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Thermochromic door glass","to":"F11","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Thermochromic door glass","to":"X13","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Red means hot—colour feedback replaces guessing a time."},
{"title":"Flashing-lamp ready signal","anchors":["C22","C17"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Blink-at-end lamp driver","detail":"Timer cam puts the cavity lamp into blink mode until the door opens"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Blink-at-end lamp driver","to":"C22","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Blink-at-end lamp driver","to":"F12","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Blink-at-end lamp driver","to":"F11","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"One component does light and signal; a blinking box is universally 'done'."},
{"title":"Bell-jar lift-top","anchors":["C8","C7","C15"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Lift-up metal dome cavity","detail":"Food sits on a fixed plinth; a counterbalanced dome lowers to seal"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Lift-up metal dome cavity","to":"C8","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Lift-up metal dome cavity","to":"F9","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Lift-up metal dome cavity","to":"F6","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Cover the plate like a cloche—no door, no reach-in, no button."},
{"title":"Silicone floor mat","anchors":["C10","C11"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Dishwasher-safe silicone cavity mat","detail":"Lies on a flat floor; lifts out with spills"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Dishwasher-safe silicone cavity mat","to":"C10","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Dishwasher-safe silicone cavity mat","to":"F18","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"F18","to":"M11","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"Nothing to align, break, or re-seat after cleaning."},
{"title":"Auto-soak timer cam","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Taper-end timer cam","detail":"Cam profile drops to 40 % duty in the final fifth of any set time for standing/evening"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Taper-end timer cam","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Taper-end timer cam","to":"F8","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Taper-end timer cam","to":"X3","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Even heating happens inside the one timer knob—the power knob disappears."},
{"title":"Colour-change turntable","anchors":["C10"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Thermochromic glass tray","detail":"Tray rim glows orange when plate underside exceeds 55 °C"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Thermochromic glass tray","to":"C10","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Thermochromic glass tray","to":"F11","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"F11","to":"M8","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"Feedback is in the tray itself; check doneness without touching food."},
{"title":"Toaster lever microwave","anchors":["C13","C14","C24"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Push-down lever with depth stops","detail":"Press the lever to a notch (1–5 min); springs back up at end with a clack"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Push-down lever with depth stops","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Push-down lever with depth stops","to":"C22","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Push-down lever with depth stops","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Push-down lever with depth stops","to":"F12","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Borrows the toaster's zero-learning gesture everyone already owns."},
{"title":"Wave-to-open door","anchors":["C15"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"IR proximity door opener","detail":"Spring door releases when a hand hovers in front of the handle zone"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"IR proximity door opener","to":"C15","type":"resolves"},{"from":"IR proximity door opener","to":"F9","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Hands full of plates? The door opens before you touch anything."},
{"title":"Detachable timer puck","anchors":["C13","C22"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Magnetic clip-off countdown puck","detail":"The timer dial lifts off and keeps counting, chiming in your pocket; oven stops via its own cam"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Magnetic clip-off countdown puck","to":"C22","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Magnetic clip-off countdown puck","to":"F12","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"F12","to":"M16","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"Set it like an egg timer, carry it like an egg timer—a mental model already learned."},
{"title":"Glow-in-dark big-numeral dial","anchors":["C24","C13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Photoluminescent oversize dial scale","detail":"Three marks only (1, 3, 5 min) in 25 mm luminous numerals"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Photoluminescent oversize dial scale","to":"C24","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Photoluminescent oversize dial scale","to":"F7","type":"relevant_to"},{"from":"F7","to":"M14","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"Fewer, bigger choices are read instantly in any light."},
{"title":"Steam whistle done-signal","anchors":["C22","C13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Kettle-style vent whistle","detail":"Exhaust port carries a reed whistle that sounds when steam flow rises"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Kettle-style vent whistle","to":"C22","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Kettle-style vent whistle","to":"F12","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Kettle-style vent whistle","to":"X13","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Passive, battery-free 'kettle logic': it whistles when the food is steaming hot."},
{"title":"Solid-state RF self-stopping","anchors":["C1","C2","C13"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Technology","label":"GaN solid-state RF with reflected-power sensing","detail":"Transistor amplifier monitors return loss; impedance shift when food warms triggers stop"},{"type":"Component","label":"Solid-state RF module","detail":"Replaces magnetron, transformer, capacitor and diode"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Solid-state RF module","to":"C1","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Solid-state RF module","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Solid-state RF module","to":"GaN solid-state RF with reflected-power sensing","type":"enabled_by"},{"from":"Solid-state RF module","to":"F1","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Solid-state RF module","to":"X13","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"The oven senses the food through the RF itself and stops—no timer to set."},
{"title":"Airflow-spun turntable","anchors":["C12","C18"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Pinwheel turntable driven by cooling air","detail":"Fan exhaust spins a vaned hub under the tray; no second motor"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Pinwheel turntable driven by cooling air","to":"C12","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Pinwheel turntable driven by cooling air","to":"F5","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"C18","to":"Pinwheel turntable driven by cooling air","type":"feeds"}],"rationale":"Fewer parts to fail means fewer confusing failure states for the user."},
{"title":"Portion-count dial","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"'1 plate / 2 plates / frozen' dial","detail":"Three detents encode combined time and duty cams"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"'1 plate / 2 plates / frozen' dial","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"'1 plate / 2 plates / frozen' dial","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"'1 plate / 2 plates / frozen' dial","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Users think in portions, not minutes and watts."},
{"title":"Foot-pedal door","anchors":["C15"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Bin-style foot pedal release","detail":"Pedal under the counter edge pops the door"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Bin-style foot pedal release","to":"C15","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Bin-style foot pedal release","to":"F9","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Kitchen-bin gesture needs no instruction and frees both hands."},
{"title":"Door-opens-at-end plus shelf light","anchors":["C22","C17"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Under-door amber floor light","detail":"At cycle end an amber LED lights the countertop in front of the oven"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Under-door amber floor light","to":"C22","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Under-door amber floor light","to":"F12","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"F12","to":"M14","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"A silent, room-visible cue that works for deaf users and noisy kitchens."},
{"title":"Weight+IR closed loop","anchors":["C13","C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Weight-and-temperature controller","detail":"Load cell sets initial power, IR thermopile ends the cycle"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Weight-and-temperature controller","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Weight-and-temperature controller","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Weight-and-temperature controller","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Weight-and-temperature controller","to":"F8","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Both knobs vanish; the front panel is just a door."},
{"title":"Cavity-is-the-cup dock","anchors":["C7","C10"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Insulated docking cup with RF seal","detail":"Dedicated lidded cup slides into a tight cylinder; cup rim forms the choke"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Insulated docking cup with RF seal","to":"C7","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Insulated docking cup with RF seal","to":"C10","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Insulated docking cup with RF seal","to":"F6","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"Insulated docking cup with RF seal","to":"X9","type":"partially_mitigates"}],"rationale":"Dock the cup like a phone—there is nothing else to understand."},
{"title":"Hourglass-visible clockwork","anchors":["C13","C24"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Exposed clockwork timer with sweep flag","detail":"Transparent fascia shows a big red flag sweeping back to zero"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Exposed clockwork timer with sweep flag","to":"C13","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Exposed clockwork timer with sweep flag","to":"F7","type":"performs_function"},{"from":"F7","to":"M8","type":"addresses_need"}],"rationale":"Progress is visible motion, not a number to decode."},
{"title":"Smart lid replaces power knob","anchors":["C14"],"new_nodes":[{"type":"Component","label":"Vented defrost dome","detail":"Perforated metal-mesh dome placed over frozen food shades it to ~30 % power"},{"type":"Technology","label":"Partial-aperture field attenuation","detail":"Mesh dome with sub-wavelength holes passes a controlled fraction of RF"}],"new_edges":[{"from":"Vented defrost dome","to":"C14","type":"resolves"},{"from":"Vented defrost dome","to":"Partial-aperture field attenuation","type":"enabled_by"},{"from":"Vented defrost dome","to":"F16","type":"performs_function"}],"rationale":"Defrosting means 'put the dome on'—a physical, obvious act."},

ideas.title: Toaster lever instead of timer, start and bell
